listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d'Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This holiday season, explore the unexpected wonders of the light-filled Issey Miyake fragrance gift sets. Designed in collaboration with creative director Yorgo Tloupas, the exclusive boxes echo Issey Miyake’s iconic aesthetic, captivating the senses through refined geometric patterns. A fresh and elegant woody marine fragrance for men. Experience a sensory awakening inspired by the energy of salt. A timeless masculine fragrance with a bold trail. Fragrance notes: Top notes: A salt accord combined with natural ginger Heart notes: Natural marine seaweed blended with sand vetiver Base notes: Cedarwood and natural oakmoss This vegan, woody marine scent is crafted from 95% natural ingredients, expressing the movement from the sea to the land. A 100% cardboard gift set, more responsibly crafted. Issey Miyake has designed its packaging to minimise its environmental impact. We encourage you to give a second life* to your gift boxes by reusing or sorting them. *Sorting guidelines may vary by location. Set contains: Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette, 50ml Le Sel d’Issey Shower Gel, 50ml

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM Elixir Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: Discover Phantom Elixir: the most rock and roll masculine signature by Rabanne. Inspired by the exhilarating energy of a night out, Phantom Elixir is made for the rock and roll night owl, who lives by his own rhythm, and revels in the contrast between shadows and light. More intense than ever before, Phantom Elixir is a clash of a fresh marine accord, vibrant mineral oud, and warm vanilla, celebrating the duality of Rabanne masculinity. Inspired by Paris at night, where the shadows meet the light, the elegant bottle of Phantom Elixir comes in an intense glossy black-to-silver gradient to reflect the olfactive contrast inside. More daring, more seductive; it embodies the clash of freshness and warmth within for the rock and roll night owl who embraces the duality of masculinity.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Created in 2006 by Jean-Claude Ellena, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette connects man to his origins, to the sources of his creative power. It tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth and his dialogue with nature. Since 2016, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel has been exploring new aspects of this fragrance. A woody, mineral composition, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette combines the power and radiance of cedar and grapefruit notes with a vibrant touch of flint. The base of the bottle is marked with an orange H, as if to leave its imprint on the earth. Its metal shoulders highlight the transparency of the fragrance. The Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette bottle unveils a range of details: the Hermès saddle nail, the sliding cover used to release the spray, etc. Designed by Philippe Mouquet, it is inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case that is conserved at the Emile Hermès museum.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Acne Studios Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Acne Studios by Frédéric Malle is an Eau de Parfum with a vibrant, magnetic and radical profile. It is an intense thrill of fresh aldehydes, concealed by the sweetness of flowers, peach and vanilla, warmed by creamy sandalwood and white musk.​ Frédéric Malle wanted to capture the spirit and create an olfactory reflection of the bountiful aesthetics of Acne Studios. He turned to the young prodigy of perfumery, Suzy Le Helley, to compose this powerful manifesto.​ Top notes: Aldehydes Middle notes: Rose, violet, orange blossom, peach notes Base notes: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Frankincense, Musks

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Latte Mimosa Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Encapsulate a moment of pure serenity. Latte Mimosa captures the ethereal beauty and sweet, powdery allure of the golden mimosa flower. Imagine a serene morning where dew-kissed blossoms mingle with the velvety softness of fresh milk. Opening with a vibrant burst of sunshine, this fragrance unfolds into a lush floral bouquet before settling into a warm, comforting, and lasting trail. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Vibrant Bergamot, Golden Mimosa Heart notes: Delicate Jasmine, Ylang Ylang, Soft Powdery Iris Base notes: Warm Sandalwood, Subtle Musk, Comforting Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Forte Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Nerolia Vetiver Forte, a neroli radiated with light, enveloped by the generosity of a creamy fig accord, the warmth of vetiver and the almond notes of the tonka bean. "I created a neroli gilded by the rays of a setting sun, and awakened by the power of vetiver." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. Aqua Allegoria Forte, the intense collection, is a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria Forte fragrances contain more than 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. *In accordance with the ISO 16128 calculation including water. How to use: Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Nerolia Vetiver Forte with: Bergamote Calabria, Orange Soleia, Mandarine Basilic or Pera Granita. Select your favorite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Scented Hair Perfume, 70ml
listings.description: The Baccarat Rouge 540 hair perfume delicately perfumes the hair while leaving it soft, thanks to its light and airy texture. At any time throughout the day, spray onto your brush or directly onto your hair for a freshened look and a beautifully delicate scent. A graphic and highly condensed signature, Baccarat Rouge 540 lies on the skin like an amber, floral and woody breeze. The aerial notes of jasmine and the radiance of saffron elevate the mineral facets of ambergris and the woody tones of freshly cut cedar wood—an irresistible combination. Castor oil–based, the Baccarat Rouge 540 hair perfume is held in the House’s iconic glass bottle, adorned with a frosted finish and topped with a cap inspired by the original fragrance. An exceptional feel-good olfactory gesture to savour every day. To enjoy a moment of well-being and prolong the sillage of your fragrance, add these other Baccarat Rouge 540 scented creations to your beauty ritual: hand and body cleansing gel, body oil and solid soap. Olfactory family: Woody, Ambery Floral Top notes: Jasmine Grandiflorum, Saffron Heart notes: Bitter almond, Mossy woody accord Base notes: Musky woody accord, Ethyl-maltol, Ambroxan™

listings.rawTitle: Valentino Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Masculine elegance meets a modern edge in Born in Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette, the fragrance for men by Valentino. Born in Roma Uomo intertwines Valentino's couture elegance with edgy modernity, reminiscent of Rome's street culture. This woody aftershave contrasts sophisticated and aromatic Clary Sage, Violet Leaves, and Vetiver Essence, against cool Mineral Salt, warm Modern Wood, and spicy Ginger. The glass bottle is encased in the armour of Valentino’s iconic stud, a fashion signature of Valentino Couture inspired by Roman architecture and representing a rebellious new era for high fashion. Born In Roma Uomo personifies this juxtaposition of old and new: Roma is where reverence for the past meets an irreverent attitude for now. To wear the Valentino stud is a symbol of strength; to wear Born In Roma is a symbol of celebration. Born In Roma Uomo Eau de Toilette celebrates where you have come from, and where you want to go. A statement of your personality, your heritage and your rules.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Ginger Biscuit Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: Just-baked biscuit. Spiced with ginger, nutmeg and cinnamon, melting into caramel. Butter-crumbly with roasted hazelnuts. Warmed by tonka bean and vanilla. Irresistible. In a special festive design finished with a bow. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another cologne or your favourite bath & body products.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Hand & Body Perfumed Gel, 200ml
listings.description: Enriched with shea butter, it perfumes the body intensively while leaving it softened and invigorated. Musk, with nuances of iris and ambrette seed, enhances the skin with a timeless fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: MATIERE PREMIERE Vanilla Powder Hair Perfume, 75ml
listings.description: Nomadic, light and kind to your hair. Spray at arm's length and scent your hair with the powerful, fluid and sensual notes of Vanilla Powder.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: What makes it different: The iconic smile of La Vie Est Belle is reinvented by the renowned artist Catherine Krunas, making way for a sculpted rose at the heart of the bottle. Each petal pays tribute to all the facets of women. In the hands of three French master perfumers in pursuit of the perfect rose, La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire emerges as a modern interpretation of the iconic flower of perfumery. "La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire is a modern interpretation of the Rose, the iconic flower of perfumery," as beautifully put by Anne Flippo, perfumer. It's a testament to the dedication and artistry of those who crafted this extraordinary fragrance. What else you need to know: Inspired by rose petals, the wings of La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire transition from white to pink, accentuated with a touch of silver glitter. Ingredients: Fresh Rose Water, Space Rose Accord, Rose Damascena absolue: A synergy of three different roses, united, to create the perfect one. Each extract highlights a different facet of the rose, from vegetal freshness to sensual opulence Iris Concrete: The iconic signature of La Vie Est Belle, the iris heightens La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire with its rich, floral and noble powdery note Woody Musk: Woody Musk is a sophisticated and timeless fragrance note, known for its warm, earthy, and sensuous qualities. It lends depth and longevity to perfumes, creating an indulgent scent experience An extraordinary trio of roses: La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire, the new scent of blooming happiness. Orchestrated by three French master perfumers, this scent celebrates the rose in all its forms. A rose made of crystal: The epitome of our savoir-faire. Discover a new blooming interpretation of our iconic crystal smile bottle. Sculpted like a crystal rose, the La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire precious bottle is an invitation for every woman to blossom into her extraordinary self. The perfumers of La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire: Anne Flipo: "This Extraordinaire version retains the codes of La Vie Est Belle, a gourmand iris. This main accord is shaped to make it brighter, more modern, with an added touch of magic" Dominique Ropion: "This formula celebrates the rose in all its forms" How to use: Spray La Vie Est Belle Rose Extraordinaire onto your skin, focusing on the warm areas of your body: the inside of your wrists, below your earlobes and behind your neck.

listings.description: Board first class this holiday season with Carolina Herrera and celebrate with the Bad Boy Cobalt gift set, pairing Bad Boy Cobalt Eau de Parfum and Shower Gel. This aromatic woody fruity fragrance blends lavender, geranium, truffle accord and vetiver for a fresh, electrifying scent charged with confidence. The Shower Gel cleanses and refreshes the skin with a subtle trace of the electrifying scent, creating the first step of a complete fragrance ritual. A luxury fragrance gift for men, ideal for holiday gifting, birthdays and special celebrations. Set contains: BAD BOY Cobalt Eau de Parfum, 50ml BAD BOY Cobalt Shower Gel, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Floral Street Enchanted Masquerade Eau de Parfum for Bridgerton 50ml
listings.description: A floral gourmand perfume created exclusively for Bridgerton. The most unforgettable encounter, brought to life. Fresh pear, hazelnut and gardenia immediately spark curiosity, while honeyed Centifolia rose quickens the heartbeat. Underneath, a flush of skin musks and sweet cedarwood lingers on the skin. This is a captivating fairytale of a fragrance for the romantic, spellbinding, elegant and spectacular, and all the diamonds of the season, of course. Are you ready to reveal your true self?

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera BAD BOY Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Bad Boy Elixir is a refined and highly concentrated elixir, evoking the smouldering heat that comes after a tumultuous storm with a sophisticated blend of aromatic sage, leather and cedarwood. The fragrance: Bad Boy Elixir is an ode to the House of Herrera's premium leatherwork, combining notes of aromatic sage with refined leather and cedarwood. Zesty bergamot from the original Bad Boy is combined with mandarin and sage. A twist of lavandin reveals a touch of softness, with the added mystique of cocoa and incense. Olfactive Family: Ambery, Leather, Woody. Top notes: Sage, Lavender Heart notes: Leather Accord, Iris Base notes: Cedarwood, Olibanum The bottle: The iconic Bad Boy lightning bolt is elevated with a luxurious brown bottle, reflecting the refined leather note that defines this powerful elixir.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Bergamote 22 Eau de Parfum Travel Kit, 10ml
listings.description: This dazzling bergamot combines freshness, sweetness and sensuality with acrobatic talent. All these qualities were encompassed in the perfume's initial code name: Fire Cologne. It's the delicate floral character of petit grain, the bitterness of grapefruit, as well as the flamboyant sweetness of amber and musk with a virile touch of vetiver, which gives Bergamote 22 its unique personality. Can't leave home without us? We know how hard the separation can be, so we've created a vintage, metal Le Labo travel tube to protect your new 10m spray.

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Halfeti Eau de Parfum 100ml Christmas Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Beloved Halfeti. An adventure of rose, spice, and fruits, leaving a trail of oud accord behind. The journey begins with an Eau de Parfum and body wash. The destination? Delight. It's just the ticket. This year, Penhaligon's Christmas collection is inspired by vintage travel trunks and the golden era of train travel, when the journey home was as important as the destination. Set contains: Halfeti Eau de Parfum, 100ml Halfeti Body & Hand Wash, 500ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée explores a new facet of Terre d’Hermès, where freshness and power interact. Reinterpreting the mineral, woody notes of Terre d’Hermès caught in an icy breeze, Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée Eau de Parfum combines the vibrancy of citron, the incisive freshness of juniper berry and the assertiveness of Timut pepper. Like a block of ice, the sleek and limpid bottle is marked with the iconic H on its base. Its frosted glass and brushed aluminium evoke the idea of a frost covering the earth. The refillable and recyclable bottle is made from glass and aluminium. Created by designer Philippe Mouquet and inspired by a bottle in a travel vanity case, the Terre d’Hermès Eau Givrée bottle reveals Hermès’ iconic saddle nail on its sliding cover.

listings.rawTitle: Hermes Terre d'Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense Refill, 200ml
listings.description: Creation: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a deeper facet of the inner fire that animates the earth and man. Olfactory notes: Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense is a deep, woody fragrance that combines fiery bergamot with burning wood, underpinned by the mineral notes of intense lava stone. Ethics: 100ml and 50ml Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense bottles can be replenished using the easy-to-use 200ml refill. How to use: Remove the cap from the Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense bottle, then unscrew the pump. Pour in the contents of the refill, placing it vertically on top of the bottle but taking care not to overfill it. Screw the pump back on, then replace the cap to close the bottle. Terre d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Intense can be sprayed onto clothes or skin for an enveloping trail.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Kobraa Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Kobraa, a timeless freshness, blended with the spiritual force of its black incense heart essence and the depth of its oud essence. A journey through the landscapes of Zealandia, a hidden continent where Snakeskin Jasper can be found. Zealandia, a hidden continent discovered only at the end of the 21st century, is an enigmatic part of the Earth where Snakeskin Jasper can be found. Used as an antidote for snakebites in ancient times, this gemstone is a symbol of powerful regeneration and life force that features a stunning green colour filled with contrasts. Bvlgari Le Gemme Kobraa contains a mysterious and timeless harmony between the spiritual force of its smoked black incense heart essence and the deep elegance of its oud essence. Black incense, a sacred raw material, inspired this fragrance. This rare ingredient allowed Jacques Cavallier to keep the clean, fresh facets of white incense while adding powerful smoky notes. Olfactive family: Ambery, Woody. Olfactive pyramid: Black Insense Heart Essence, Oud Essence.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Leite Néctar Perfume Mist, 90ml
listings.description: Leite Néctar Perfume Mist captures the irresistible comfort of Brazilian pavê de pêssego, a creamy peach dessert delicately layered with biscuits. Milky and fruity, this indulgent fragrance opens with notes of juicy peach, then melts into creamy coconut milk and sweet cream for a delicious scent that satisfies every craving. A dreamy escape you’ll want to wear again and again.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Champs-Élysées Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Champs-Elysées is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Champs-Elysées is a tribute to the City of Light and to Guerlain's flagship located at 68, Avenue des Champs-Elysées. This joyful floral fragrance celebrates mimosa. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Under the Lemon Trees Eau de Toilette
listings.description: The memory of a sunny escape to the countryside. Take a nap under the lemon trees while you indulge sparkling citrus scents, refreshing green leaves and the warm Mediterranean breeze. Maison Margiela’s Under the Lemon Trees is a combination of invigorating citruses complemented by the earthy freshness of green tea extract, coriander and woody extracts from both cedarwood and white musks. A perfectly light, everyday, unisex fragrance. From Maison Margiela’s Replica collection. Made In France. Top Notes: Kalamansi Lime Accord, Cardamon Essence Middle Notes: Coriander Essence, Green Tea Extract Base Notes: Cedarwood Essence, Cistus Absolue, White Musks Family: Citrus

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Athalia Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Athalia boasts a highly floral, woody and musky olfactory signature. Top notes of bitter orange and incense lead the wearer to the heart of this feminine Eau de Parfum, which combines powdery iris and delicate orange blossom enveloped in mysterious amber and caressed by white musk. It is an intriguing fragrance with a delicate opulence. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bitter Orange, Incense Heart notes: Orange Blossom, Iris, Cashmeran Base notes: Musk, Vanilla, Amber

listings.rawTitle: Juliette has a Gun Vanilla Vibes Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: Vanilla Vibes is the fusion of two opposites, an aphrodisiac natural Vanilla twisted with Sea Salt. Heart notes of natural vanilla absolute and orchid absolute combine with bottom notes of sandalwood absolute, tonka bean absolute, brown musk, benzoin absolute. Vanilla Vibes, the expression of sensual, powerful, and free femininity. Enjoy the trip. Top note: Fleur de sel Heart notes: Natural Vanilla Absolute, Orchid Absolute Bottom notes: Sandalwood Absolute, Tonka Bean Absolute, Brown Musk, Benzoin Absolute A fragrance for men and women.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vetiver Eau de Parfum, 125ml Refill
listings.description: In 2018, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel brought a new perspective to Terre d’Hermès and created Terre d’Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver. An unprecedented expression of power. An intense, woody composition, Terre d’Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver is underpinned by the depth of vetiver combined with the liveliness of green bergamot and Sichuan pepper. The Terre d'Hermès Eau Intense Vétiver refill is designed to replenish the 30ml travel bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Rosa Damascena Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Rosa Damascena, a floral perfume for women by Amandine Clerc-Marie. A crisp and spontaneous rose inspired by the concoctions of petals and crinkled leaves Amandine Clerc-Marie would brew in her family garden when she was a little girl. Exuding a sense of botanical purity and a lightly spiced floral signature, this Chloé for women Eau de Parfum is perfect for day and night. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Rosa Damascena with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Sacred Wood Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Sacred Wood is a portrait of Sandalwood, especially the most coveted variety from Mysore with its spicy, woodsy and milky facets that are simply incredible. The fragrance opens with Ambrette Seed Absolute and Carrot Seed Essence for spicy and earthen elements, only to unfold into a multi-layered Sandalwood Accord with Cedarwood Oil Atlas sourced in Morocco and Amyris Oil from Dominican Republic. Copaiba Balsam Oil adds warmth with an animalic aspect of Apricot. A malted milky vapor rises like incense, for an exceptional and long-lasting sillage. The Perfume notes: Amyris, Sandalwood, Tolu and Copahu balm. Olfative Family: The Cellars. Each KILIAN PARIS bottle is transformed into a precious object. The perfume bottles of the cellars family are adorned with a distinctive black lacquer and meticulously engraved on each side, with the representation of the Achilles shield. These details bring to the KILIAN PARIS creation a guarantee of luxury that should not be ephemeral, but should last a lifetime. That's why the bottle of this cellar perfume can be refilled indefinitely.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: As a homage to the equestrian art, Jean-Paul Guerlain created the first Amber fragrance for men in perfumery in 1965. Habit Rouge refers to the famous red jackets worn by the riders. It is a fragrance mix of earth, warm leather and the forest... This is a high-flying figure, the reflection of mastered, refined and powerful instinct. Habit Rouge Eau de Parfum reveals the intense and sensual signature of woody and leather notes. Habit Rouge has an eternally elegant French appeal. Habit Rouge embraces a dandy man who dares everything, combining sophistication and refinement. He lives his life fervently and distinguishes himself with a trail of extreme sensuality.

listings.description: The enveloping sensuality of two woody notes. A carnal agar wood softened by the sweetness of fir balsam. Profound, mysterious. “To the scent of agar wood, which carries a warm and mysterious vibration at its heart, I wanted to bring another wood, fir balsam, with its balmy and enveloping notes.” - Christine Nagel. Fragrane notes: agar wood, balsam fir.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Hermessence Agar Ébène Eau de Toilette 200ml

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Hubert Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. Two-sided two-tone Geranium: Considered as a masculine rose: this geranium emits an intense, aromatic breath of peppermint, clear green notes and moist earthy accents. This wealth of ingredients giving the perfume a refined, natural sillage. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Hubert transports us in the dream world of the d'Ornano family. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. Top notes: Mint accord, Shiso, Buchu Middle notes: Geranium, Cedarwood, Papyrus Base notes: Patchouli, Oakmoss accord, Ambroxan

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Rosa Nobile Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Passion, love, tenderness and joy - all emotions that are awoken by the unequalled femininity and beauty of the centifolia rose.An all-italian fragrance true to the brand's heritage, Rosa Nobile is born from the essence of the centifolia rose which is carefully grown and cultivated in a small rose garden in Piedmont, Italy. Each bud is hand-picked at dawn when they are still fresh and dressed with the morning dew during 40 days between May and June.Poetic in its complex beauty, Rosa Nobile is the embodiment of femininity and elegance.Originally released in 2014. Top notes: Pepper, bergamot, mandarin orange Heart notes: Rose, violet, lily-of-the-valley, peony Base notes: Musk, ambergris, cedar

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau De Mandarine Ambrée Eau de Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena created Eau de Mandarine Ambrée in 2013. It is a vibrant Cologne, as gentle as it is mischievous, that interprets the freshness of a sunlit orchard. A citrus, amber composition, Eau de Mandarine Ambrée Cologne combines fresh mandarin, juicy passion fruit and velvety amber. The iconic lantern bottle is adorned with a joyful, sparkling hue. Around the orange box, a vividly contrasting band recalls its colour. The Hermès Colognes Collection: Hermès Colognes explore the sensory nature of materials. Unifying beyond genres, ages or seasons, they bring immediate and abundant pleasure and offer a playground that is as infinite as it is masterly.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Sheer sensuality, crystal transparency, and luminous brightness. Bright Crystal Parfum is an enthralling and inviting new fragrance. Its fresh and floral notes create a timeless scent distinctly designed for the strong, confident and sensual Versace woman. The delicious opening to the fragrance centres around a dazzling feast of sweet and juicy pomegranate, yuzu and red fruits before leading into the soft and feminine floral heart of delicate magnolia, peony and lotus flower. The voluptuous parfum is rounded off with an intense blend of sophisticated woody and amber base notes, ensuring an enriching and long-lasting scent.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Chant for The Nymph Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Crafted from pure natural plants and flowers layered with modern molecules, each fragrance and formula in the Alchemist’s Garden is inspired by the science of alchemy, telling the story of a place, a moment, or a memory. The singular scents in the eaux de parfum, acque profumate and oils are customizable and transformative when layered in a multitude of ways, allowing each wearer to curate a distinct identity from their combinations, which linger in the air when worn. A Chant for the Nymph is an ode to tropical forests filled with sublimating solar flowers. The fragrance is inspired by the Frangipani, which symbolizes immortality for the heavenly and enduring smell that it releases on warm nights. With its enchanting beauty, the Frangipani embodies the story of a mythical nymph who appears on a summer’s night in a long-forgotten dream. Hiding behind the intoxicating Ylang Ylang and sensual Tiare flower, the nymph invites you to exotic lands, where seasonal clusters of long-lasting flowers are warmed by soft Vanilla. For daily use.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Chant for The Nymph Eau de Parfum 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Forte Eau de Parfum 75ml Christmas Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Discover the House’s iconic creations within a midnight blue velvet paper case, a gift to celebrate an out-of-the-ordinary Christmas. The limited edition Guerlain gift set is adorned in midnight blue velvet paper inspired by the universe of couturier Kévin Germanier. When opened, a holographic pink illuminates Guerlain’s iconic creations. This reusable case transforms into a true jewellery box. This gift box has been designed according to the principles of the circular economy to reduce its environmental impact: Velvet-topped gift box made with recycled paper-based materials Reusable gift box with removable inner tray Tube made from at least 26% recycled materials Refillable bottle made in France from at least 15% recycled glass Set contains: Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Forte Eau de Parfum, 75ml Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Forte Eau de Parfum, Miniature, 7.5ml Aqua Allegoria Florabloom Body Lotion, 75ml

listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Delicious Rhubarb & Rose Eau de Parfum, 30ml
listings.description: An irresistible Eau de Parfum with a tempting recipe of sweet lychee, delicate peony and rich cedarwood. A signature note of juicy raspberry brings out the joyful, sparkling nature of this sophisticated floral-fruity fragrance. Fragrance notes: Top notes: grapefruit, yuzu and lemongrass Heart notes: rhubarb leaf, rose and spearmint Base notes: vanilla, musk and spun sugar Fragrance family: gourmand.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Narcotic Delight Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A sensual shot of provocation. It set its sights on the erogenous Vanilla Bean, electrified by Pink Pepper, drenched in a draught of cognac, before finally succumbing to the intoxicating swirls of a cigar. A cheeky twist of plump and juicy cherry celebrates the indulgence of a polished proposition. Amber Vanilla. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Cherry, Cognac, Vanilla, Black and Pink Pepper, Tobacco.

listings.description: This festive season, Chloé draws inspiration from the Art Deco movement. The House revisits a period defined by effervescence. Graphic feathers and golden tones illuminate the gift boxes, recalling a time when celebration was conceived as an art form. Chloé captures the sparkle, the lightness, the joy of daring. A vibrant and feminine Holiday season. Set contains: Chloé Nomade Eau de Parfum, 50ml Chloé Nomade Body Lotion, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum Holiday Limited Edition Size, 200ml
listings.description: Intense musks. To celebrate the holidays, an exceptional new format. Fluffy, cottony, intensely mellow. Alongside iris and ambrette seed, musks reveal their carnal softness in Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum. An ideal fragrance to give or to keep.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Cinnabar Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Cinnabar is warm, mysterious, endlessly appealing spicy scent. Jasmine, Orange Flower, Clove and Patchouli blend intriguingly into an intense, sensual experience. Fragrance family: Spicy Amber. Top: Bulgarian Rose, Jasmine, Muguet Heart: Violet, Orris Base: Vetiver, Moss, Amber The Inspiration: "Cinnabar is a fragrance that fulfils every woman's yearning for the exotic and mysterious," said Mrs Lauder. "Its rich Amber notes provide a lingering warmth and sensuousness." Estée Lauder had always been fascinated with the mystery and opulence of the East. In 1978, she decided the time was right for an Eastern-influenced fragrance. Cinnabar marked the beginning of a worldwide wave of exotic Amber fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Santal Royal Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Santal Royal, a rare and precious wood majestically rising up in the penumbra. A fragrance trail that unfolds in a play of subtle contrasts between dark leather notes, the oud accord and the luminosity of floral notes of jasmine and rose. "In addition to its elegant woody and light facets, sandalwood has a certain freshness, that’s at once creamy and richly deep. Its intrinsic suppleness allows it to meld freely with certain spicy or floral notes, to which it lends body and soul." Thierry Wasser, Guerlain Master Perfumer. Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts by moonlight. A powerful symbol of Guerlain's commitment to the planet, Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain up to 90% natural origin*. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Santal Royal comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle which is made in France using 15% recycled glass. Featuring a removable spray pump and transparent lacquer finish, its design can be easily recycled. *90% to 94% of ingredients are of natural origin, in accordance with ISO 16128. Calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Inverness Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Its very name is intriguing, languorous: Inverness. A land of peat, heather and golden rain, beyond the senses, aptly known as the capital of the Highlands, the largest region in Scotland. Nature reigns free, unspoilt, extraordinary, and the River Ness forges its curves and mysteries. The odours of different varieties of wood rising up from this endless green and bracing empire, each more captivating and fragrant than the last. About the flacon: The plate of Inverness is inspired by the famous Scottish tartan, here with a unique pattern created by Memo Paris. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Iris butter, Mate absolute Heart notes: Sandalwood essence, Amyris essence Base notes: Cedarwood essence, Guaiacwood essence

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Eau Sauvage Aftershave Balm, 100ml
listings.description: Softens the skin and prevents razor burn thanks to the soothing properties of its active ingredients. A sensation of well-being that provides the skin with moisturization and comfort.100ml

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Si Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani Sì Eau De Parfum – The Perfume For Women. Armani Sì Eau De Parfum is a timeless perfume that is whole-hearted and grounded yet turns into a soft trail that lingers. Sì is Italian for 'yes' and reveals the contemporary femininity of Giorgio Armani, the Sì woman has the confidence to say yes to the values that define her life. This Eau de Parfum resembles fresh sheets that have dried outside in the summer air, soft and warm with a hint of sophisticated sweetness. Distinctive, creamy and catches attention, Armani Sì is a floral perfume for women who are strong and graceful. Fresh, green and addictive in its initial impression, the elegance of Freesia and the exquisite honey hues of Rose De Mai absolute make this perfume truly distinctive. The long-lasting and sensual notes of Oakmoss and Patchouli softly define this fragrance as a captivating modern chypre. Circling the neck of the Armani Si bottle is a gold ring that symbolises the promise of eternity, a perfect wedding, engagement, or anniversary gift. Looking for something lighter? Try Sì Eau de Toilette Looking for something more fruity and passionate? Try Sì Passione Eau de Parfum Looking for something more floral? Try Sì Fiori Eau de Parfum Fragrance Family: Modern Chypre. Top notes: Blackcurrant Liqueur Heart notes: Rose de Mai Absolute & Freesia Base notes: Patchouli & Oakmoss Notes: Patchouli & Oakmoss How to use: Before use, ensure your skin is hydrated with Armani Sì Body Lotion to intensify the moisture on your skin Apply Sì Eau de Parfum in a classic 'V' shape from one shoulder and finishing at the other

How to use: The perfect perfume for all occasions, this Gucci scent can be applied delicately to the wrist, neck and chest for a long-lasting gorgeous fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Dolce & Gabbana K by Dolce & Gabbana Parfum

The Fig, protagonist of all K by Dolce & Gabbana fragrances, is transformed into a sweeter and more addictive Caramelized Fig, mixing with notes of Licorice. To give depth and boldness to the fragrance, the base is all built around notes of Sandalwood. The design: The iconic glass bottle is tinged in an elegant midnight blue hue and adorned with a crown cap covered in burnished silver topped by a lapis lazuli blue dome. listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Van Cleef & Arpel’s Collection Extraordinaire revisits the legendary Oud Wood with Oud Blanc. A more transparent and crystalline Oud. An Oud accord enveloped in a composition that mingles aldehydic white Musks, tender Rose and a creamy base of Vanilla suffused by cool Incense. Part of the Matière Blanche collection, creative and dreamlike fragrances that play with the sensations and textures conjured up by the colour white. Symbolising purity, softness, and perfect balance, whose values are based on minimalism and olfactory excellence. To echo the material, Oud Blanc comes in an immaculate bottle in a deep and luminous white.

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Discover L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, a truly timeless fragrance. As Issey Miyake's first perfume for men, L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has established itself as a signature reference in the world of men's perfumery and aftershave. Strength and balance – these are the two qualities that unite the fragrance. Upon first spritz, you're greeted with the vibrant freshness of yuzu, the iconic Japanese citrus, and tangerine. In the heart, water lily creates the aquatic facet of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, balanced by warm spicy notes. Tobacco, vetiver, and sandalwood channel an energy which evokes that of a powerful waterfall, making the fragrance assertive and masculine. The iconic bottle of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has transcended time as well. Inspired by waterfalls as well, the slender, contemporary glass widens at the base and stands in contrast with the light grey hood.

listings.description: Delicate Floral. Effortless. Ethereal. Les Jardins Botaniques Wisteria is inspired by a leisurely stroll through garden paths filled with draping vines of Wisteria. The air is fresh and filled with the delicate scent of Wisteria's fragrant blooms. Radiant notes of Honeysuckle blend with the unexpected warmth of Ylang Ylang to create a light and ethereal fragrance evoking crisp morning air. Velvety Musks and subtle Woody notes linger on the skin like the embrace of a day spent in the magic of a beautiful garden.

listings.rawTitle: Guilty Absolu de Parfum For Him, 60ml
listings.description: Every guilty pleasure has a scent. What’s yours? Gucci Guilty Absolu de Parfum for men and for women is a duo of rare Millésimes. Guilty Absolu de Parfum for men is an intense woody ambery assemblage curated as a guilty pleasure. At its heart, the Rum Accord brings a warm aroma evoking the faceted savour of a fine aged spirit. Gently stirred with the sulfurous Orange Flower Absolute, it brings substance to the composition, while the fiery Red Chilli Pepper Accord spices it up. The result is a perfume for men that lasts for hours, a shot of sophistication, sensuality and mystery that is perfect for any occasion, especially a night out in the dim glow of an intimate space. The vibrant green flask of this Gucci fragrance unveils an absolutely Guilty scent made for a bold, confident and seductive man who embraces temptation.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Beach Blossom Cologne 50ml
listings.description: A summer escape to the idyllic palm-fringed beaches of the Seychelles to encounter the rare coco de mer. Basking in tropical sunlight, the sea coconut’s sculptural form inspires a fresh solar scent. A refreshing twist of coconut water is carried on the breeze, meeting the sparkling clarity of lime and mint, wrapped in the allure of tonka bean. How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points – your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products. Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. listings.description: Presenting a subtle balance of citrus and aromatic notes on a woody base, this Eau de Parfum exudes a fresh, sensual and refined scent in an ocean-blue bottle that will be remembered. Amongst the top notes, scents of bergamot and mandarin sublimate through a touch of aromatic water to offer a unique combination. The heart notes give Percival its character and depth through a blend of natural jasmine, violet and geranium, overlapping with lavender, coriander and cinnamon. On the skin, musk mixes with pepper, absolute balsam fir and, to give emphasis, woody spices are revealed at the base. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Pink Pepper Heart notes: Lavender, Geranium, Cardamom Base notes: Balsam fir, Woody spices, Tonka Bean A Parfums de Marly olfactory that is designed for men with a strong passionate side and a gentle refined spirit. Percival is a fresh fragrance that is as bold of a character as the man who wears it. The sensual and refined scent opens on aromatic bergamot, pink pepper and mandarin notes and settles to a heart of lavender, geranium and cardamom, holding true with a woody base.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense, a sensual and unique woody amber. The vanilla tincture, artisan-produced by Guerlain, blends with vanilla Tahitensis and smouldering patchouli. They accompany lavender and sandalwood, forming a unique and sensual woody amber composition. "Mon Guerlain Intense is a confident sensual enveloping signature, that no one forgets. It is this heavy dose of lush vanilla that creates an addictive quality while offering up plenty of elegance and mystery" Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. The 'quadrilobe' bottle, created in 198, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name 'quadrilobe' to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum Intense, a sensual and unique woody amber. The vanilla tincture, artisan-produced by Guerlain, blends with vanilla Tahitensis and smouldering patchouli. They accompany lavender and sandalwood, forming a unique and sensual woody amber composition. "Mon Guerlain Intense is a confident sensual enveloping signature, that no one forgets. It is this heavy dose of lush vanilla that creates an addictive quality while offering up plenty of elegance and mystery" Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. The 'quadrilobe' bottle, created in 198, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name 'quadrilobe' to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Olympéa Parfum
listings.description: Olympéa Parfum by Rabanne lets your divine aura shine to reveal your inner goddess. Olympéa Parfum is a hypnotic ambery green floral fragrance crafted with exceptional ingredients. A luminous vegetal accord blends with a white flower bouquet and mysterious vanilla to liberate the goddess within. To capture her mystery, the iconic Olympéa bottle evolves into lacquered black, with a glossy cap and divine golden wings. Olympéa Parfum captures the most mysterious facet of her divine power. The fragrance: Let your divine aura shine with new Olympéa Parfum by Rabanne: An ambery green floral fragrance that captures the sensuality within. Crafted with exceptional ingredients, Olympéa Parfum brings a fearless new intensity, blending a luminous vegetable accord with spicy notes of pink pepper, along with an irresistible bouquet of jasmine, absolute rose, and orange blossom. listings.description: Created from lemon tree flowers, oranges from California, Amyris from Jamaica, Iris from Florence, Vetiver from Haiti and a woody musky amber. Like the flamboyant warmth of a sunset Amyris kindles a flame that never dies. It's smooth bright and soft floral fragrance. Amyris is a genus of flowering plants in the citrus family. The generic name is derived from the Greek word which means "intensely scented" and refers to the strong odour of the resin. Members of the genus are commonly known as Torchwoods[4] because of their highly flammable wood.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: In the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs collection, artist perfumers guide your eyes and your nose towards singular flowers. Capturing Nature’s hidden scents and revealing the beauty in the unexplored through women's fragrance. The Fleurs de Nuit women's Eau de Parfum collection unveils the unsuspected fragrance of three flowers whose perfume changes as night falls. During the day, these enigmatic flowers absorb the brightness and warmth of the sun. At dusk - only at dusk - they fully blossom and release new carnal, narcotic notes to create a sophisticated scent. Among this women's perfume collection is Tubéreuse Lazuli Eau de Parfum for Women. In the early hours of the morning, the perfume of Tuberose in this floral woody perfume is green and fresh. As night approaches, it becomes increasingly dense and heady. To convey this powerful sensuality, perfumer Jean-Christophe Hérault has combined Indian Tuberose with voluptuous Jasmine. Through this fragrance for women, deepest facets of the flower are enhanced by a textured base accord where a refined white Oud blends with the creamy notes of Sandalwood and the smoked facets of Patchouli. For the Fleurs de Nuit collection, the iconic Atelier des Fleurs bottle takes on a captivating shade of midnight blue – a deep mysterious colour inspired by the vastness of the celestial vault – and features an undulating glass silhouette, evoking the sunburst pleating so dear to the Maison, and a sand-colored cap. A floral scent from Chloé that is a concentrate of timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Woody. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance that stays all day, delicately spray this floral perfume on clothing and pulse points at the neck, chest and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Ô Oui Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: It’s summertime; which emotion will you choose? It’s up to you to set your mood for the day. Meet Ô Oui, the exhilarating new Eau de Toilette in our Ô collection, amplifying its mood-boosting spirit with pure euphoria. Born under the golden sun of Le Domaine de la Rose and enriched with its signature Grasse rose, Ô Oui is an electrifying yes: an ode to thrill, freedom, and the pure joy of celebrating every radiant moment your way. The scent: A burst of euphoria. Created by Givaudan and infused with Happy&BlissfulTM technology, Ô Oui delivers a fresh, petal-like scent that’s irresistible, designed to awaken positive emotions, lift your mood and infuse your day with optimism. A radiant fruity-floral creation by master perfumers Quentin Bisch and Louise Turner, it shines with the vivid juiciness of lychee accord, blooms into centifolia rose, and lingers in the soft embrace of creamy musks and ambrette, evoking pure, luminous euphoria. Top notes: Lychee Accord, Bergamot Essence Heart notes: Centifolia Rose from Le Domaine de la Rose, Grasse Base notes: Ambrette, Musks The sensation: A wave of optimism. Designed to uplift the senses, Ô Oui inspires a sense of joy, positivity and euphoria - backed by consumer tests: 82% say this fragrance instantly puts them in a good mood* 77% agree they feel happy every time they wear it* 74% say they instantly feel delighted* *Consumer-test, 180 women. Why you'll love it: Instant mood boost: Helps spark a feeling of joy, lightness, and euphoric positivity from the very first spritz A burst of juicy euphoria: Vibrant lychee accord delivers an immediate fruity freshness, capturing the feeling of peak summer in a bottle A luminous, floral heart: Centifolia rose unfolds at the core, adding soft femininity and radiant elegance Sensual, skin-like warmth: Creamy musks and ambrette create a soft, irresistible trail that feels comforting, modern, and effortlessly sensual Created with expert artistry: Crafted by world-class master perfumers for a long-lasting scent that delivers perfect harmony between freshness, florality and warmth The bottle: A sculpted floral signature. A sleek, refined silhouette that captures the essence of the rose in a sculptural, tactile expression. Signature rose embossing brings depth and texture, creating a delicate interplay of light across its surface. Crowned with an elegant cap to evoke modern femininity and timeless sophistication.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Bal d'Afrique Absolu de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by founder Ben Gorham's personal connection to Africa, particularly his father's experiences travelling and living there, Ben Gorham crafted Bal d’Afrique as both an imaginary journey and a celebration of Africa's rich cultural impact on dance, art, and music. Intensifying the gourmand aspect of Bal d’Afrique, this reimagined composition heightens the contrast between vibrant lightness and addictive depth, offering a richer, more addictive experience. Notes of bergamot, lemon, and blackcurrant offer a bold vibrance, melting into the sweetness of praline, musks, and violet, and finishing on a dramatic base of cedar, vetiver, and warm black amber. Beyond the fragrance, the homage to craftsmanship is reflected in the newly redesigned Absolu de Parfum bottle. The textured cap, inspired by Yakisugi, the Japanese art of charring wood, embodies the deep intensity, transformation, and enduring strength that mirrors the essence of the Absolu. The silver and gold atomiser spray, with its industrial edge, complements the bottle’s elemental design and the clean curves of the glass. Within the bottle, the hue of the Absolu de Parfum is intensified, offering a visual hint at the rich concentration of fragrance inside. Woody Genderless Notes: Top: Bergamot, Lemon, Black Currant Heart: Musks, Praline, Violet Base: Black Amber, Cedarwood, Vetiver How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Caban Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Yves Saint Laurent's pea coat – caban in French – is known for its fascinating sophistication and its role in defining the maison's signature style. The fragrance mirrors the coat's comforting warmth and sleek lines with tonka bean, which brings notes of almond, caramel, and tobacco to the forefront. The olfaction: Inspired by YSL’s sleek, empowering pea coat, Caban reveals the innate elegance and sophistication of a simple olfactory shape, built around warm, lush tonka bean absolute. Run through with boldly woody tones, this fascinating tonka is textured with bright spices. Airy, fresh, and electric with a fruity facet, pink pepper absolute reflects light like carved golden buttons on a couture YSL caban. Tactile and sleekly sophisticated, Caban embodies a modern look with a raw yet enveloping impact. Fragrance family: Woody Spicy. Top notes: Pink Pepper Oil, Black Pepper Oil, Elemi Oil Heart notes: Olibanum Resinoid, Osmanthus Base notes: Sandalwood Oil, Tonka Bean, Patchouli Heart The inspiration: It was the very first piece Yves Saint Laurent presented under his name, in 1962. Opening his fashion show, worn with white shantung pants and mules, the thick wool double-breasted overcoat worn by sailors to ward off the cold and the rain - the caban, or pea coat – was reinvented as a couture garment. And paved the way for Yves Saint Laurent’s signature style, which borrowed from menswear to make women feel comfortable and confident. Turning the simplicity of a practical garment into the ultimate form of refinement, YSL’s caban has shown its range throughout the years, asserting a marine-inspired look or nonchalantly worn over a sleek cream satin gown. The Caban is more than just a single garment; it's a symbol of the YSL style, its clean lines and structured shape contributed to the distinctive YSL silhouette. blending masculine tailoring with feminine grace, female empowerment, and timeless sophistication. The Caban conveys a sense of confidence and power. When a person wears a Caban, they adopt a garment that historically signified authority and strength. This creates a sense of self-assuredness and boldness without compromising its fascinating elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Le Nectar Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Chloé Le Nectar reflects the instinctive, true-to-self nature of the Chloé woman. Rooted in the 1970s mood that still influences the Maison, the new fragrance draws on the spirit of that era. With Le Nectar, the Chloé woman finds her own rhythm between the past and present—independent, unbound by convention, and true to herself. The scent: Chloé Le Nectar opens with the sparkling freshness of bergamot, then reveals its heart: an opulent flower accord where neroli essential oil, orange blossom absolute and rose absolute intertwine in radiant harmony. As it settles, the base unveils an overload of balmy tonka absolute and amber accord, which is enriched by the earthy depth of patchouli essence. The bottle: Le Nectar is presented in the iconic pleated glass flacon, now distinguished by its warm amber hue and a golden beige ribbon. Le Nectar is available in refillable 30ml, 50ml and 100ml sizes. How to use: For a beautiful fragrance that stays on all day, delicately spray this women’s perfume onto clothing and pulse points: neck, chest, and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Libre L'Eau Nue Parfum de Peau 50ml
listings.description: Summer freedom in a scent for radiant skin. Libre L'Eau Nue is the first alcohol-free Parfum de Peau by Yves Saint Laurent. A sun-kissed, radiant and sultry scent of long Mediterranean summers on your skin. A unique sensorial experience that enhances the skin with a radiant glow.​ The bottle: Discover the iconic bottle of Libre in a new radical white couture piece. A new it-bottle echoing the uniqueness of Libre L'Eau Nue. How to use: A new sensorial fragrance gesture to suit your mood. Smell it. Feel it. Mist hair from 15cm (6") and lightly run your fingers through your lengths to evenly spread the product. Do not intentionally be exposed to the sun. Do not use it on the face. Avoid spraying towards the eyes. In case of contact, rinse immediately and thoroughly.

The crisp aldehydic notes are blended with black pepper and warm neroli, giving way to a more vivid floral heart. Rose, violet, and jasmine unfold with a stronger, subtly fruity nuance. The lovers, high above the world to almost touch the stars, with full hearts and bodies light as air. The Perfume: A true olfactory pleasure, the fresh perfume of tasty mango and the fresh scent of powdered sambac jasmine are mixed with coconut milk and rice, of a pallor similar to the moon, all wrapped in tonka bean and the delicacy of vetiver. Both unique and familiar, this fresh perfume with an exotic fragrance from Moonlight in Heaven pushes you to open the doors of paradise. Perfume notes: Grapefruit, Mango, Roasted Tonka Beans. listings.description: Ideal One tells the fantasy of the magnetic intimacy between you and a dream partner, who has been conceived to be the perfect match, captured in a carnal and sensual skin scent. Each of the Replica Fantasies fragrances is shaped around a surreal ingredient, born from the imagination of Perfumers. Master Perfumer Christophe Raynaud has bottled this fantasy, crafting this new fragrance around a unique Skin Fusion Accord. Imagine feeling your essences intertwining in a singular, skin-to-skin, intoxicating moment. So intense that the boundaries between you and your ideal one begin to blur, to become one. With this powerful trail, dream of carrying the permanent imprint of your Ideal One close to your skin.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Muse Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: To draw the silhouette of his ideal, trace the iconic pieces his muses inspired, the couturier dipped his pen in the darkest of inks. Thousands of sketches embody the essence of the couturier’s aesthetics in fluid black lines. The ink blends all of his unforgettable muses, as captured through Yves Saint Laurent’s vision. The olfaction: To capture the essence of his muses, Yves Saint Laurent turned to ink. Thousands of sketches flowed from his hand, each fluid stroke revealing the inspiring silhouettes of his ideal. In those bold, black lines, he translated inspiration into tangible form, immortalising the essence of his muses and all the creativity he drew from them. Ink is the enigmatic accord chosen for Le Vestiaire des Parfums’s new fragrance: Muse. A strikingly streamlined composition crafted by Principal Perfumer Marie Salamagne: "The ink reveals enigmatic woody notes, intimate and elegant smoky facets. It veils the skin in subtle, dark, metallic tones, slightly iris-y, earthy. For me, the ink takes on the colours of creativity and mystery. It stimulates the imagination." The dusky note is etched onto a precious ingredient, Marie Salamagne compares both to paper and skin, for its softness. Carnal and supple, iris concrete offers powdery, buttery, woody and leather facets for a perfect blend. Empowered by a sensual Bourbon vanilla absolute pod – another sublime material crafted for YSL - the result is what Marie Salamagne calls "a skin scent that explodes." A fragrant tattoo with an impressive trail, as distinctive and memorable as YSL’s fascinating muses. Fragrance family: Woody Ambery. Top notes: Incense, Lavender Ourika, Clary Sage Heart Heart notes: Ink accord, Ambrette Absolute Base notes: Vanilla Bourbon Absolute, Iris Concrete and Ambery Woods Accord The inspiration: Elegant. His muses were the epitome of the YSL style. They exuded a nonchalant elegance, a sense of effortless sophistication. They were often seen in simple yet impeccably tailored pieces, effortlessly donning tuxedos, embodying a chic silhouette. They were also the embodiment of the YSL spirit. They moved through the world with a captivating blend of purpose and individuality. They exuded an effortless confidence that defied convention by embracing androgyny, bold style choices.

At the heart of the fragrance, the emblematic Cedarwood. Thanks to its soothing scent, it reveals itself and extends in the background its milky effect in combination with the Musk and Vanilla. A silky texture that is gently left on skin.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum Travel Fragrance Set
listings.description: Take the iconic Baccarat Rouge 540 fragrance with you wherever you go, in your handbag or luggage. Set contains: A Globe Trotter gold-toned travel spray case. Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de Parfum Refills, 5 x 11ml

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme La Vie Est Belle L'original Eau De Parfum 50ml Body Care Travel Christmas Set
listings.description: This holiday season, the table is set for festive moments overflowing with optimism. Lancôme reveals a limited gifting collection designed by French artist Octave Marsal, whose artistry welcomes you inside a Parisian palace, surrounded by the city's most beloved icons. Step inside and pull up a seat at the holiday gathering. There is always extra room for more: more love, more friends, more generosity, and more happiness. Unwrap your gift and unveil your beauty icon. This set includes: La Vie Est Belle L’Original Eau de Parfum 50ml La Vie Est Belle Body Lotion 50ml La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum Travel Spray 10ml The Complete Fragrance Experience The Nourishing Base Body Lotion Enriched with royal jelly extract, this silky lotion deeply nourishes and hydrates the skin. Your At-Home Icon L’Original Eau de Parfum This is your daily signature and the ultimate scent of optimism. Created by three of the most renowned French perfumers, the brand's best-selling gourmand Eau de Parfum blends the nobility of iris with the depth of earthy patchouli and an alluring vanilla accord into an unforgettable, irresistible trail. It is encased in a refillable bottle designed to make happiness last. Happiness On-The-Go Travel Spray This is the brand's perfect handbag companion. Universally sized for travel or touch-ups on the go, this sleek purse spray allows you to refresh your signature fragrance trail anytime and anywhere, ensuring your holiday glow never fades. Set the Trail: Spray the 50ml Eau de Parfum on pulse points (wrists, neck, and décolletage) for your main morning ritual. Touch-Up Anywhere: Keep the 10ml Travel Spray in your bag or clutch to revive your scent throughout the day or night.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Ombré Leather Eau de Parfum, Travel Spray, 10ml
listings.description: Vast. Untethered. Driven. Freedom comes from within, the desert heart of the west wrapped in leather. It moves forward, untethered, through the still air of wide-open space. Floral leather and cool spices reveal an untethered scent for men and women. “Ombré Leather is a deeply textural scent that imprints you with a tactile sensuality. It makes one feel different, beautiful and desired.” TOM FORD.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Margiela Replica Fantasies Celestial Whispers Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A talismanic fragrance capturing the feeling of being surrounded by a protective, ethereal embrace. A chance to step outside of the pressures of everyday life, and to take a moment to pause and reflect. Celestial Whispers captures this contemplative mood in a powerfully smoky, fresh, and spicy olfactive trail. Each of the Replica Fantasies fragrances is structured around a surreal ingredient which stems from the imagination of Master Perfumers. At the heart of this new Eau de Parfum, Master Perfumer Daniela Andrier shaped a surreal fragrance accord, the Celestial Smoke. This imaginary treasure captures the fantasy sensation of being enveloped by delicate, fragrant swirls of bright white smoke as they rise in the air, sheltering you in a halo of positive energy. Celestial Whispers cloaks you in an aura of fragrant protection, as the warmth of incense smoke intertwines with the metallic brightness of aldhehydes. The fantasy of a fragrance imbued with protective virtues.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women 50ml
listings.description: In the Chloé Atelier des Fleurs collection, artist perfumers guide your eyes and your nose towards singular flowers. Capturing Nature’s hidden scents and revealing the beauty in the unexplored through women's fragrance. The Fleurs de Nuit women's Eau de Parfum collection unveils the unsuspected fragrance of three flowers whose perfume changes as night falls. During the day, these enigmatic flowers absorb the brightness and warmth of the sun. At dusk - only at dusk - they fully blossom and release new carnal, narcotic notes to create a sophisticated scent. Among this women's perfume collection is Nuit d'Oranger Eau de Parfum for Women. A symbol of the Mediterranean basin where the founder of Chloé, Gaby Aghion, was born, Orange Blossom has a fresh, delicate smell during the day. At night, it releases a generous, sensual scent that grows in intensity until dawn. In this fragrance composed by Alex Lee, Orange Blossom appears in two different forms: an airy Neroli gradually gives way to an opulent, honeyed Orange Blossom absolute. In the background of this fragrance for women, Mate and Patchouli form a herbaceous accord evoking the nature that surrounds the orange blossom. For the Fleurs de Nuit collection, the iconic Atelier des Fleurs bottle takes on a captivating shade of midnight blue – a deep mysterious colour inspired by the vastness of the celestial vault – and features an undulating glass silhouette, evoking the sunburst pleating so dear to the Maison, and a sand-colored cap. A floral scent from Chloé that is a concentrate of timeless elegance. Fragrance family: Floral. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance that stays all day, delicately spray this floral perfume on clothing and pulse points at the neck, chest and wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Herba Mimosa Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Herba Mimosa, a luminous perfume for women by Amandine Clerc-Marie. This tender, powdery women's Eau de Parfum echoes a memory from Amandine Clerc-Marie's youth: the stirred emotions of discovering mimosas blooming in the hills of Grasse when she was 20. The powdery, woody and luminous facets of mimosa blossoms lend a botanical facet to the composition of this spring fragrance. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Herba Mimosa with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

listings.description: Bright and energetic, Burberry Her Blossom perfume fragrance for women is a love letter to London in bloom. The gourmand signature of the original Eau de Parfum is wrapped in luminous plum blossom notes. Sparkling mandarin, creamy sandalwood and comforting musk notes convey warmth and depth. The bottle is luxurious yet understated, inspired by an archival Burberry fragrance design. Fragrance Family: Floral Gourmand. Top Notes: Mandarin, Pink peppercorn Heart Notes: Plum Blossom, Peony Base Notes: Musk, Sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums 1828 Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: JUles Verne. He was born in Nantes, at the beginning of that century of discoveries. The close ocean took him far away, inspiring in him extraordinary novels of adventure. Inspired by the father of literary science fiction, this Eau de Parfum breathes its aromatic Hesperides-like scents, just as a marine breeze over a wild heath. The scent of a treasure chest crafted from precious Wood and filled with spices from faraway lands, stowed on a boat sailing uncharted seas. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Grapefruit, Citrus, Tangerine, Eucalyptus Heart notes: Nutmeg, Pepper Base notes: Cedar, Incense, Vetiver, Pinecone

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her
listings.description: The fragrance: Feel the power of attraction pull you in with BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her, an intense, addictive scent that captures the strong, undeniable chemistry flowing between a power couple. The scent: A rich, full-bodied interpretation of the iconic signature BOSS The Scent, this ambery-floral-woody fragrance unites intense contrasts to unleash an alchemy of attraction. It opens with an overdose of addictive Orange Blossom, played against the enveloping warmth of Vetiver. The heated tension is further heightened by mysterious, airy Akigalawood, weaving through the base in a mesmerising embrace that entices the senses. The bottle: BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her reinvents empowering sensuality in a striking flacon featuring the BOSS logo on deep-plum lacquered glass and a Double-B monogrammed rose-gold cap. Capturing the spotlight, its multi-faceted shape reflects the sensorial showdown within this powerfully evocative scent, while echoing the many sides of a power couple. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Parfum for Her on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this addictive scent for women.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Not Your Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Not Your Rose Eau de Parfum with Ambrette and moss. Hiding in the winter haze, she is not your rose. Cold and mysterious, she cannot be possessed. Almost impossible to reach, she belongs to nature. Surviving the winter frost, she is glistening with aquatic rose and enveloped in soft musk. Meet The Perfumer. Caroline Dumur: "Hiding in the winter haze, the rose is at the same time fresh, almost cold and sensual, shaded with mystery. [...] an enigmatic accord that takes us back to that ephemeral moment, just after the rain... highlighted with ambrette, gently iridescent." How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Seeped in extreme natural tones, Hypnotic Poison Eau de Parfum draws its strength from powerful absolutes. The lush charm of sambac jasmine absolute mingled with a welcoming orange blossom absolute is wrapped in smooth, intensely evocative tonka bean. The round licorice note behind the seductiveness of Hypnotic Poison is boosted to new, bolder heights. It creates irresistible appeal empowered by the vanilla, an immediate sign of gratitude. An atmosphere of total deliciousness reigns supreme. The bottle of Hypnotic Poison-fragrance of mystery-is an absolute icon. A sultry incarnation of the forbidden fruit.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 01 Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Escentric 01 celebrates the hyper-abstraction of Iso E Super. Escentric 01 focuses on Iso E Super at 65% of the fragrance compound in an abbreviated formula designed to maximise the molecule's efflorescence. It contains lime peel, hedione (green jasmine bud), orris incense, balsamic notes, and fresh musk, producing a seriously lingering base note. Iso E Super does not exist in nature and was created in a laboratory at the IFF in 1973. This composition echoes the mystical power of Escentric 01 in a cult-scented formula that will add a dose of olfactory intrigue to your everyday. A unisex fragrance liberated from preconceptions of identity and form. We heard the best things come in small packages. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

listings.description: Inspired by one of the world's most beloved flowers, Armani/Prive ROSE ALEXANDRIE showcases the Rose of May, in the spirit of the gardens of Alexandria in Egypt. Drawing on the grace and distinction of rose, it is prized for its highly complex alchemy, lending itself to an infinite number of compositions. listings.description: Discover a sister scent to the iconic Clarins Eau Dynamisante - Introducing Eau des Jardins, a floral and uplifting treatment fragrance, made of 93% natural ingredients. Get that added pep in your step with this mood booster that will leave you smiling all day. Featuring top notes of zest of the lemon, orange and grapefruit; and heart notes of bay leaf, spearmint and geranium, combined with the balancing notes of cedar. Organic rowan bud extract blended with soothing organic blackcurrant bud extract leaves the skin glowing. Fill your day with joy with this treatment fragrance. Its gorgeous green bottle is refillable. How to use: Use every morning and top up at any time of day. In the splash format, applied all over your body: pour the Treatment Fragrance into your hands and rub onto your body In the spray format, applied like a fragrance: to take full advantage of the aromatic benefits of your Treatment Fragrance, spray into your hand, rub your palms together, then breathe in deeply.
