listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Solid Perfume, 3g
listings.description: The perfumer-artists of Chloé Atelier des Fleurs fragrances guide your eyes and nose toward some utterly singular flowers, revealing their imperfect charm. Paying tribute to the pioneering vision of Gaby Aghion, they shed light on the unknown facets of well-known flowers, all to reveal the beauty of the unexplored. Chloé presents Atelier des Sens. A new door opens in the atelier, where we discover new sensorial gestures and nomadic perfume rituals. The iconic fragrances of L'Atelier des Fleurs are being reinvented in the form of this elegant and refined solid perfume, allowing you to take the unique flowers of the collection everywhere with you. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Solid Perfume is infused with Magnolia Alba, one of the line's most emblematic fragrances, it elegantly scents the body with a unique interpretation of Chinese magnolia. Typically raw, powerful, almost astringent, this emblematic flower is here softened by creamy petal notes and subtle woods. Its melting balm texture allows you to scent your skin in one smooth gesture, easily applied to pulse points. Whether used alone for a more intimate Chloé fragrance experience or layered with your perfume so it lasts all day, it becomes the perfect companion for quick touch-ups. Designed in the iconic ivory shade, the lid smoothly glides open to reveal the endlessly refillable solid fragrance and its vegan formula that contains at least 93% naturally derived ingredients. Refills sold separately. How to use: Scent your skin by applying Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Magnolia Alba Solid Perfume melting balm texture on your pulse points with one smooth gesture.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Twilly d’Hermès Eau de Parfum Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Joyful effervescence. This limited edition gift set illustrated by Jonathan Burton is your invitation to a festive celebration with a difference in the Hermès workshop. A surreal commotion filled with fantasy and illusion for unforgettable gifts. A spicy, floral eau de parfum with a cheeky personality expressed through fresh ginger, light tuberose, and milky sandalwood. Christine Nagel: "It is with young women in mind, by observing their lives, that I created Twilly d’Hermès. Free, bold, connected, mischievous and irreverent, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, invent a brand new tempo." It is in this spirit that Christine Nagel composed Twilly d'Hermès. Ginger, tuberose and sandalwood are given a new twist. Combined differently, they become searing spice, disconcerting attraction, a revelation of the carnal. In a final flash of wit, a hand-tied silk ribbon playfully graces the bottle. Each silk ribbon is unique. Set contains: Twilly d’Hermès Eau de Parfum, 50ml Twilly d’Hermès Eau de Parfum travel size, 15ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Le Sel d’Issey Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Le Sel d’Issey Parfum, the new intense woody-marine-leather perfume for men by Issey Miyake. For this intense new Le Sel d’Issey perfume, the cold sea meets the heat of the land. Taken to deeper extremes, the marine scent pulses with a powerful vibration of woody notes, enriched with the leather tones of a vibrant saffron accord. As salt turns black, it reveals its most concentrated facets. An intensified woody-marine-leather perfume for men: For this new masculine fragrance, the original Le Sel d’Issey signature is enhanced with leather accents, adding depth to the infinite movement from the sea to the land. Fragrance notes: Top notes: A vivid salt accord meets a vibrant saffron accord Heart notes: The purity of natural-origin marine seaweed contrasts with the deep sensuality of black woody notes Base notes: A natural-origin amber accord envelops natural-origin oakmoss with warmth Two polarities are pushed to the extreme as the ultra-fresh sea encounters the incandescent land. Le Sel d’Issey Parfum is a long-lasting vegan perfume composed with 92% natural-origin ingredients. A bottle design embodying a new intensity: Evoking warmth and energy, the deep glossy black cap flows seamlessly into the dark gradient of the bottle, which is made with 20% recycled glass. How to use: Intensify your fragrance ritual. Refresh your skin with the Le Sel d’Issey Shower Gel and Deodorant Spray. Next, apply Le Sel d’Issey Parfum over your pulse points to amplify the scent’s long-lasting trail.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum 90ml Holiday Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This holiday season, the Armani gift set dresses in silver with a magnetic red touch and a festive bow. Open your holiday gift set and experience Armani’s timeless signatures. Elevate your festive gifting with the My Way women's gift set, which includes a full-size My Way Eau de Parfum, My Way Body Lotion and My Way Eau de Parfum travel size. Crafted within the floral ambery woody scent family, My Way is defined by exceptional ingredients: Bergamot from Calabria & Orange Blossom from Egypt: The sparkling start of the fragrance. The orange blossom note, extracted from hand-picked bitter orange fruits in Egypt, is created using an entirely natural effleurage extraction process Tuberose & Jasmine from India: The bright floral heart of the fragrance is a contemporary interpretation of iconic flowers. The Indian tuberose flower is sourced and hand-picked near Mysore, India, in the state of Karnataka Cedarwood from Virginia, Vanilla from Madagascar & White Musks: The enveloping vibrant base of the composition. listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums Rose On The Moon Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. Rose On The Moon Eau de Parfum with Sandalwood and Vanilla. Under the moonlight, the rose becomes hypnotic. She is illuminated. Coming alive in the night, she’s almost cold, mineral and intriguingly mysterious. Enveloped in deep sandalwood notes with the sweetness of the rose, she transports the mind and senses to a mystical state of inner peace. Meet The Perfumer: Fabrice Pellegrin: "A hypnotic rose, magnified by the sumptuous texture of sandalwood. I chose to create a synergy between the rose and the sandalwood note; in this composition, the flower and the wood seem to intertwine with each other." listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Sublimage L'Extrait Huile Lèvres Ultimate Lip Oil Reinvigorates And Nourishes, 7ml
listings.description: All the reinvigorating and nourishing powers of Vanilla Planifolia and Swertia extracts in an exceptional lip care product, SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Huile Lèvres. At the heart of its formula are powerful active ingredients: Swertia extract, which supports natural repair mechanisms that are even more intense at night, and a fortifying peptide to help reinvigorate the lips. In addition, polyfractioned Vanilla Planifolia helps nourish and revive lip skin. Lips appear fuller and more youthful. As lightweight as it is comfortable, and as enveloping as it is imperceptible, this amber oil is composed of 97% naturally derived ingredients* and lays a veil of softness on the lips. From the moment you wake up, your lips appear smoother and more luminous. Sparkles of amber from the formula shine through its glass bottle, which has been developed in partnership with a renowned French glassmaking House. The golden metal applicator has been designed to fit the shape of the lips perfectly for optimal application. To make every application an exceptional moment of pampering, SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Huile Lèvres comes in a leather case lined with tweed, the iconic CHANEL fabric, which has been exclusively created by Maison Lesage. *According to ISO 16128 standard. How to use: Apply SUBLIMAGE L’Extrait Huile Lèvres every night as part of the SUBLIMAGE ritual. For an extra touch of pampering, apply L’Extrait Huile Lèvres occasionally throughout the day. The golden metal applicator fits the shape of the lips perfectly and delivers just the right amount for an immediate feeling of comfort.

listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Eau de Toilette,100ml
listings.description: Escentric 03 honours Vetiveryl Acetate, a natural root and synthetic hybrid. Vetiver's alluringly sensual aromatic flavour goes beyond composition. This accord has a clean crispness with a sharp effervescent quality that plays beautifully in the landscape of skin scents. Picture the scene. A gentle river runs through green plains. On the horizon, a plump orange sun rises behind a set of fluffy clouds. This isn't a pastoral painting or a picture-perfect seen ripped from the pages of a literary classic. This is an olfactory memory of Escentric 03. Vetiveryl Acetate could be described as a hybrid molecule, half-synthetic, half-natural. It is a fraction of vetiver oil distilled from the roots of an Indian grass, which is then 'crossed' with acetic acid to remove the bitter and leathery aspects of the root. Escentric 03 focuses on Vetiveryl Acetate in a formula that pays tribute to the three roots used in perfumery: vetiver, ginger and orris. "I wanted Escentric 03 to bring out the scent impressions of these roots and show how they harmonise with each other," says Geza Schoen. Ginger dominates the top note, which is vibrant, green and spicy with lime peel and green peppercorn. The heart is a rich, velvety orris with Egyptian jasmine and tea notes. The dry-down emphasises the complex earthiness of vetiver together with sandalwood, cedar, mellow balsams and musk. The result is a spicy but fresh and elegant chypre with woody, balsamic notes — that heady hit of dark green woodiness when you walk past tropical grass, but far smoother and softer. How to use: Spritz onto your pulse points, such as wrists, neck, and behind your ears, as desired, and let it dry naturally.

The woody marine dry amber men’s fragrance. Created by perfumer Quentin Bisch, this new woody marine dry amber fragrance reveals sea freshness with warm land vibrancy. Evoking the sea, a salty polarity combines a vivid salt accord with natural origin marine seaweed and natural origin oakmoss. Evoking the land, the earth polarity is infused with the sensual notes of natural origin incense and natural origin amber notes. Upcycled cedarwood enhances the enveloping warmth. A long-lasting fragrance combining the intensity of salt with a masculine elegance. Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is made with 94% natural origin ingredients, including 100% natural origin French alcohol, and is vegan-certified. A refillable perfume bottle with an intensified design. In perfect harmony, the outer box features gunmetal colour details on matte grey textured paper. It is made with 10% upcycled seaweed and material from well-managed, FSC™ certified forests and other controlled sources. Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum is made in France. How to use: Enhance your perfume experience. Start with the Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Toilette shower gel, then apply Le Sel d’Issey Eau de Parfum all over, focusing on your pulse points, to enhance your fragrance experience.

listings.description: Bring on the night. Explore the depths of desire as the sun sets on a private island paradise. A sensational landscape of endless beaches illuminates under the stars. The twilight is yours for the taking. Dazzling reflections of Bergamot Essence dance across the delicate petals of Ylang Ylang—their spicy floral facets enhanced with smouldering Pepper. listings.description: Created by perfumers Ralf Schwieger and Nathalie Feisthauer, Eau des Merveilles Eau de Toilette showcases the wonders of Hermès. Where the extraordinary is brought into the light with a shower of stars. With its woody and amber fragrance, the Eau de Toilette invites you to take a stroll through enveloping benzoin, spicy elemi and sparkling bigarade orange. Designed by Serge Mausau, the star-spangled magnifying-glass bottle twinkles with an orange light. The cap is engraved with the house’s seal, the “clou de selle”. The Eau des Merveilles Constellation: The first opus of Hermès’ Merveilles collection, the Eau de Toilette invites you to discover a world of enchantment. listings.rawTitle: Annick Goutal Ambre Sauvage For Him Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Ambre Sauvage captures the magic of twilight in Tangier: the warmth of resins, the vibrancy of spices and the density of air that still hangs heavily with fragrance. Labdanum and styrax make up a fiery, balsamic amber, softened by voluptuous vanilla. Lavender and pink berries bring a fresh radiance, while iris distils a soft elegance. A reinvented amber, free, intense and luminous, that lingers on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Can't Stop Loving You Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: Kilian Hennessy crafts in Can’t Stop Loving You a true love declaration: a perfume celebrating love. This floral perfume enters the Narcotics olfactive family with, at the centerpiece, Orange Blossom, a symbol of eternal love. Both luminous and somber, Can’t Stop Loving You is a narcotic floral fragrance that puts peace in danger. The Perfume: The fragrance opens with the narcotic Orange Blossom flower, alongside Paradisone, an ethereal jasmine compound that suggests pure paradise. Its heart is incredibly suave, featuring Honey from Provence, a new ingredient in the KILIAN PARIS repertoire, for a delicious French touch. Vanilla absolute from Madagascar adds a doubly gourmand incitement to pleasure, while notes of Oak Moss bring an earthy intensity. Incense extract from Somalia lends sensuality, volume and endless mystery. The Perfume notes: Orange flower, Labdanum Cistus, Honey. Olfactive Family: The Narcotics. Perfumer: Alberto Morillas.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Side Effect Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: The Tobacco, Vanilla, Rum and Cinnamon harmony of this fragrance is spellbinding. Deeply buried emotions and passions take over. The fragrance lifts the veil on the unsayable. This passionate perfume has the power to plunge its wearer into that altered statewhere nothing is too daring because there are no risks left. Amber. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Cinnamon Bark, Rum, Tobacco, Saffron, Sandal Wood, Hedione.

listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana dedicate their classic fragrance Pour Homme to the elegance and style of the Italian man. It is an olfactory portrait of the Latin lover, able to project into the collective imagination the iconic power of his irrestistible appeal and tenderness. At the heart of the scent, lavender provides a soul of pure, dry freshness, like a Mediterranean breeze, while cedarwood lends it its masculine structure.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Sì Nude Bloom Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Sì Nude Bloom intertwines floral freshness and a skin-on-skin intensity in its fusion of a blackcurrant accord, May rose, and patchouli. Sì’s signature blackcurrant accord opens the fragrance, now crafted with sparkling mandarin, lemon, and bergamot essential oil, paired with the brightness of a black pepper extract. The florality intensifies at the heart, as a trio of roses, among them May rose absolute, convey a rich texture and density, as if the flowers’ petals, with their fruity, powdery, and floral facets, are caressing the skin. A daring, enveloping bloom then emerges at the base. Earthy, woody patchouli and vanilla bourbon, with its deep, balsamic tones, mingle with the scent’s floral femininity, creating an intense sillage. To perfectly capture the elegant twist on floral scents, the iconic Sì flacon is reimagined with a new luminosity. The SI Nude Bloom bottle is exquisitely crafted from radiant frosted glass, presenting a distinct nude hue, and crowned with Sì's organic, stone-shaped cap in soft nude pink. The signature 'Sì' name is artfully embossed directly into the glass in tactile, transparent lettering, adding a sophisticated touch. Discover Sì Nude Bloom, a radiant and silky chypre floral fragrance capturing the flower’s luminous and elegant sensuality. How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Mandarin Blossom Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: Find your moment. Sunlit skin, crisp sheets, a good book, the first sip of tea…all simple pleasures, all intimately familiar. With the introduction of White Tea in 2017, Elizabeth Arden embarked on a journey to capture these simple pleasures in a pure and exquisitely uncomplicated fragrance. White Tea Wild Rose and White Tea Vanilla Orchid expanded the experiential collection in 2019, and today, Elizabeth Arden introduces its latest scent – White Tea Mandarin Blossom. Mandarin Blossom combines citrusy sweet mandarin, delicate white tea, and warm luminous musks to create an energetic scent that instantly transports you to a bright meadow. Expertly crafted to evoke all of the different feelings you experience when taking a moment for yourself, Mandarin Blossom joins the White Tea collection to celebrates the pleasure of a life finely crafted. Discover the simple joy of defining a moment for yourself and savouring the personal reflection that comes with it. Citrus. Floral. Musk. Top Notes: Mandarin, Bergamot, Lemon, Exotic Fruits Heart Notes: Orange Flower, Jasmine, Neroli, White Tea Base Notes: Luminous Musks, Cedarwood, Osmanthus, Ambrox

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Angels' Share Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The perfume Angel's Share is Kilian Hennessy's most personal fragrance creation yet, inspired by his eighth-generation inheritance of Hennessy savoir-faire in cognac making. The perfume goes deep into the cellars of the founder's mind and memory, and into its most mysterious dimension: 'la part des anges' or 'angels' share,' an evaporation of liquor in oak barrels that lifts, while ageing, like a silent offering to the gods. The Perfume: Much like a Master Perfumer who crafts accords and essences in a perfume, a Master Blender combines the eaux-de-vie in perfect proportions for an exceptional cognac. Angels' Share contains the essence of Cognac derived from the liquor to lend it a natural caramel colour. Opening with cognac oil, upon a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence and Tonka bean absolute, the scent's long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline and vanilla make for a delicious finish, a rare concoction only angels should experience. Main notes: Cognac Essence, Tonka Bean Absolute, Oak Absolute. Top notes: Cognac Heart notes: Oak, Cinnamon Base notes: Tonka Bean, Sandalwood Perfumer: Benoist Lapouza. Designed to collect, curate, and carry your fragrances, the refillable spray bottle is a portable statement of style and elegance.

The distinctive bottle is designed with a silver translucent finish inspired by a polished gentleman's flask and features a black rhombus 'R' diamond monogram as a homage to the architectural heritage of its namesake city and Ralph Lauren's hometown. listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Zafferano Eau de Parfum 100ml
listings.description: In Acqua di Parma's Zafferano, the warm and dry notes of saffron are distilled and combined with luminous notes of Italian golden fruits, like gilded sparks dancing with the intense spicy notes to create an unexpected and vibrant sensation. Italianity meets the ingredient’s origin land, the Middle East in Venice, the historical European gateway along the ancient spice route that represents a metaphorical intersection between East and West, embodying charm and mystery, richness, and dissimulation. The essence of an intimate, never ostentatious luxury that can only be fully appreciated and understood by those who know their history. An unexpected juxtaposition, an olfactory translation of the Venetian terrazzo’s compositional technique, in which precious materials such as gold, marble and Murano glass are combined with mastery to create an objet d’art. A touch of flowers shines through the essential oils of orange blossom, jasmine sambac and geranium, further enhancing the heart of the composition. The woody and amber notes of tonka bean and vanilla soften the dusky accents of saffron, creating an intriguing and unexpected harmony. An exquisite experience that unfolds over time. A radiant interpretation of the precious and soft scent of Saffron. Ambery Woody. Top Notes: Mandarine, Bergamot, Coriander, Orange Heart Notes: Jasmine Sambac, Geranium, Rose, Saffron, Orange Blossom Base Notes: Vaniglia, Tonka Bean, Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès’ perfumer Christine Nagel, Le Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette is a surprising garden that it's neither green nor floral, but... blond. It is the expression of an olfactory quest through Greece that leads to Kythira, an unspoiled island that has inspired many artists. A citrus and woody fragrance, Un Jardin à Cythère Eau de Toilette combines enveloping notes of grasses with the strength of olive wood and the tenderness of fresh pistachio. Designed by Fred Rawyler, the bottle is inspired by the lines of the horse-drawn carriage lanterns of yesteryear. The luminous graduated yellow glass echoes the sunny fragrance. On the box, artist Elias Kafouros sketches a colourful landscape of his homeland: golden grasses, green olive trees, fresh pink pistachios and, in the background, the blue of the sea. The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the inspiration of the perfumer and the theme chosen by Hermès each year to illuminate its creation. An olfactory stroll to share for every moment, to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Rouge L'Interdit Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A floral woody gourmand fragrance blending luscious Black Cherry with a White Flower Bouquet. More magnetic, sensual, and bold than ever, L'Interdit Elixir by Givenchy unveils a striking new facet of femininity with its intense, captivating trail. A fragrance with magnetic power: From the very first notes, indulgent dark Black Cherry reveals a vibrant and sensual intensity. At its heart, the iconic L'Interdit signature white floral bouquet of Orange Blossom, Tuberose and Jasmine Sambac blends elegantly with Pure Oakwood Extract, giving the fragrance a deep intensity, enhanced by notes of Rum, Davana and Vanilla. A deeply sensual fragrance for women who seek to leave a lasting impression. A bottle crafted like a jewel: Inspired by the ruby, the L'Interdit bottle glows in an incandescent red that fades into black, designed to magnify the aura of the fragrance and evoke the rarest, most intense shade of the precious stone. How to use: For a light touch: mist a cloud of fragrance around your head and shoulders, letting it fall gently over you For a medium intensity: spray in a Y-shape across the body, starting from one shoulder and finishing at the other For a richer intensity: apply directly on pulse points and warm areas (wrists, inside of the elbows, base of the neck). The warmth of your skin will reveal the full intensity of the fragrance

listings.rawTitle: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: GOOD GIRL is inspired by Carolina Herrera’s unique vision of the duality of the modern woman: audacious and sexy, elegant and enigmatic, good and bad. Forever pushing and crossing the limit, the mysterious sensuality of GOOD GIRL makes for a modern yet sophisticated fragrance. For: Her When: All Day Type: Powerful & Daring POWER OF THE HEEL SHE’S GOOD ON ONE SIDE AND BAD ON THE OTHER The complex duality of modern femininity is captured in this sophisticated yet multifaceted women’s perfume. Reveal your good side – or your bad side – with the luminous facet of tuberose and best quality Sambac Jasmine contrasted with the dangerously addictive notes of roasted tonka beans and Cocoa. WELL BEHAVED GIRLS RARELY MAKE HISTORY Powerful, playful and a lady on the edge, the GOOD GIRL is never afraid to be herself, challenging the expectations of everyone she meets. Her magnetic sensuality captivates men and women alike as she knows exactly where and when to reveal her true self; good and bad. Informal elegance: Bulgarian rose, Jasmine sambac, Orange blossom, Praline, Cinnamon Freshness: Bergamot, lemon Comfort: Sandalwood, cedarwood, cashmere, Patchouli, Amber notes, Transparent musk POWERFUL, PROVOCATIVE AND UTTERLY COMPELLING: CAROLINA HERRERA CAPTURES THE NEW DIMENSIONS OF FEMININITY. GOOD GIRL, a boldly sophisticated scent in an astonishing new bottle that expresses women’s delicious duality. Complex and seemingly contradictory, this is a fragrance where sensibilities collide. She is the master of her own duality; ultra-feminine and powerful; sensual and irreverent; independent and fearless; and ultimately, brimming with intrigue. Women’s thrilling duality, which is brought to roaring life by the city that never sleeps, inspires a fragrance signed Carolina Herrera New York. The GOOD GIRL is unforgettable; she captivates us with her confidence, mesmerises us with her contemporary elegance, charms us with her unbridled, untamable spirit. Carolina Herrera celebrates the exquisite power of femininity and the beautiful contradictions of a woman today in the most alluring of ways.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR J’adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime Roller-Pearl, 20ml
listings.description: J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime is available in a roll-on Roller-Pearl format, a travel-friendly bottle for an infinitely sensual perfuming gesture. The glass bead tip of the J'adore Roller-Pearl bottle delivers a soft and voluptuous application of the J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime. The velvety-soft pearl rolls over the pulse points: neck, wrist and décolleté, releasing its sensual and enveloping notes: centifolia rose, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, Grasse tuberose and creamy sandalwood. As the J'adore Roller-Pearl sensually glides over the skin, the flowers of J'adore Eau de Parfum Infinissime unfurl and exalt their scent infinitely.

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Baie 19 Eau de Parfum Travel Refill, 3 x 10ml
listings.description: Truth is...Baie 19 should have been called Water 19. Not that it smells like nothing (though nothing smells like it), but it has this crisp, wet, drenched effect that water gives to the earth after the rain...And there’s a word for that, by the way: petrichor. It’s that magical feeling during heavy rain after a long dry spell, and it’s one of the most beautiful olfactive phenomena in nature. There are many reasons for this, including the ozone in the air, the negative ions, but most importantly the release of oil secretions from certain plants, accumulated after a long dry period. This is what Baie 19 is about: the dry juniper berry, the patchouli, the green leaves... all soaked by a beautiful, luminous, magnetic rain after a long drought. And the joy that comes with it... Refill your travel tube with the fragrance of your choice. Includes 3 x 10ml spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Giorgio Armani Armani Code Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Giorgio Armani unveils Armani Code Eau de Parfum, a new compelling and vibrant intensity, encapsulated in the iconic Armani Code refillable bottle. A new fougère ambery spicy fragrance that opens with a faceted freshness with notes of green mandarin and unfolds into a spicy and woody heart of nutmeg essence. A masculine sensuality emerges from the fragrance’s base through a rich and warm tonka bean absolute. Armani Code Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh and vibrant green mandarin essence, sourced from Italy, which brings a distinctive tangy effect to the fragrance. This essence is obtained by grating the zest of the mandarin fruit under running water, with the essence then separated from the water. The heart of the fragrance is composed of a warm and spicy nutmeg essence. The nutmeg essence, derived from the fruit of the nutmeg trees, is obtained via a meticulous drying and steam distillation process, to create its warm, spicy, and woody note. A warm, sensual masculinity is revealed in the fragrance’s base notes, which spotlight the richness of tonka bean absolute. Creating a honeyed tobacco note with milky undertones, the tonka bean absolute is derived from the fruit of the Dipterix odorata tree. The fruits are harvested just as they fall from the tree and undergo a drying process to allow the development of the coumarin molecule, that lends tonka its scent. The absolute is then obtained using a solvent extraction method. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: Soleil Neige is a ray of solar light, a breath of winter air that conjures sun on fresh alpine snow. Radiant and exhilarating, it captivates with bright citrus, white florals and musk. TOM FORD’s winter world conjures the thrill of a day on the slopes that melts into the celebratory warmth of après-ski. A cool burst of bright and green citrus gives way to a bouquet of winter-white florals and rose absolute. Fragrance family: Citrus Scent type: Citrus Musk

listings.rawTitle: Byredo La Tulipe Hair Perfume, 75ml
listings.description: When tulips start blooming, it is the sign that Spring has sprung. With the dull days of winter at an end, gardens come to life with bold colours and clean-cut shapes. Tulips may not be the first flowers you would think of as being fragrant, but a number are definitely sweet-smelling. Notes: Top: Cyclamen, Freesia, Rhubarb Heart: Tulip Base: Blonde Woods, Vetiver

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria, an enchanting Eau de Toilette that celebrates the majestic Calabria and its golden Bergamot fruit. Bergamotto di Calabria is characterised by effervescent top notes of bergamot fruits. At the heart of this Eau de Toilette, accords of red ginger and cedar wood bring a calming note while the base is rounded off with a unique combination of vetiver, benzoin, and musk. Bergamotto di Calabria comes in the iconic Acqua di Parma bottle with Art Deco influences. The glass, which is pure, luxurious, and thick, is tinged with a deep blue in a play of reflections that evokes the transparency of the sea.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria Eau de Toilette Spray 100ml
listings.description: Blu Mediterraneo Bergamotto di Calabria, an enchanting Eau de Toilette that celebrates the majestic Calabria and its golden Bergamot fruit. listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum 60ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: I Want Choo is a powerful floral gourmand woody fragrance that explodes with joy and good humour, finished with a seductive twist. It is the incarnation of the true Jimmy woman: glamorous, confident, playful and always full of joy. The sensual fragrance is inspired by the atmosphere when friends are getting ready to party the night away. It is not about going out; it is all about sharing the fun, the laughter and making it a girls' night in to remember. On top, a citrus note of mandarin juice contrasts with the suave, velvety peach nuances. The carnal and solar vanilla-like notes of the red spider lily blend in with the sensual vibes of jasmine sambac in the heart. The base notes of vanilla and benzoin anchor the fragrance in a deep, yet joyful way, leaving an intense vapour trail behind. Set contains: Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Eau de Parfum, 60ml Jimmy Choo I Want Choo Perfumed Body Lotion, 100ml

listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum 50ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: This holiday season, explore the unexpected wonders of the light-filled Issey Miyake fragrance gift sets. Designed in collaboration with creative director Yorgo Tloupas, the exclusive boxes echo Issey Miyake's iconic aesthetic, captivating the senses through refined geometric patterns. For this modern floral ambery fragrance, perfumer duo Fabrice Pellegrin and Marie Salamagne have translated light into a scent for an eau de parfum as radiant as a sunrise. Sparkling top notes of organic green mandarin open the perfume with a bright and zesty start. At the heart, solar notes of orange blossom diffuse a generous sunlit aura. Addictive base notes of a pistachio wood accord blend with creamy sandalwood. For a warm and sensual fragrance with a powerful luminosity. Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum is a vegan fragrance made with 90% natural-origin ingredients, including 100% natural-origin French alcohol. Set contains: Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum, 50ml Lumière d’Issey Moisturising Body Lotion, 50ml Lumière d’Issey Eau de Parfum Purse Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Mojave Ghost L'Huile Parfum Roll-On Perfumed Oil, 7.5ml
listings.description: Roll-On Perfumed Oil delivers an intense hit of fragrance with a long-lasting effect, in an alcohol-free formulation. Housed in a travel-friendly glass vial, perfect for on-the-go application. Capturing the soulful beauty of the Mojave Desert, this scent draws on the rare ghost flowers that emerge amidst the arid wilderness. Fragile, translucent petals blooming atop sunbaked terrain: a miraculous moment of life in Death Valley. Delicate magnolia and powdery violet notes layered atop the hazy warmth of ambrette and cedarwood. Against a seductive landscape of musk, a fresh appearance of Jamaican Nesberry. A graceful, lingering spirit of slowly unfurling contrasts. Notes: Top: Ambrette Heart: Magnolia, Sandalwood, Violet Base: Cedarwood, Chantilly Musk, Crisp Amber

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Mademoiselle Crush Absolu Eau de Parfum Limited Edition Sleeve, 100ml
listings.description: The ambery COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU scent embodies the power of attraction, whose pull is impossible to resist. An Eau de Parfum whose intensity is magnetic, designed by CHANEL In-House Perfumer-Creator Olivier Polge. It sparks a liberating rush each time it is applied, like love at first sight. COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU disrupts the status quo, presenting a sensual, captivating and indescribable version of femininity by means of fruity, floral and woody-ambery accords. A scent that leaves no one indifferent. COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU has taken the iconic COCO MADEMOISELLE bottle and elevated its impact and power of attraction to the next level. The scent's colour, a more intense variation of the line's hallmark pink-beige hue, evokes a deep, almost visceral sensuality. The black label accentuates the bottle's mystique. The CRUSH ABSOLU name appears in golden lettering, set into the glass like the promise of forever. Each detail strengthens the fragrance's magnetic pull and arouses fascination. How to use: To bring out the full power of this magnetic fragrance, spray COCO MADEMOISELLE CRUSH ABSOLU Eau de Parfum onto the skin or inside clothing in a sweeping motion. To accentuate the scent's sensual nature, spray it on the pulse points: the décolleté, the nape of the neck and the wrists.

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: To mark its sixtieth anniversary, Diptyque has chosen to pay homage to the legendary encounter with Orphéon, a late-night bar at the intersection of 34 boulevard Saint-Germain and the Rue de Pontoise. The bar’s entrance was adjacent to the original Diptyque boutique, and a few years later the Maison has extended into its space. Today, the only remaining vestige from the Orphéon is the blue faceted column at the back of the Diptyque boutique at 34 boulevard Saint-Germain. Orphéon Eau de Parfum is the olfactory portrait of the place where curls of tobacco smoke mingle with powdery trails of blusher, lingering on burnished wood. At the heart of the composition is the atmosphere of that unforgettable place, recognisable through the warmth of the tonka bean, the depth of cedar and the vivacity of juniper berries.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL N°5 Eau de Parfum Purse Spray, 3 x 20ml
listings.description: N°5, the very essence of femininity. A powdery floral bouquet housed in an iconic bottle with a minimalist design. A timeless, legendary fragrance. The eau de parfum draws inspiration from the parfum with which it shares its floral aldehyde signature. This floral bouquet composed around May Rose and Jasmine features bright citrus top notes. Aldehydes create a unique presence, and the smooth touch of Vanilla an incredibly sensual trail.20 ml spray sold with 2 refills.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Neroli Amara Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: The Collection Extraordinaire’s new Opus presents an emblematic material in perfumery: Neroli. Floral, green, and citrusy all at once, Neroli breathes new air into the Collection, making it more aqueous and botanical. The fragrance of Neroli Amara tells the tale of a princess’s love for her flower, Amara Orange Blossom… Notes: Top - Lemon Italy, Mandarin, Bergamot Middle - Black Pepper, Cypress Base - Orange Blossom Absolute

listings.rawTitle: Diptyque Fleur de Peau Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: In ancient Greece, one myth stood out as the most passionate and sensual: the love between Psyche and Eros. Only one scent can convey this legend as a fragrance, that of musks. Equally legendary, they have the unique ability to enhance the skin with their arousing carnal accents. They are at the very heart of Fleur de Peau, as cottony and light as they are soft. Highlighted with the elegantly powdery iris and fruity, ambery ambrette seeds, they reveal their full tactile dimension.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Coco Mademoiselle Eau de Parfum Twist and Spray
listings.description: The essence of a bold, free woman. An Amber fragrance with a strong personality, yet surprisingly fresh. The eau de parfum comes in a "Twist And Spray" format you can slip into your purse. A simple twist envelops you in the modern notes of this Amber-fresh fragrance. An Amber fragrance with a strong personality, yet surprisingly fresh. Sparks of fresh and vibrant orange immediately awaken the senses. A clear and sensual heart reveals the transparent accords of Jasmine and Rose. The trail unfurls the pure accents of Patchouli and Vetiver that emphasise the slender structure of the composition. The eau de parfum comes in a purse spray format to revive the notes of the fragrance throughout the day. A complete perfuming ritual for the bath and body is also available to enhance the fragrance trail.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Extrait, 50ml
listings.description: A men's fragrance icon and true to its pioneering spirit, Sauvage Extrait is Dior's first extrait de parfum for men. A composition of unprecedented intensity, matured for 42 days to reach its peak of intensity, resulting in ultimate long-lasting wear and power. The beating heart of the composition, the precious essence of Vietnamese oud, leaves its animalic imprint with leather notes in a rich blend of noble woods. In this denser and more woody interpretation, Francis Kurkdjian, Perfume Creative Director, imagined this intense trail that pushes the limits of concentration. The dark and enveloping essence of Indonesian patchouli contrasts with the light, creamy essences of Madagascan vetiver and Virginia cedarwood. A sensual and powerful base that is contrasted by a fresh and aromatic top accord of bergamot and an essence of AOP lavender from Provence. Its bottle, with its translucent interior lacquer – a true masterpiece of glasswork – evokes a drop of deep blue ink suspended in crystalline glass, engraved with the CD monogram. A signature that also adorns the cap, like a crown on the bottle. How to use: Spray Sauvage Extrait on pulse points, wrists and neck, to reveal a powerful and long-lasting olfactory imprint on the skin.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Bois Impérial by Quentin Bisch Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Bois Impérial has freshly crushed and spicy Thai Basil leaves that meet the sparkling peppery and grapefruit facets of Nepalese Timut Pepper absolute. A brilliant combination that contrasts perfectly with the bold woody signature of the fragrance. A green, rich and earthy Haitian Vetiver oil echoes with Georgywood, an exclusive molecule with powerful cedarwood tones. This vibrating woody association is illuminated by the sophisticated floralcy of Petalia. The majestic Akigalawood truly signs the fragrance. This exclusive natural ingredient is upcycled from Patchouli through a biotechnology process. Its unique spicy-woody character is enhanced by a rich Indonesian Patchouli oil and a powerful, sustainable note of Ambrofix.

listings.rawTitle: CREED Men's Sample Inspiration Fragrance Gift Set, 5 x 1.7ml
listings.description: The House of Creed Sample Inspiration Sets allow you to explore some of the finest fragrances for men and women from the comfort of your home and help you ensure you pick the right fragrance the first time round while shopping online. The glass Vials are 2.0ml and the Parfum's are 1.7ml hince the look of the vials not looking full. The Set contains: Aventus Eau de Parfum, 1.7ml Silver Mountain Water Eau de Parfum, 1.7ml Green Irish Tweed Eau de Parfum, 1.7ml Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum, 1.7ml Original Vetiver Eau de Parfum, 1.7ml The House of Creed is currently upgrading its packaging as part of its commitment to artisanal excellence. If you receive slightly different packaging to that shown while they go through this transition, please rest assured that the bottle contains the same exquisite formula as before.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Allure Homme Sport Superleggera Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: A new interpretation of the ALLURE HOMME SPORT fragrance, available as a limited-edition release. ALLURE HOMME SPORT SUPERLEGGERA is an intense fragrance with fresh, woody, ambery notes. A work of precision and balance that has been tuned to perfection. A tension between lightness and intensity, which reveals the allure of a man who is free and who strives for the ultimate in performance. Sleek and compact with a streamlined shape, the iconic ALLURE HOMME SPORT bottle has been reimagined using clear smoked glass. The emblematic Superleggera name, a symbol of excellence and distinction, is stamped in raised red lettering on the bottle, adding a touch of sporty allure. How to use: Spray ALLURE HOMME SPORT SUPERLEGGERA on skin or inside clothing.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Crafted Collection Rosetopia Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: The soft texture of petals and fresh notes of florals. LOEWE Rosetopia Eau de Parfum is a captivating fresh rose fragrance, conceived as a niche perfume that connects the human spirit with the raw beauty of nature. LOEWE Rosetopia Eau de Parfum is a contemporary olfactory escape shaped through notes of grapefruit and pink pepper, balanced by the delicacy of peony and lily of the valley. This nuanced peony perfume evokes pure serenity. Damascene rose forms the heart of the composition, unfolding into a base of amber and amber musk. Unveiling a deeply comforting amber scent, this niche fragrance lingers beautifully on the skin. The resinous, ambery LOEWE Accord waves through the composition. Inspired by the organic beauty of traditional handblown glass, this fresh fragrance from the LOEWE Crafted Collection arrives in a sculptural glass flask topped with a tactile granite cap, celebrating the collection’s innate artistry. A sensorial ode to floral notes, LOEWE Rosetopia EDP stands as a refined expression of craft.

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Oh! Midsummar Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: A scent of sunlight and celebration. Fresh wild strawberries glisten against green stems and meadow dew. Buttercups, clover, cornflower and meadowsweet weave the scent of flower crowns and birch-dressed maypoles. Gentle jasmine adds a soft, sunlit radiance, while patchouli and musk bring warmth and the feeling of skin in the open air. Scent notes: Top: Buttercup Accord Middle: Wild Strawberry Accord Base: Orcanox™ (captive ingredient)

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Distant Shores Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Empty beaches and shimmering horizons. Sea lily and sea grass ripple in the wind, touched by samphire and the faint salt of skin after a swim. Heather drifts through the air in a soft floral haze, while sun-warmed driftwood settles gently beneath it. Rolling sand dunes hold back the breeze, guarding quiet, summertime secrets. Scent notes: Top: Fresh Crisp Air Accord, Arctic Thyme Accord Middle: Mountain Carnation Accord, Olibanum Resinoid Base: Birch Tree Skin Accord, Moss Accord

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Deep Forest Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: A meditative walk beneath the pine canopy, where the air tastes of resin and rain. Pine needles and fir balsam bring crisp clarity, while cedar, spruce and vetiver root the scent in earthy calm. A breath of forest air accord moves through the stillness, carrying the brightness of pink pepper, rowanberry and juniper, like wild berries scattered across the forest floor. Scent notes: Top: Eucalyptus Leaves Essential Oil, Pink Pepper Pure Essence™ (captive ingredient) Middle: Cypress Essential Oil, Pine Essential Oil Base: Vetiver Essential Oil, Cedarwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Nordik Nights Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Outside, snow falls in silence; inside, warmth lingers. A scent that captures the sensual side of hygge, when soft light, stillness and comfort turn into deeper connection. Scent notes: Top: Cappuccino Accord Middle: Tonka Bean Absolute, Danish Bakery Accord Base: Driftwood Accord, Cedarwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: SKANDINAVISK Kopenhagen Eau De Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Climbing white roses open to the cool city air, merging with the soft mineral scent of stone after rain. Along the harbour, water moss mingles with a metallic accord of polished steel, reflecting the blend of ancient trading hub and modern creative pulse. Beneath the freshness, a trace of charred wood and pale musks adds warmth and depth in a contrast of purity and texture. Scent notes: Top: Blue aluminium Accord Middle: Cypress Essential Oil, Moss Accord Base: Cedarwood Essential Oil, Gaiacwood Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: New Notes Erotika Minimale Extrait de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Embody the essence of subtle sensuality. Erotika Minimale by New Notes is an aphrodisiac oriental-gourmand fragrance that celebrates the power of understated allure and confident elegance. It opens with an intriguing aura of warm spices, transitioning into a sophisticated, powdery floral heart before settling into a captivating base of leathery patchouli and soft vanilla nuances. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Spicy Coriander, Warm Cinnamon Heart notes: Pulpy Geranium, Powdery Rose, Sophisticated Iris, Jasmine Base notes: Sensual Musk, Leathery Patchouli, Warm Amber, Soft Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Argentina Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: With Argentina, Memo plunges into the heart of a territory, a country, to the rhythm of a dance, a passionate impulse. Argentina is embraced in its entirety, carried away in a single movement; that of a twirling tango. A dance of mixing, of travel, and on the dance floor, corolla shapes appear. Like a rose, emblematic of perfume, queen of flowers and symbol of ardent love. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Pink Pepper CO2 extract, Ambrette absolute Heart notes: Rose absolute, Jasmine Sambac absolute, Magnolia essence Base notes: Oud essence, Cypriol Heart, Benzoin resinoid Siam

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Soleil Blanc Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: In the world of Soleil, the sun never sets. The heat of endless summer lingers on the skin and wears long into the night. Soleil Blanc Parfum is an exaltation of floral-amber warmth with a rich concentration of white florals and glowing vanilla absolute. TOM FORD Soleil Blanc Parfum is a heightened blend of white florals, amber and coco de mer accord. The Soleil Blanc Parfum bottle embodies the uninhibited pursuit of sun and luxury with a bright white lacquered bottle and golden accents. The Parfum features an elevated, bevelled cap and plaque. Fragrance family: Warm and Spicy Scent type: Amber Floral

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Limited Edition Colonia Il Profumo Millesimato, 100ml
listings.description: To mark the 110th anniversary of Acqua di Parma’s Italian Art of Living, Colonia Il Profumo is reimagined in a celebratory Millesimato limited edition that magnifies its citrus notes and enduring Italian elegance. At its heart lies the exceptional 2024 harvest of Ylang-Ylang from Nosy Be, cultivated in the Madagascan island’s tropical climate, where the flowers develop their full complexity, marked by fruity and subtly spiced undertones. Nurtured by the year’s rare convergence of abundant rainfall and gentle warmth, the flower reveals a rare luminous complexity and intensity. Expertly distilled over 24 hours and delicately fractionated, the 2024 harvest of Ylang-Ylang from Nosy Be amplifies the vibrancy of the citruses and gives density and depth to the perfume. Italian bergamot, blood orange, petitgrain, and grapefruit open the composition with a golden freshness, while rosemary, orange leaves absolute, patchouli, and vetiver give structure and sophistication to this citrus aromatic creation. Presented in a glass bottle with an embossed architectural detail inspired by classical Italian design and a back label that highlights the fragrance’s craftsmanship and olfactory composition, the fragrance is housed in Acqua di Parma’s iconic yellow hatbox, distinguished by a golden medal stamp celebrating the 2024 harvest and the 110th anniversary of Acqua di Parma. A collector’s icon that bridges heritage and modern refinement with sophisticated olfactive clarity.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Tropiques Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Tropiques is a charismatic elixir for the bold explorer and a delicious ode to the lush flora found in the equatorial reaches of our wondrous planet. It is an exploration of the beauty of the tropics and their tantalising treasures. Created by perfumer Gael Montero, the fragrance starts with a vibrant infusion of bergamot, mandarin and papaya that ignites the senses, before they mingle with a sumptuously sweet rosyfolia®, lavandin and mahonial® in the heart. The ground-breaking captive molecules reinvent the story of exotic blooms, creating a drift of soft, solar floral heart notes caught on an island breeze. A dry-down of caramel, amber and musk evokes the warm embrace of the sun on the sand at the day’s close, rounding out this Fruity-Amber perfume that dances on the skin like sunlight and is your passport to an unspoilt, far-away island paradise.

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Violet & Amber Absolu, 100ml
listings.description: In the Arabian night, an ethereal violet mysteriously blooms. Beloved of the British flower bed, its elusive scent of darkly purple petals and violet leaves wraps around oud and white musk, anchored by warm, sophisticated amber. Fragrance notes: Heart notes: Violet. A smooth, warm and enveloping accord, composed of violet leaf and violet petals. Powdery and elegant Base notes: Amber. A note that wraps the fragrance in woody warmth, imbuing it with sensuality How to use: Spritz generously onto your wrists, neck and pulse points. Your body heat will help to diffuse the fragrance as the day goes on. Wear alone or layer with another Cologne or your favourite Bath & Body products.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Psychedelic Love Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: The signature of this narcotic bomb lies in three essential ingredients: Rose, Hedione and Heliotropin. Equally tender and illicit, this crystalline powder hides its intentions well. Beware of its creamy, powdery and floral facets, wavering between Vanilla and Almond! Floral. Made in France Unisex Cruelty-free Fragrance notes: Bergamot, Rose, Myrrh, Vanilla, Patchouli, Heliotrope, Hedione.

listings.rawTitle: BDK Parfums Vanille Leather Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Vanille Leather honours vanilla, a precious spice from Madagascar, in a creation with voluptuous and textured tones. Majestic, it invites you on an olfactory journey between warmth and sensuality. It melts into a trilogy of Indian tuberose, Egyptian jasmine and orange blossom.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Iris Malikhân Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Inspired by a breathtaking discovery of iris fields on the edge of the desert, Iris Malikhân contrasts a powdery verdant iris with warm notes of vanilla and leather. An intoxicating and addictive creation! Fragrance notes: Cypress essential oil, lentisque essential oil, galbanum absolute, orris butter, mimosa absolute, vanilla, leather accord, amber, musks. A fragrance for women and men.

listings.rawTitle: Essential Parfums Ambre Latte by Jordi Fernández Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Ambre Latte opens in a vaporous cloud of almond milk infused with roasted tonka bean. A decadent dulce de leche caramel melts into vanilla, benzoin and white musks, creating a perfectly controlled indulgence. Beneath its milky caress emerges a woody-amber alchemy, where Ambrofix, Georgywood, Akigalawood and sandalwood shape an intensely addictive trail, the perfect balance between gourmandise and addiction.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa Perfume Mist Best Sellers Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Your ultimate intro to being cheirosa all season long, this limited-edition set brings together the all-new floral Cheirosa 91 and three of our best-selling fragrances in travel-ready sizes. From fruity-floral to warm gourmand, each scent shines on its own or layers to make something all your own. Comes in a reusable, sunny yellow jelly bag that's perfect for travel, poolside days, or quick touch-ups on the go. How to use: Spray on wrist, neck, and chest. It can also be spritzed on hair and clothes for a lingering scent. Set contains: Cheirosa 62, 30ml Cheirosa 68, 30ml Cheirosa 59, 30ml Cheirosa 91, 30ml Jelly Bag

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Scent Layering Kit Trio Fragrance Gift Set, 3 x 9ml
listings.description: The three colognes in this starter kit have been chosen for effortless layering with your favourite Jo Malone London fragrance, allowing you to mix and match as you please. Play and combine to create a scent that's uniquely yours. Grapefruit lifts with a citrus brightness, Peony & Blush Suede warms with a smooth floralcy and English Oak & Hazelnut freshens with a woody elegance. Set contains; Grapefruit Cologne, 9ml Peony & Blush Suede Cologne, 9ml English Oak & Hazelnut Cologne, 9ml Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Looking to find your new favourite scent in person? Visit our Jo Malone London boutiques inside selected John Lewis & Partners shops: Cheadle Chelmsford Cribbs Causeway Edinburgh Exeter High Wycombe Horsham Milton Keynes Oxford Street Reading Southampton Stratford White City

listings.rawTitle: Versace Pour Femme Miniature Fragrance Gift Set, 4 x 5ml
listings.description: Pour Femme miniature set containing 5ml fragrances. Set contains: Dylan Purple Eau de Parfum, 5ml Dylan Turquoise Eau de Toilette, 5ml Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette, 5ml Bright Crystal Absolu Eau de Parfum, 5ml

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Cologne Collection Fragrance Gift Set, 5 x 9ml

Buongiorno Buonanotte: A delicate and enveloping fragrance that marks the end of a night filled with shared laughter and spontaneous joy when buongiorno and buonanotte blur into a single moment Buongiorno Amore Mio: A fragrance of unique, subtle elegance like fresh garments that softly embrace the skin, marking the beginning of a perfect new day Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente: A fragrance of light-hearted ease that comes from choosing to do nothing at all, except enjoy the sweetness of an unhurried day Buongiorno Gioco del Destino: A modern gourmand touch that evokes a moment sparked by chance, when something unexpected stirs a sudden, joyful sense of euphoria Buongiorno Al Bacio: A radiant, dewy fragrance that evokes the gentle intimacy of a morning kiss—an affectionate spark that awakens the senses and welcomes a new day Set contains: Buongiorno Buonanotte Eau de Parfum, 10ml Buongiorno Amore Mio Eau de Parfum, 10ml Buongiorno Dolce Far Niente Eau de Parfum, 10ml Buongiorno Gioco del Destino Eau de Parfum, 10ml Buongiorno Al Bacio Eau de Parfum, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Versace Dylan Blue Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Dylan Blue Pour Femme is a tribute to femininity, an alchemy of irresistible notes that dance, arouse and embrace. The colour of the bottle is as intense as the deep and mysterious Mediterranean Sea, whilst the gold details and the iconic Medusa, a bridge between the past and present, serve to embellish the precious content.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy Gentleman Eau de Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Gentleman Givenchy, a new intensity full of fearless charm. Vibrant and charismatic the Eau de Parfum plays it freestyle for men who choose not to follow the crowd; for men who dance to their own beat. A woody-Floral plays an explosive tempo from the get-go. Peppery effervescence rifts with the gentle and aromatic lavender. Contrasting notes built upon a beating floral heart. Amber and addictive. A rhythmic scent to accompany you through the night.

listings.rawTitle: Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Embrace the untamed beauty of nature with a scent as free-spirited as a wildflower bouquet. Playful and wild, Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra blends the rare chocolatey floral of a real Chocolate Daisy with creamy Banana, juicy Pear Nectar, and a warm swirl of Vanilla and Amber. A floral gourmand that feels youthful, joyful, and effortlessly sophisticated—capturing the sweetness of nostalgia and the thrill of the unexpected. Marc Jacobs Daisy Wild Eau So Extra adds an extra layer of sophistication through its cap and bottle design. Taking inspiration from a wildflower bouquet, now blooming in vibrant shades, the bottle is crowned in a mix of yellow, pink, purple, and green flowers, while playful stems remain, peeking through a bottle in a deeper shade and adorned with a gold logo. The result is a bottle and cap that feel precious and elevated, yet still playful and spirited. How to use: Spritz onto pulse points (neck, wrists, and décolletage) for a long-lasting, impactful scent. Wear alone or layer with your favourite Daisy scents to enhance and extend the fragrance experience. Reapply as desired to keep the surreal garden blooming all day.

listings.rawTitle: TOCCA Colette Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Colette Eau de Parfum is TOCCA’s chic floral amber fragrance, made for effortless everyday luxury. Colette is effortlessly chic and endlessly sophisticated. Colette opens with bright bergamot and mandarin before melting into jasmine and settling into warm sandalwood, vanilla and musk. Elegant yet understated, Colette captures the charm of Parisian cafés and the quiet confidence of a modern classic. Fragrance family: Floral Amber. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bergamot, Mandarin, Lemon, Juniper Berry, Pink Peppercorn Heart notes: Jasmine, Violet, Cyclamen Base notes: Incense, Musk, Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Cedarwood TOCCA fragrances are inspired by powerful feminine archetypes, both mythic and modern muses. Crafted by master perfumers with the world’s finest ingredients, each Eau de Parfum is housed in a fluted Italian glass bottle with a hand-finished cap — a graceful tribute to feminine beauty and confidence. How to use: Spray generously onto your wrists, neck, and pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Heaven Can Wait Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Heaven Can Wait is Jean-Claude Ellena’s sensual journey in warm spice. Clove, pimento, ambrette and carrot seed are joined by the sophisticated beauty of iris. Vetiver brings structure and vibrancy; facets of peach and prune, roundness. Inspired in part by the intimacy of private worlds, the result is a modern rendering of a Parisian classic: understated, discreet and noble–an eternal seduction, simultaneously exotic and comforting. It subtly draws one in irresistibly and invites embrace. The result is something we now appreciate more than ever: a private heaven. Born into a family of perfumers from Grasse, Jean-Claude Ellena was introduced to the art of developing fragrances as a teenager. Self-taught, he defines his creations as a “poetry of memory.” Everyday smells–wax floors, clean sheets, skin, an old sweater–are some of his great inspirations. His signature is simple, minimalist and modern. Top notes: clove, ambrette, carrot seed Middle notes: iris, vetiver Base notes: vanilla, peach, musk

listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Flåm Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: A fragrance that brings to mind the magnetic energy of the northern lights alongside the protective warmth of a cosy wooden house. The marriage of natural ingredients, including bergamot, bitter orange, aromatic clary sage, and sambac jasmine, creates a rush of bright freshness. They whirl around suave, vibrant notes of cedarwood. Then emerges that pleasant feeling of well-being at home, as Mother Earth generously provides ingredients such as tonka bean and vanilla pods, paired with comforting mineral amber and sweet white musk. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Bergamot essence, Orange Bitter essence, Clary Sage essence Heart notes: Petal accord, Jasmine Sambac absolute Base notes: Cedarwood essence Virginia, Tonka Bean resinoid, Vanilla absolute Madagascar, Musk, ambrettolide

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Lady Million, the ultra-feminine fragrance for women by Rabanne. A carnal white floral fragrance, diamond-bright and daring. Shine for all to see, because decadence is thrilling. A trail of white flowers awakens the skin with fresh notes and exudes an intimate woody warmth. Infused with notes of jasmine, orange blossom and honey. An addictive scent, seductive, sensual. The striking gold bottle is fun, fabulous and created for a glamorous, confident woman. Perfectly packaged in decadent, gilded gold. The fragrance: Lady Million is a fresh, woody, floral scent with notes of jasmine sambac, orange blossom, neroli, raspberry and bitter orange, this signature honey patchouli perfume manages to be evocative and brave. The bottle: A multi-faceted glass diamond. Clean, architectural, naturally dazzling. Special features: perfect size, beautiful shape, gold cabochon. Inspiration: "The Regent", a famous diamond preserved at the Louvre Museum. Creation: Noé Duchaufour-Lawrance. Olfactive family: Fresh Woody, Floral. Top notes: Neroli, Bitter Orange & Raspberry Heart notes: Orange Blossom Absolute, Jasmine Absolute Base notes: Honey & Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Solo Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Balanced and contemporary, the unisex LOEWE Solo Elixir reinvents and enhances the original LOEWE Solo fragrance with a higher concentration of the warm yet intense benzoin, labdanum and tarragon essential oils. LOEWE Solo Elixir unveils aromatic, floral and amber notes of lavender, jasmine sambac, mandarin and orris combined with spicy nutmeg, cinnamon, olibanum and patchouli. The composition is highlighted by the rich, raw and authentic aspects of LOEWE Accord - an exclusive note created by our perfumer, Nuria Cruelles, and based on the complex, resinous scent of the Spanish rockrose wildflower - LOEWE's olfactory identity. The entire LOEWE Solo fragrance family is inspired by the sunset: its soothing, radiant glow and blissful state of suspension between night and day: a joyful sense of perfect elegance, serenity and eternal calm. LOEWE Solo Elixir fragrance for men and women is presented in the house's signature block-shaped glass flask in a gradient of burnt umber, echoing the colour of the original fragrance with a tactile wooden cap.

listings.rawTitle: Miu Miu Miutine Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The new feminine fragrance by Miu Miu - a duo of wild strawberry accord with vanilla and brown sugar twists an iconic warm floral signature with a hint of gourmand. Unconstrained and unconventionally feminine, Miutine Eau de Parfum reaffirms the essence of Miu Miu with a bold, memorable scent for those who navigate life on their own terms. Fragrance notes: Top note: Wild Strawberry accord Heart note: Gardenia accord Base note: Brown Sugar accord, Vanilla, Patchouli oil Youthful and unconstrained, Miutine offers a Miu Miu twist on an iconic fragrance family: the warm floral. Inspired by Miuccia Prada’s unconventional aesthetic, master perfumer Dominique Ropion teases the vintage genre into an effortlessly cool floral with a gourmand twist that subverts expectations. "I started from a classic and I twisted it with a surprising resonance, a harmony of mischievous freshness and opulent sensuality." Dominique Ropion, master perfumer of Miutine. Miutine Eau de Parfum is the signature Miu Miu fragrance for those who are confident in their contradictions. Featuring juicy wild strawberry to express the Miu Miu girl’s spontaneous and unyielding spirit. A radiant, milky gardenia accord to embody her effortless charm. A sweetly provocative blend of chic patchouli oil, brown sugar accord, and vanilla for her unconventional femininity. Cheeky but sophisticated. Youthful yet assertive. Irreverent and carefree. About the bottle: Twisted into a modern icon for Miutine, Miu Miu’s signature retro-modern bottle becomes more covetable than ever. Irreverent and sophisticated, with the famous matelassé glass inspired by the luxury house’s iconic leather handbags. Instantly desirable, with the Miu Miu tag as a ring around the collar. Bold and playful, with its round black cap in the shape of a sequin. The unexpected modern brown tint of the transparent glass expresses a different, ultra-contemporary type of femininity, with a touch of boyishness. Youthful as ever. But all grown up. How to use: Exude the carefree spirit of a Miu Miu girl with your new signature scent - spray Miutine to the pulse points on your neck, collarbone, and wrist. To leave an even longer-lasting scent trail, apply to the crooks of your elbows and the back of the knees, which will intensify the fragrance with the warmth of your body heat.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Magic Energy Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: “Magic Energy is a sophisticated and reawakening scent that helps connect you to the four elements of nature! “Air is channelled through the crisp and effervescent bergamot, bringing a fresh, floral, zesty note with a hint of spice to the fragrance. “The creamy and aromatic palo santo accord combined with the resinous incense-like finish of frankincense, imbues magic energy with fire. “Grounding, energising cypress ultimate connects the fragrance with earth, emitting the delicate, mossy and forest-like aspects of the scent. “Water is represented by the unique and marine-like aspects of seaweed extract, like a splash of energy providing fresh and salty facets to the scent. “Magic Energy is the perfect reawakening and energising scent that transports you to a magical forest! Boost your feelings of grounding energy with the emotion-boosting molecules of magic energy!” Charlotte Tilbury. This is energy in a bottle. Awaken your senses with a boost of grounding energy, powered by energy emotion-boosting molecules - purifying palo santo accord, re-energising bergamot oil and cypress ultimate. listings.rawTitle: Wade Pottery Fish Earthenware Jug, 1.2L, Eau De Nil
listings.description: Add a touch of UK heritage-inspired design to your home with this Fish Jug from Wade. A statement piece, it's handcrafted in the heart of the potteries industry using English earthenware, and it showcases and celebrates exceptional craftsmanship. The 1.2-litre capacity allows you to use it as a water jug or wine carafe at family mealtimes or social gatherings. It's also ideal as an ornament, vase or table centrepiece. The unique gurgle sound has long been a hallmark of the jug, and it will produce the sound when pouring the jug if it's at least three-quarters full. Formed in the shape of a fish, the mouth perfectly aligns to create an easy-pour spout, while the tail curves upward to create an ergonomic handle with a comfortable grip. A great gift for any heritage brand lover and ideal for weddings, birthdays and housewarming parties.

listings.rawTitle: Givenchy	Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême, 200ml
listings.description: Givenchy proudly introduces new Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême for Men, a woody floral spicy fragrance designed for the fearless individuals who set their own standards. Embodying the essence of a modern Gentleman, this Eau de Parfum pushes olfactory boundaries to the extreme with an intense and sophisticated trail. A daring community: There are many ways to be a Gentleman. Join Givenchy’s Gentleman Society with a new masculine Eau de Parfum that gathers a community of thrill-seeking members who strive for excellence, shatter limits, and venture fearlessly into the unknown. Crafted with exceptional raw materials and Givenchy's renowned savoir-faire, this men’s fragrance marks the start of a new olfactory chapter in the Gentleman Society. A powerful and captivating new signature: This new Eau de Parfum reinvents the iconic Gentleman Society signature with a spicy twist, for a magnetic and deeply masculine trail. Top notes of Clary Sage and ice-cold Peppermint contrast with the warm and fiery notes of Nutmeg. The heart reveals the unique Gentleman Society accord, a combination of Narcissus Absolute and Iris Concrete, blended with a Vetiver Quartet. Unexpectedly, Coffee Extract Absolute emerges from this accord, enhanced by Peppermint Essence to reveal its deepest, most intense facets. This deliciously roasted note becomes even more addictive with the unfurling base notes of Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Patchouli Essence, and Vanilla Absolute, leaving a deep and lasting impression. A rallying symbol: Inspired by couture, the iconic Gentleman Society bottle is revisited to highlight the exhilarating facets of the fragrance within. With a deep black lacquer finish, the bottle is adorned with the Givenchy 4G logo in a striking gunmetal finish. An emblem of the Gentleman Society, unmistakably Givenchy. Moreover, the Gentleman Society Eau de Parfum Extrême bottle is made from 15% post-consumer recycled glass. Join the Gentleman Society. It’s not a place, it’s a state of mind. Fragrance family: Woody Floral Spicy. Head notes: Essence of Clary Sage France & Eastern Europe, Essence of Peppermint USA & China, Essence of Nutmeg Indonesia Heart notes: Concrete of Orris France, Absolute of Narcissus France, Absolute of Coffee Extract Ethiopia, Quartet of Vetiver (Madagascar, Uruguay, Haiti) extract Haïti, Essence of vetiver Uruguay, Organic essence of Vetiver Madagascar Base notes: Organic Essence of Cedarwood Himalaya India, Organic Essence of Sandalwood Australia, Absolute of Tasuki Vanilla Madagascar

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Success is not only about pursuing personal ambitions, but also about celebrating peers. From aspirational stardom to relatable fandom, discover how BOSSes get inspired and inspire others. BOSS recognise BOSS. Bradley Cooper, Vinicius Junior, and Maluma embody this spirit of brotherhood as the three global ambassadors of BOSS Bottled Beyond. Spark admiration with BOSS Bottled Beyond, the first premium ginger-leather fragrance where opposites collide in a balanced interplay, delivering long-lasting intensity. The duality of this distinctive Eau de Parfum, echoed with the Double B monogram design, incites double the motivation, double the success. Bold. Balanced. Beyond. In this powerful dual blend, the stimulating freshness of ginger, extracted through cutting-edge technology, meets the carnal sophistication of leather. Playing on a harmonious duality of spices, ginger diffuses the scent’s pure, vibrant profile, while leather exudes sensuality. To shape this new olfactory signature, master perfumers Daphné Bugey, Frank Voelkl, and Bruno Jovanovic have brought their personal best to the collaboration. The lines are blurred between niche craftsmanship and blockbuster allure, creating a balanced, enduring trail. Reinventing an iconic design, the BOSS Bottled Beyond bottle stands out in black lacquered glass, complemented with a double-leather trim and a gunmetal-grey cap. A radiant gradient, from black to smoky grey, completes its masculine aesthetic. An engraved Double B monogram cements the fragrance’s duality. Crafted to Perform. To Go Beyond. BOSS Bottled Beyond is designed to last a lifetime. Its 50ml, 100ml, and 150ml bottles are refillable with the 200ml BOSS Bottled Beyond Eau de Parfum Refill.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Olivier Pescheux, Eros Eau de Parfum expresses sensuality and power, an extreme force that represents a heroic and passionate man, much like Eros, the Greek god whose arrow can make you fall in love. A fragrance with an element of charm that brings love, passion and seduction splendidly to the fore, Eros Eau de Parfum embodies excess and provocation. It has a signature that is not afraid to flaunt itself and reveal its extremes, with a stark contrast between the extremely citrusy and the extremely delicate. Radiant and energetic top notes of Italian lemon and mandarin are paired with mint oil and a unique note of candied apple before giving way to a heart of geranium flower, clary sage essence and Ambermax. In the dry-down, Atlas and Virginia cedarwood, Haitian vetiver, Indonesian patchouli and sandalwood combine with decadent vanilla, a provocative weapon with its intoxicating and creamy effects and Amber character, to round out this Woody-Amber-Fresh Eau de Parfum. The fragrance is also produced in line with vegan principles, containing no intentionally added animal products or animal-derived products such as dairy, eggs, bee products or animal enzymes. Top notes: Italian Lemon, Mandarin, Mint Oil, Candied Apple Heart notes: Geranium Flower, Clary Sage Essence (France), Ambermax® Base notes: Cedarwood Atlas and Virginia, Vetiver Orpur Essence (Haiti), Patchouli Coeur Orpur Essence (Indonesia), Sandalwood, Vanilla

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Fiori di Neroli Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Liquidum stage: Gucci Fiori di Neroli Eau de Parfum. The sparkling soul of a Mediterranean breeze, distilled. Floral, Wood, Sparkling. Fragrance family: Floral, Citrus. Featuring Italian Neroli Essential Oil exclusively sourced with one of the last Neroli producers in Italy. The 7th generation Liguria terroir producer utilizes artisanal in-house distillation to transform the raw ingredient. Steam extracts their essence, transforming it into a precious oil. The Gucci fragrance is grounded with Cedarwood notes and elevated with the green, fresh scent of Petitgrain, showcasing the transformative powers of water and the mastery of the ultimate alchemist’s technique: distillation. The bottle: A gold bottle reminiscent of the golden Neroli Essential Oil extracted through the transformative powers of water. The bottle’s orange blossom bud symbol tells the story of reviving this quintessential Italian tradition. Olfactive alchemists: Gucci olfactive alchemists Mathieu Nardin and Julie Massé separate the essence of Neroli to capture the traditional scent’s golden soul in various ways. How to use: |To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, behind the ears and chest Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other products from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection. There are three recommended layering combinations for Gucci Fiori di Neroli Eau de Parfum: Combined with Vanilla Firenze Eau de Parfum to unveil a zested vanilla, where Neroli, Italian Orris, and Vanilla create a creamy violet citrus For a creamy citrus scent, layer Fiori di Neroli with Osmanthus Nectar Eau de Parfum, as Osmanthus Nectar and Neroli burst with a deliciously fruity trail Enhance Fiori di Neroli by pairing it with Fading Autumn perfumed water and A Nocturnal Whisper perfumed oil, where Neroli, Woods, and Oud whisper between the forests and orchards
