listings.description: The luxury fragrances embody the Atelier Versace absolute dedication to excellence, encompassing a studious approach to exceptional quality components, innovative techniques and hand-craftsmanship. Vanille Rouge encompasses the Madagascar vanilla, adding a hint of pralines. The sweet tones are accompanied by a powdery musk accord. The powerful fragrance contains an unexpected rose note. The perfume boasts a hand-made black glass bottle enriched with the name of the fragrance written in a gold tone. The sculptural bottle is packed into a paper box embellished with a gold-tone Greek Key border painted by hand. The box reveals a mirror that features the Atelier Versace logo painted in a gold tone.

listings.rawTitle: Clinique Happy Heart Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Clinique Happy Heart celebrates the romantic side of happiness in a rich, fresh, floral with a loving, harmonious feel.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Eau de Parfum Naturelle
listings.description: Exuding the modern scent of organic rose, Chloé Eau de Parfum Naturelle is an irresistibly floral perfume for women, connecting the strength and spontaneity of nature with that of the free-spirited Chloé girl. Effortlessly elegant, as well as authentic and aware, she lives in harmony with the natural environment she cherishes and that inspires her. This fresh and feminine Eau de Parfum for women is an eco-conscious perfume rooted in nature for wholesome luxury that resonates with the independent Chloé girl's lifestyle. Spritz on your wrists and neck to reveal a full expression of the graceful strength of nature. Vegan and formulated with 100% natural origin fragrance, the Eau de Parfum is also formulated with ethically sourced ingredients and naturally derived alcohol to envelop you in floral freshness all day long. Each gentle whisper of the emblematic and woody organic rose will remind you of a serene, natural setting that soothes and awakens the spirit. Hand-picked and ethically sourced, organic rose is the hero ingredient of this Eau de Parfum, opening the perfume with an airy and feminine aura complemented by Moroccan neroli. Fresh and delicate cedrat essence mingles with green, sparkling blackcurrant for an assertive spirit, while base notes of cedar essence add a powerful woody facet. Sensual mimosa highlights the scent's round character and elevates the floral heart notes. The eco-designed sunray-pleated glass bottle includes 25% recycled materials and comes in sustainable cardboard packaging made of 40% recycled materials. Inspired by the Maison's iconic crêpe de chine blouse with a feminine necktie, the timeless vintage-inspired bottle is adorned with a 100% recycled hand-tied ribbon in a new, natural shade of green. Refillable option only available on 100ml.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Le Flacon Coeur Eau de Parfum, 20ml
listings.description: Guerlain’s iconic La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum has now inspired a never-seen-before, travel-friendly, refillable bottle: the Flacon Coeur. Its travel-friendly shape makes it easy to slip into your bag and to carry around everywhere, at all times. A new creation that captures the irresistible free spirit of the most Parisian fragrances of the House. Inspired by the inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom and love, the embodiment of elegance and style, an invitation to joie de vivre and irreverence. A characterful sillage in homage to the rose. A tailor-made rose embroidered with the finest black notes in perfumery. Combining rose essence with the tender, naturally honeyed scent of a damascena rose absolute, Guerlain has allowed a new rose to bloom. The distinctive and utterly recognisable rose that is La Petite Robe Noire's signature... Combined with almond, red berries and bergamot notes, black cherry gives La Petite Robe Noire's sillage a gourmand sophistication and an irresistible fruity accent. If the heart shape and design of this new bottle seem instantly familiar, that’s because it follows in the footsteps of another icon in Guerlain’s fragrance heritage: the famous 'inverted heart' bottle. First created in 1912 for L'Heure Bleue and then reissued for La Petite Robe Noire in 2012, this timeless bottle forms the inspiration for this part-classic, part-modern bottle and its innovative new size. How to use: The Flacon Coeur La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom. Specially designed for the House’s iconic women’s scent, this 20ml size heart-shaped bottle is made to be refilled from one of the classic La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum’s bottles. A new gesture, easy to adopt.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Eau de Soleil Blanc Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Ascent to the sun. Eau de Soleil Blanc follows Soleil’s radiant light, a world where sparkling citrus gives way to decadent florals. Step into the sun's golden path with the hypnotic warmth of addictive amber and a luscious coco de mer accord. The fragrance opens with an uplifting rush of citrus fruit, elevated with a savoury pistachio accord and spicy cardamom. A transportive blend of tuberose, ylang ylang and orange blossom with a coco de mer accord brings a balancing warmth. Key notes: Vert de bergamot Orange bitter, Petitgrain bigarade Ylang ylang Pistachio accord Coco de mer accord How to use: On clean skin, spray on or twice on desired areas. Do not rub the fragrance on your skin. This will alter how the fragrance develops.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Gelsomino A Freddo Ambrosia Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Inspired by the mythical elixir of the gods, Gelsomino a Freddo Ambrosia is a fragrance crafted from the ancient technique of cold enfleurage that captures the essence of eternity - an unmistakable composition defined by its intensity and greater concentration. Rich, dense, and vibrantly alive, Gelsomino a Freddo Ambrosia is an exquisite elixir that shimmers like precious jewels, offering an enduring and elevated sillage. Its 30% pure perfume oil concentration results in the fragrance’s expressive projection and long-lasting presence. Part of the woody floral olfactive family, Gelsomino a Freddo Ambrosia opens with a radiant burst of Italian lemon notes, balanced by the warmth of olibanum nuances and the spicy allure of cardamom essences. At its heart lies the refined beauty of jasmine enfleurage extract, enriched by the deep, textured notes of black tea, orris, and myrrh, creating a harmonious interplay of light and shadow. It culminates in a powerful base, where the creamy depth of sandalwood essence meets the earthy elegance of vetiver and cedarwood notes. The composition’s starring jasmine enfleurage essence comes from a precise technique where delicate jasmine flowers are layered onto purified shea butter multiple times under the supervision of a master perfumer, ensuring every nuance of the olfactive molecule is captured, preserving the flower’s natural complexity and richness. The 50ml fragrance is housed in a transparent glass bottle, highlighting the coloured jus with a precious decorated porcelain cap and is presented in the Maison's iconic yellow hatbox. Fragrance notes: Top Notes: Cardamom, Italian Lemon, Olibanum Heart Notes: Jasmine Enfleurage Extract, Black Tea, Orris, Myrrh Base Notes: Sandalwood, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Guaiacwood

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum Refillable 50ml
listings.description: With this third instalment in the H24 line, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel continues her botanical exercise in the footsteps of a modern man on the move. H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum recreates the sensation of rediscovering urban nature after the rain. H24 Herbes Vives Eau de Parfum combines the power of a bouquet of fresh herbs, the texture of a pear granita, and the liveliness of a high-tech molecule, Physcool®. The pure lines of the bottle designed by Philippe Mouquet are adorned with green lacquer to echo the notes of the fragrance. The box is in a deeper shade of grey-green as if traces of plant life had spread through the asphalt of the city. A lime-green line both delineates and opens up the space. The aerodynamic refillable bottle is made from 15% recycled glass. Its box is made from ECF (Elemental Chlorine Free) recycled paper pulp. H24 is the key to a new space. H for Hermès, Homme, and Hours. 24 to express a relationship with time and a link to the house’s iconic home of 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.description: Rose Milano is a haute couture unisex fragrance imagined by Giorgio Armani as a tribute to Milan, a city that is more than an emblem of fashion, it is home to the fashion of Giorgio Armani. Through this signature scent, he wanted to encapsulate his vision of the Milanese elegance, both raw and refined. Giorgio Armani reinterpreted the rose with citrusy and juicy notes of Primofiore lemon, enlightening a majestic Damascena rose, while earthy notes of a modern patchouli turn the juice into an iconic and elegant chypre accord. The new fragrance is encapsulated in the iconic Armani/ Privé squared bottle, which unveils a more modern and luminous look for the whole "Les Eaux" collection. A black shiny lacquered cap, creating contrasts between its curves and the sleekness of the squared bottle. Between modernity and timelessness, an interpretation of chypre in a new freshness, almost like the dew infused by rose petals that gives the juice an understated rosewood colour. Key notes: Damascena Rose Absolute Fragrance family: Chypre floral How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden A Midnight Stroll Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Gucci fragrances opens a new story of magic and imagination in Luxury Collection: The Alchemist’s Garden. The singular unisex fragrances in The Alchemist's collection of Eau de Parfum, Acqua Profumata and oils become customisable and transformative when layered in a multitude of perfume combinations to construct a special enticing scent that stays with you all day—the amount the perfume lingers in the air when it is worn. "The oils and Acqua Profumata create mesmerising individual statements. Personalise your beloved scent with a captivating oil or a floral water to build a unique scent. Each oil or floral water of the collection can be layered with each eau de parfum. Just play with the scent to find your favourite, as an alchemist would work to find the gold formula," says Alberto Morillas. The scent: Evoking the resinous profile of Incense, A Midnight Stroll is an homage to the allure of night-time. Epitomised by a jaguar, an animal of unerring strength, the elegant creature is imagined to capture the essence of the scent’s mystery. With its combination of aromatic Incense fragrance and intense, smoky Cade Wood, the solitary jaguar moves under the cloak of darkness, as fresh Cypress channels this expression of vitality. The bottle: The design of each Eau de Parfum bottle is inspired by the bottles found on wooden shelves of a vintage apothecary, curious pharmacy jars and the first perfumery containers. Gold lettering, decoration and secret symbols appear on the Eau de Parfum, contained in lacquered Gucci fragrance glass bottles with stoppers - covetable objects for lovers of mystery. How to use: Each Perfumed Oil and Acqua Profumata in The Alchemist's collection can be layered with each Eau de Parfum: experiment with combinations to build a unique scent of your beloved scent. Bottling the essence of nature into sublime distillations, the customisable compositions are designed to be layered together, each building from a hero ingredient that shifts and magnifies its character when paired with other Gucci fragrances. The beauty of alchemy is in the transformation: layered scents that become new expressions of art and unfold the magic of unseen worlds. Layer pure and highly concentrated perfumed oils with the Eaux de Parfum to intensify its strength and richness: Apply your choice of The Alchemist Perfumed Oil first on the wrist and neck Follow with your Eau de Parfum layered on top The Acqua Profumata can be applied over the Eau de Parfum to recharge top notes and refresh the overall impression of your signature scent A recommended layer combination for A Midnight Stroll perfume, designed to bring out the different facets of its enticing woody ambery scent: Fold yourself into the darkness of A Midnight Stroll Gucci perfume with voluptuous perfumed oil A Nocturnal Whisper. The pair brings out the deep, smoky incense fragrance—a precious, rare experience Finish with a touch of Acqua Profumata A Winter Melody for an aromatic, strong finish

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Habit Rouge Le Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Synonymous with strength, strongly concentrated parfum offers the boldest expression of a fragrance. To reinterpret Habit Rouge’s iconic amber fragrance, Guerlain’s perfumers have turned to the world of spirits as an inspiration. Drawing upon the emblematic notes and the spellbinding yet bold aesthetic of this world that shares so much with perfumery, this spray fragrance is crafted from an exceptional selection of highly concentrated ingredients to create a scent of unparalleled seduction. Legendary, intense, passionate. As the first amber fragrance to be created for men, Habit Rouge was inspired by equestrianism, the pastime that was dear to its creator, Jean-Paul Guerlain. First released in 1965, Habit Rouge’s woody, spicy fragrance enveloped with round vanilla became an olfactory symbol of French elegance. Taking its inspiration from the bold intensity of bourbon, Habit Rouge Le Parfum opens with the rich tonalities of a rum accord, followed perfectly with Guerlain’s unique vanilla tincture that is made according to its own special in-house process. Set alongside patchouli, it’s this vanilla tincture that lends Habit Rouge’s signature its unparalleled depth. A square, faceted, streamlined bottle. Maintaining the same strong and sleek lines of its Guerlain heritage, Habit Rouge Le Parfum’s bottle takes on a bolder look with a darker red label that reflects the power and concentration of the bewitching fragrance. With a nod to the world of watchmaking, the heavy matte cap features a guilloche pattern.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Après L'Ondée Eau de Toilette, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Après L'Ondée is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Created by Jacques Guerlain in 1906, Après L'Ondée is a celebration of the sunshine after the rain. In this bouquet of powdery flowers, Jacques Guerlain orchestrated its floral note around violet, iris and vanilla nuances. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: AERIN Amber Musk Pistache Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Amber Musk Pistache is a rich gourmand fragrance with notes of Pistachio Cream, warm Amber, and rich Vanilla. Indulge in a world of sweet and nostalgic delicacies. The fragrance is inspired by the elegant and charming atmosphere of an artisanal pastry shop where the scent of creamy confections, marzipan, and soft florals fills the air. The fragrance opens with a delightful contrast as notes of Pistachio cream melt into the soft, floral aroma of Almond Blossoms. Rich notes of Vanilla fold into the signature scent of golden Amber for an added dimension of velvety warmth. Rose Centifolia and Sandalwood notes add a sophisticated touch to this decadent indulgence. "My new Amber Musk Pistache is a warm and indulgent interpretation of my best-selling fragrance, Amber Musk. It is inspired by the comforting aromas that fill the air in an artisanal pastry shop. The scent blends notes of Pistachio cream, soft florals, and golden Amber to create a nostalgic yet elegant fragrance." Aerin Lauder, Founder and Creative Director, AERIN. Fragrance type: Amber Gourmand. Fragrance family: Warm Spicy. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Rose Centifolia, Coconut, Almond Blossom Middle notes: Pistachio Cream Accord, Tonka Bean Base notes: Amber, Vanilla, Sandalwood The bottle: The Amber Musk Pistache packaging design takes inspiration from the original Amber Musk, re-interpreted to reflect the gourmand and indulgent notes of this pistachio-inspired fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum for Her, 60ml
listings.description: Guilty Elixirs de Parfum are a daring assertion, a colourful extraversion. Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum for women is an ambery floral fragrance. An enticing scent featuring a sensual vanilla and tonka base, a floral wisteria heart, and a citric mandora and bergamot top note. Extending a loving invitation to explore, create and connect with our truest selves. An ode to self-acceptance, friendship and love in all its forms. An intense fragrance for an intense connection, Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum is an ambery floral woody fragrance for women. Guilty Elixirs are a daring assertion, a colourful extraversion: sensual and provocative scents that extend a loving invitation to accept who we are and let our authentic selves be seen while celebrating the countless iterations of love. Perfumers Quentin Bisch and Nathalie Cetto embued this Gucci fragrance with a sensual and mysterious base of vanilla absolute aroused by dark tonka beans, complemented by Gucci Guilty's signature of earthy patchouli, mandora, and floral and feminine wisteria. The fragrance for women is rounded off by a top note of citric bergamot which is beautifully balanced by rose, osmanthus and a sweet and soft violet accord. This Gucci scent is contained within an opulent purple glass bottle, a romantic reminder of feminine power and a reflection of the intense fragrance that lies within. The bottle of this beautiful fragrance unexpectedly plays with transparencies and features a debossed interlocking GG logo: precious ingredients concentrated in a flask. How to use: Spritz this intense women's fragrance on pulse points at the neck and wrists for a seductive fragrance that lasts all day long. Follow the steps below for the ultimate Gucci beauty routine: Add a pop of colour to your lips with the Gucci Rouge à Levres Mat matte lipstick in the classic shade Goldie Red Finish off the routine by spraying the Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum on pulse points

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Un Jardin en Méditerranée Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Created in 2003, Un Jardin en Méditerranée Eau de Toilette was the very first Parfum-Jardin. Designed by Jean-Claude Ellena, it evokes a stroll in a secret garden in Tunisia, exuberantly overflowing with trees and flowers. A fruity, woody fragrance, Un Jardin en Méditerranée Eau de Toilette mingles sweet fig tree with the notes of green lentisk and delicate oleander. The bottle echoes the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages and was created by Fred Rawyler. The glass features delicately graduated shades of blue, evoking the shifting reflections of the Mediterranean. The box is illustrated with the hues of South of France by artist Aurore de la Morinerie. The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the Hermès annual theme. They are olfactory strolls to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Layton Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Layton is a fragrance which captures the essence of the debonair. This seductive Amber and floral fragrance with an intense olfactory signature opens with bergamot and its tangy passion, while lavender and geranium blend into a fresh note, chic and chivalrous all at once. The intensity of the Eau de Parfum is further amplified by amber, enhanced by the natural elegance of pink pepper. Distinguished and addictive, Layton's character is further carried by vanilla and precious woods, which develop through an intriguing note of caramelised coffee. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Apple, Bergamot, Lavender Heart notes: Jasmine, Violet, Geranium Base notes: Vanilla, Pepper, Guaiac Wood, Patchouli Layton is unforgettable thanks to its addictive presence and unique appeal. It is for the gentleman who is looking for an exhilarating fragrance that fits within the great lineage of Parfums de Marly. Its bottle features the brand's equestrian cabinets, embossed on the solid and opaque glass. The captivating refinement of the fragrance establishes itself with grace. Proud and velvety, like the night blue matte of its bottle, Layton radiates with a fragrant, sensual and mighty olfactory narrative.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Mojave Ghost Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Mojave Ghost is a woody composition inspired by the soulful beauty of the Mojave Desert. In this xeric wilderness, rare are the plants that dare to blossom. With a light and graceful character, top notes of musky Ambrette combine with fresh Jamaican Nesberry. Powdery Violet then unfurls to reveal Sandalwood. Finally, warm Chantilly Musk rounds out a base of crisp Amber and Cedar wood, leaving the raw spirit of Mojave Ghost to linger on the skin. Woody Genderless Medium Intensity Notes: Top: Ambrette, Nesberry Heart: Magnolia, Sandalwood, Violet Base: Cedarwood, Musks, Vetiver How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Paris-Venise Les Eaux de CHANEL – Eau de Toilette Spray 50ml
listings.description: A fresh, Amber trail inspired by the exotic and enchanting city of Venice, one of Gabrielle Chanel's favourite places. A composition of shadow and light, between freshness and sensuality. 1920. Venice was a revelation for Gabrielle Chanel. It changed her life. Shattered by the death of her lover Boy Capel, she drew strength from the bustling energy of this richly contrasted city and its mix of people and influences from around the world. There, she discovered a taste for the treasures of Byzantine and Baroque art that caught her eye and became a major source of inspiration for her style. PARIS-VENISE evokes this legendary, captivating city that marks the boundary between East and West.An eau de toilette with a sensual structure. The beautiful contrast between the fresh and luminous neroli essence and the enveloping warmth of an ambery vanilla and tonka accord. A light bottle with a rounded shape that fits in the palm of the hand. A sleek sleeve designed with natural materials that evoke the waves lapping on the beach. LES EAUX DE CHANEL are available in a large misting spray bottle for full and generous perfuming. With a single spray, LES EAUX DE CHANEL fragrances create a feeling of freshness so vivid it takes you on a journey.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Sauvage Parfum Refill, 300ml
listings.description: Discover the Sauvage Parfum 300ml refill. The 100ml Sauvage Parfum bottle, now refillable, is part of the House of DIOR's eco-design initiative. The 300ml refill makes it easy for you to reuse your Sauvage Parfum bottle at home. Thanks to the auto-stop system, the refilling process stops automatically when the bottle is full. The Sauvage Parfum refill is made of recycled aluminium. Using the refill reduces our environmental footprint: 60%* less energy consumption 53%* less water 60%* less greenhouse gas production 62%* less waste The 300ml refill can only be used to refill a 100ml bottle and cannot be used alone. *Use of a 100ml Sauvage Parfum bottle + a 300ml Sauvage refill, compared to four 100 ml Sauvage Parfum bottles. Life cycle analysis in compliance with ISO14040 and ISO14044 standards.

listings.description: The first essential skincare step, Eau de Beauté from Guerlain, concentrates all the effectiveness of a make-up remover, cleanser and toner for quick and effective cleansing in just one step. This unique, almost gel-like liquid is applied with a cotton pad to refresh the skin like beneficial dew. Its micelles – surfactant molecules – gently cleanse and trap the slightest impurity and every last trace of make-up on the face and eyes, while toning the skin. Gentle, pure and incredibly fresh, skin is hydrated and plumped up in a single step. The exclusive signature fragrance developed for Eau de Beauté enfolds the skin in a delicate scent blending the purity of white tea, the comforting freshness of musky notes and a touch of jasmine

listings.rawTitle: Maison Crivelli Cuir InfraRouge Extrait de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Maison Crivelli presents its seventh extrait de parfum, Cuir InfraRouge, developed in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez. For this new opus, Thibaud Crivelli was inspired by the taste of a raspberry cocktail while attending an electronic music festival. "With Cuir InfraRouge, my intention was to bring back to life fun memories, when I attended music festivals while sipping raspberry cocktails, which are among my favourites. This creation is a delight. It sees an incredible contrast between a young, vibrant, luminous and nearly fluorescent raspberry accord on one side, and a deep, comforting and sophisticated leather accord on the other. I find Cuir InfraRouge to be an unprecedented take on leather, the one I had always dreamt of creating." Thibaud Crivelli’s vivid experience is the inspiration for Cuir InfraRouge extrait de parfum, a supple leather illuminated by a fluorescent raspberry. This vibrant contrast sets the tone from the very first notes, an invigorating cocktail blending a raspberry accord and fresh, juicy citruses. The heart sees cedarwood coupled with the powdery notes of orris and cinnamon, while osmanthus brings leather and apricot tones. The drydown is built on a beautiful combination of leather suede accord, oud and patchouli. Vanilla prolongs the elegance of the creation with its addictive and intoxicating warmth. Maison Crivelli was created with the aim of surprising people with gender-neutral, daring olfactory creations that defy conventions and stand out from the classics. Each fragrance in the collection encapsulates adventures experienced by the brand's founder, Thibaud Crivelli. Scents, colours, sounds and textures intermingle to capture the essence of surprise, a challenge to the ordinary and an invitation to explore new sensory frontiers.

listings.description: Maison Crivelli presents its seventh extrait de parfum, Cuir InfraRouge, developed in collaboration with perfumer Jordi Fernandez. "With Cuir InfraRouge, my intention was to bring back to life fun memories, when I attended music festivals while sipping raspberry cocktails, which are among my favourites. This creation is a delight. It sees an incredible contrast between a young, vibrant, luminous and nearly fluorescent raspberry accord on one side, and a deep, comforting and sophisticated leather accord on the other. I find Cuir InfraRouge to be an unprecedented take on leather, the one I had always dreamt of creating." Thibaud Crivelli’s vivid experience is the inspiration for Cuir InfraRouge extrait de parfum, a supple leather illuminated by a fluorescent raspberry. This vibrant contrast sets the tone from the very first notes, an invigorating cocktail blending a raspberry accord and fresh, juicy citruses. The heart sees cedarwood coupled with the powdery notes of orris and cinnamon, while osmanthus brings leather and apricot tones. The drydown is built on a beautiful combination of leather suede accord, oud and patchouli. Vanilla prolongs the elegance of the creation with its addictive and intoxicating warmth. Maison Crivelli was created with the aim of surprising people with gender-neutral, daring olfactory creations that defy conventions and stand out from the classics. Each fragrance in the collection encapsulates adventures experienced by the brand's founder, Thibaud Crivelli. Scents, colours, sounds and textures intermingle to capture the essence of surprise, a challenge to the ordinary and an invitation to explore new sensory frontiers.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Vétiver Le Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Synonymous with strength, strongly concentrated parfum offers the boldest expression of a fragrance. To reinterpret Vétiver’s iconic fragrance, Guerlain’s perfumers have turned to the world of spirits as an inspiration. Drawing upon the emblematic notes and the spellbinding yet bold aesthetic of this world that shares so much with perfumery, this spray fragrance is crafted from an exceptional selection of highly concentrated ingredients, to create a scent of unparalleled seduction. Noble. powerful, intense. Composed much like a gin, Vétiver Le Parfum opens with slightly bitter, aromatic notes of juniper berry. Invigorating and energising, an exceptional vetiver essence follows, revealing its freshest facets. Distilled from vetiver roots, this noble ingredient showcases the full depth of vetiver’s woody tones. Blended with captivating smoky notes and the addictive Tonka bean, beloved by Guerlain, the result is a fragrance that reveals a sublime balance of brightness and earthiness, power and elegance. A square, faceted, streamlined bottle. Maintaining the same strong and sleek lines of its Guerlain heritage, Vétiver Le Parfum’s bottle takes on a bolder look with a darker green label that reflects the power and concentration of the bewitching fragrance. With a nod to the world of watchmaking, the heavy matte cap features a guilloche pattern.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Bleu Noir Parfum 50ml
listings.description: For Him Bleu Noir Parfum is a new creation for a man who defines his own singularity. Mysterious and audacious, this new bleu noir fragrance revisits masculine elegance by exploring a new complementary universe within the for him franchise. Bleu Noir Parfum embodies a warm, amber, and utterly addictive fragrance. In this new fragrance, suede leather is enhanced by the sensuality of iris and sweetened by the addiction of tonka. The heart of musk, the brand's signature, evokes the sensuality and luxuriousness of Bleu Noir which is truly unforgettable. Regarding the design, for the first time, the iconic bottle of bleu noir is unveiled without interior lacquering, revealing an elegant blue hue with a translucent black outer lacquering. Lastly, a matte navy cap brings the final touch of sensuality. An iconic design that expresses mystery and intensity.

listings.rawTitle: LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir Eau de Parfum for women reinterprets the original fragrance with a higher, more resonant concentration of essential oils. As a standout in the LOEWE Botanical Rainbow Elixir collection, this floral perfume is inspired by the pure and fresh air all around us, uplifting, elemental, and life-giving. It captures a sense of freedom, resilience, and vitality in a scent that is both delicate and profound. The fragrance is characterised by a floral, fruity, and musky notes profile that opens with a vibrant, crisp blend of cassis, bergamot, lemon, and pear. As the scent develops, a refined heart of orange flower, magnolia, jasmine sambac, peony, and muguet emerges. This complex women's perfume is anchored by a deep, earthy base of vetiver, sandalwood, and musks, all enriched by the raw and authentic LOEWE Accord, an exclusive note created by our perfumer and centred on the resinous Spanish Rockrose wildflower that defines the brand's olfactory DNA. The LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir experience is housed in the signature block-shaped glass flask, featuring a beautiful leaf-green gradient and topped with a tactile wenge wooden cap that echoes the natural inspiration of the scent. Whether you seek a perfume with sandalwood and musk for depth, or a fruity perfume with pear and magnolia for freshness, the LOEWE Aire Sutileza Elixir EDP provides a resonant, long-lasting, and authentic sensory journey of the LOEWE DNA.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Eau de Parfum For Women 30ml
listings.description: Escape into a joy-fuelled fantasy land with Gucci Flora. Evolving into a delicious Eau de Parfum fragrance, floral yet delicately sweet, Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia relaunches in a campaign filled with flowers and fluffy animals. A signature floral scent for all free-spirited women full of positive energy. This perfume for women is built around the Gardenia flower, admired since the dawn of time for its splendour and said to be used in elixirs and magical potions. Taking inspiration from this legend and the idea of its mystical power, the gorgeous White Gardenia note is blended with solar Jasmine Grandiflorum absolute. This delicious potion of joy is introduced by a cheerful Pear Blossom accord while a touch of Brown Sugar accord adds a delicate sweetness to its scent trail. Encased within a new, elongated bottle, the lacquered pink glass and shiny gold cap make it an object of beauty. One notable addition is the House’s distinctive Flora pattern, reimagined with a design inspired by Alessandro Michele’s vision. A core part of the Gucci identity, the motif is a painting of colourful flowers by artist Vittorio Accornero, created for Gucci in 1966. Directed and shot by artist Petra Collins and fronted by artist, actor, trailblazer and philanthropist Miley Cyrus, The #FloraFantasy campaign is a journey through a candy pink world, inspired by Japanese anime and filled with pop references where more is more. "The Flora Gorgeous Gardenia campaign is a challenge to reinterpret the world of flowers in an unexpected way. The inspiration comes from Miley Cyrus, an artist with a spirit that is both rock ‘n’ roll and eclectic at the same time... Because who says that someone with a rock ‘n’ roll attitude can’t live in a world of flowers and embody the Flora universe?" Alessandro Michele.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci Guilty Eau de Parfum For Her 30ml
listings.description: The new chapter of Gucci Guilty signature fragrances revels in the notion of women who are truly liberated. A modern declaration of self-expression and fearlessness burns brightly in the new powerful statement #ForeverGuilty. Blended for the new revolution, the Gucci Guilty for her scent is reborn, an Amber Floral that brings richness and nobility to the original eau de toilette. Superior floral notes and enhanced natural fragrances flourish into a strong and refined eau de parfum. The perfume is intensified, with a higher perfume concentrated than the classic eau de toilette, radiating with commanding ingredients Mandora, Pink Pepper, Lilac and Patchouli. Opening in the mood of the scent’s message, a top note experience is redolent with the citrus notes of Mandora - a fruit found in the Mediterranean island of Cyprus smoothed out with natural Bergamot and Pink Pepper. The heart defines the scent’s new complexity. Lilac is contrasted with rosy and violet notes and layered with Geranium Oil to create a nuanced and individual floral blend. Defining the scent: a deep natural duet of Patchouli Oils; Patchouli Coeur and Patchouli oil Micro-Distillation combined with Ambery notes, which leave an enduring silage - the time the perfume’s fragrance lingers in the air when worn.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Kalan Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Intense and subtle at once, Kalan is an olfactory signature that surprises with a sparkling opening, blending black pepper and spices with fresh notes of blood orange. The Parfums de Marly Eau de Parfum is anchored with a heart of orange blossom and lavender, and while it evolves, facets of white sandalwood unfold and drape into notes of moss and precious wood. The result is an olfactory narrative that is round with clear, seductive top notes and simultaneously an immediately discernible base. The harmony between the materials and the accords creates this olfactory music that is the signature of Kalan. Olfactive notes: Top notes: Blood Orange, Black Pepper, Spices Heart notes: Lavender, Solar notes, Orange Blossom Absolute Base notes: Precious Wood, Oakmoss, White Sandalwood Revolutionary in its aesthetic, fluctuating between shadow and light and rebelling against current fragrance trends, Kalan is a unique creation that resides on the margins of the olfactory family, a revisited Fougere. Captivating luxury in its gleaming ardent red attire, this contemporary Parfums de Marly eau de parfum is a best seller and made for the lover of rare materials and ultimate exhilaration.

It's the ultimate expression of victory, never stop winning. The fragrance: The quintessence of Invictus Victory. A precious ambery woody and spicy elixir blending high-impact. listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's Quercus Eau de Cologne, 100ml
listings.description: A cologne of some sophistication, named for the iconic English oak. Basil and lemon as fresh as a mountain stream, sweet jasmine, and a woody, mossy depth that brings one happily back to earth. Key notes: mandarin, lily Of The Valley, oakmoss. "Quercus is a joyful burst of citrus and basil, supported by jasmine, cardamom, lily and amber. These are warmed through with moss and patchouli to create an elegant, transparent and uplifting cologne."

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM IN RED Parfum Elixir 50ml
listings.description: For nearly six decades, Rabanne has been a pioneering force. Renowned for its avant–garde fashion and audacious fragrances, it continually challenges conventions and pushes the limits of radical self–expression. Disruptive. Empowering. Cutting edge. The Maison continues that legacy, trailblazing a new era in beauty. Created to define a new world order for a defiantly rebellious tribe, Rabanne Beauty inspires new generations to push the limits of creativity. From Fashion to Beauty, from Paris to the world, it addresses those who dare to express who they are. If love is a game, he breaks all the rules. Rabanne’s irresistible night owl with a rock and roll soul returns to rule the city of love – but this time, he’s truly, madly in love. With PHANTOM IN RED Parfum Elixir, PHANTOM’s signature lavender is reinvented in a potent, masculine, amber aromatic woody fragrance. Made for men who are born to stand out, PHANTOM IN RED forms the ultimate power couple with FAME IN LOVE Parfum Elixir. Inspired by love, PHANTOM IN RED’s addictive lavender is turned into a potent elixir by the ambery woody inflexions of smoky benzoin and sensual saffron.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Him Musc Santal Eau de Parfum Intense 50ml
listings.description: The For Him collection by Narciso Rodriguez is a tribute to the strength of modern masculinity, in all its duality. For Him Musc Santal Eau de Parfum Intense reveals a new intensified masculinity, in a story of contrasts where assertive self-confidence meets sensitive authenticity, for the man who attracts with his natural charm. An understated force, with a powerful aura. Working alongside Narciso Rodriguez, renowned perfumer Florian Gallo has crafted a woody musky perfume for men, composed around the magnetic sensuality of musk. This vegan fragrance opens with the clear freshness of clary sage and juniper top notes. At the core, the powerful character of the Narciso Rodriguez heart of musc signature reveals its paradoxical nature: clean yet animalic, pure yet mysterious. At the base, woody notes of cedarwood and sandalwood create extra contrast. A perfume that juxtaposes the duality of warm and cold to create an addictively seductive tension. A design contrasting cool grey with warm wood: For this masculine perfume, the geometric bottle is infused with the subtle strength of frosted grey, and the cap is crafted from natural wood. The outer box features a textured wood-grain effect.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: Like the cut of a dress, this fragrance is shaped with all of Guerlains’ finesse. Its simple signature enhances and romances several exceptional materials in a bold overdose. Black cherry blinks the first wink. It is illustrated by a clever blend that extends exquisite almond and delicious berries. The second wink takes place as rose enters the stage. Finally, the shadowy temptations of licorice and smoky black tea reveal more of me and lead to irresistible seduction. For the ultimate temptation, the entire creation is wrapped in Guerlinade. Fresh, enigmatic and exhilarating… Mischievous and captivating… I am the warm spark beneath the sweetness. I am absolutely essential and utterly irresistible. I am the chic and very seductive, perfumed creation by Guerlain.

listings.rawTitle: Charlotte Tilbury Love Frequency Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: “A flash of addictive pink pepper, rose ultimate and spicy, sultry saffron feels like a warm embrace that attracts the purest love to you and everyone around you! “Blended with sensual musks, alluring ambery woods and intoxicating patchouli heart, it elicits feelings of love to make your heart dance, leaving a love scent trail in its path that lasts up to 18 hours! “Love Frequency wholly encapsulates the encounter of the romantic rose, queen of the flowers, dancing in perfect harmony with the euphoric and spicy facets of pink pepper! “A vibrant union between bold patchouli, sensual woody notes, and velvety addictive musks, Love Frequency is the alluring and perfect scent of eternal and all-encompassing love. Boost your feelings of love with the emotion-boosting molecules of love frequency!” Charlotte Tilbury. This is a love portal in a bottle. Discover Charlotte’s vision of a modern rose, the flower of love! Powered by love emotion-boosting molecules, hypnotic rose essential and warm cashmere wood, that bathe you in the glow of love. Floral, soft and delicately hypnotic, this enchanting fragrance radiates love. It’s that all-encompassing, comforting feeling of being in love and being loved. How does Love Frequency enhance feelings of love? Charlotte had a specific vision in mind - working with scientist Céline Manetta at IFF, the IFF Scentcube™ algorithm was able to identify the perfect combination of notes to create a fragrance that helps boost feelings of universal love - from friendship to romance to familial love and self-love. Love Frequency emanates that all-encompassing feeling of being loved and being in love. 84% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of love 82% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of romance 81% agree the fragrance enhances feelings of inner love *Tested on 104 people over 1 week. Emotion-boosting molecules: Hypnotic rose essential Warm cashmere wood Olfactive family: Floral Woody. Magic fragrance notes: Top notes: Addictive Pink Pepper Heart notes: Sultry Saffron, Romantic Rose Ultimate Extract, Hypnotic Rose Essential Base notes: Sensual Musk, Warm Cashmere Wood, Captivating Ambery Woods, Intoxicating Patchouli Heart

listings.description: Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense embodies bold femininity. Its olfactory signature plays with refined contrasts, blending the power of intense and radiant notes with the softness of gentler accents, creating a sophisticated and elegant composition that leaves a lasting impression. The design: The design of the Dolce & Gabbana The One Eau de Parfum Intense bottle reinterprets the essential lines of the original The One, revealing its rich amber tones and enveloping essence. The fragrance was created by Quentin Bisch exclusively for Dolce & Gabbana. Fragrance notes: Top notes: A vibrant touch of Pink Pepper opens the composition with a multifaceted, energising, and unexpected Heart notes: At the heart, Jasmine unveils a luminous floral sensuality - elegant and magnetic Base notes: In the base, creamy Vanilla blends with warm, ambery accords, leaving a rich and lasting trail on the skin

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Mandarine Basilic Forte Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Mandarine Basilic Forte, a golden mandarin paired with vibrant basil, beautifully enhanced by the warmth of sandalwood and the delicious vanilla tincture. Aqua Allegoria Forte, a warm and enveloping journey to the heart of the world’s wonders: Eaux de Parfum celebrating the intense beauty of nature, revealed by the golden rays of a setting sun. Create your own olfactory signature by pairing Mandarine Basilic Forte with Nerolia Vetiver, Bergamote Calabria, Rosa Rossa, Nettare Di Sole or Flora Cherrysia. Select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Pure Musc Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: A supremely addictive scent, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum teases the senses and envelops the body. It is a provocative play on purity. Worn alone, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum is pure addiction. When layered with other For Her fragrances, For Her PURE MUSC Eau de Parfum is more personal and most memorable. The Fragrance: Narciso Rodriguez’s signature musc is reinterpreted and refined with a disarming purity and a rich depth. With For Her PURE MUSC, the sublime heart of musc is enhanced with a white floral bouquet. Cashmeran added to the base lends warmth to the perfume. Witness a fragrance that maintains a sophisticated delicateness amidst all of its strength. The Bottle: The black and white bottle echoes the exquisite artistry and beauty of the fragrance within. The frosted white lacquer against a strong black cap continues its story of strength mixed with softness. Olfactory Family: Musky Chypre. Top Notes: Jasmin and Orange Blossom Heart Notes: Heart of Musc Base Notes: Cashmeran, Amber and Patchouli The Fragrance Ritual: Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her Eau de Parfum. Live an addiction of musc and peach to feel seductive Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her Eau de Toilette. Live an addiction of musk and white flowers to feel sophisticated Combine For Her PURE MUSC with For Her fleur musc. Live an addiction of musk and spicy rose to feel daring

listings.rawTitle: Sisley-Paris L'Eau Rêvée d'Eliya Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Dreams inspire our creativity, they nourish us with images, memories and sensations. Les Eaux Rêvées express this imaginary place where inspirations collide, join together and become one – the inspirations of different generations of the d’Ornano family, the creators of Sisley. This collection is made up of six mixed fragrances, olfactory odes with a perfect, ambivalent nature. A tropical bouquet after the rain: L’Eau Rêvée d’Eliya revisits a tropical forest and imagines a utopian jungle, vibrant after the rain: a new and innocent garden, filled with mythical birds and unknown sounds. Its atmosphere intriguing, warm and perfumed, is the starting point for a radiant juice combining exotic flowers with tuberose and violet. Designed in collaboration with two artists, Elżbieta Radziwiłł et Bronisław Krzysztof, L'Eau Rêvée d'Eliya transports us into the world of unknown, distant and mysterious dreams. Canson paper case and glass bottle made in France. Case and bottle are recyclable. Top notes: Bergamot, Lemon, Exotic Flowers accord Middle notes: Tuberose, Violet, Jasmin Base notes: Amber, Cedarwood, Patchouli

listings.rawTitle: Hermès H24 Eau de Parfum Natural Spray, Refillable 50ml
listings.description: Created by Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel, H24 Eau de Parfum reveals a new energy that is characterised by its intensity. A woody aromatic, H24 Eau de Parfum unfurls the rich, botanical power of enveloping sage, the density of high-tech moss and the warm vibrancy of sclarene. To echo the fragrance’s olfactory notes, the bottle with its aerodynamic lines designed by Philippe Mouquet is adorned with moss-green lacquer. The intense grey of the box is defined by a fine lime-green line that opens up the space. The bottle is refillable and made from recycled glass. The box is made entirely of untreated paper and is also composed of recycled fibres. H24 opens up a new space. H for Hermès, Homme and Hours. 24 to evoke a relationship with time and a link to the house’s flagship address of 24 rue du Faubourg Saint-Honoré.

listings.description: The Suede Vanilla home fragrance from our Private Collection has a warm and aromatic scent of fresh sage, soothing vanilla, and creamy sandalwood, filling any room with a sense of serenity. Beautifully presented in a reusable glass bottle, specially designed to complement our scented candles and reed diffusers. How to use: Diffuse a few sprays in the air and enjoy a delightful fragrance. When the bottle is empty, simply refill it with your favourite home fragrance refill.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: The Mon Guerlain fragrances are a fragrant manifesto of today's femininity. A multi-faceted woman: strong, free and sensual. Discover Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet, a smiling fruity fresh amber. The fragrance impression of a radiant personality. A fragrance faceted like a jewel, which revisits Mon Guerlain’s essential ingredients in a fruity and intensely luminous register. The essential lavender-vanilla duo is beautifully enhanced by a sparkling pear note and a luminous Sambac jasmine. A captivating fruity fresh amber sillage with a magnetic charm. "It’s a pear-lavender sorbet which melts onto burnt vanilla." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfumer. The 'quadrilobe' bottle, created in 1908, established itself as one of Guerlain’s iconic bottles. Simple and graphic, it echoes an alchemist’s bottle and owes its name 'quadrilobe' to its stopper, which is formed from one piece to obtain a shape resembling four lobes. One century later, beautifully enhanced by a luxurious glass weight and a golden adornment, this bottle offers a contrast between strong taut lines and sensual curves, expressing contemporary femininity. How to use: Spray Mon Guerlain Sparkling Bouquet on pulse points.

listings.rawTitle: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette, 90ml
listings.description: A vibrant, fresh, floral scent from the glamorous Italian fashion house. Bright Crystal is bursting with juicy notes of pomegranate, pretty magnolia, peony and lotus flowers with amber and musk.

listings.rawTitle: Fresh Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum
listings.description: A woody blend of earthy cannabis and patchouli. Let a seductive memory linger with our woody fragrance Cannabis Santal Eau de Parfum, featuring sensual notes of earthy cannabis, patchouli, and vetiver. This intoxicating, forbidden fragrance is enclosed in an apothecary-style glass bottle. The smell of smoky woods and sensual patchouli still lingers in the air, transporting you back to the night before. A seductive cannabis accord sprinkled with the rind of an orange has become your obsession. Lev Glazman, Fresh co-founder. Fragrance notes: Top: Plum, Bergamot, Italian Orange Middle: Patchouli, Earthy cannabis, Rose Bottom: Vanilla, Musk, Dark Chocolate, Vetiver How to use: Spray on the inside of your wrists, the back of your neck, below the centre collarbone, or on either side of your shoulders. When layered with another fresh fragrance, alternate the location of each scent.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum intensifies the radiance of the three auras found in this woody, ambery floral perfume, without betraying the original inspiration of the eau de parfum. The perfumer’s mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody perfume extract, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Grandiflorum jasmine perfume creates head notes that gently underscores the craftsman’s voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with a musky and woody accord. Adding to the intensity of this bouquet perfume, the bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian Extrait de Parfum embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time. Olfactory family: woody ambery floral. Top notes: Grandiflorum jasmine, Saffron Heart notes: Bitter almond, Cedarwood Base notes: Musky woody accord, Ambergris accord

The perfumer’s mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody perfume extract, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Grandiflorum jasmine perfume creates head notes that gently underscores the craftsman’s voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with a musky and woody accord. Adding to the intensity of this bouquet perfume, the bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian Extrait de Parfum embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time. Olfactory family: woody ambery floral. Top notes: Grandiflorum jasmine, Saffron Heart notes: Bitter almond, Cedarwood Base notes: Musky woody accord, Ambergris accord

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau d'Orange Verte Cologne, 50ml
listings.description: Hermès' first cologne: the bright and green freshness of orange combined with woody undertones. The founding cologne, created by Françoise Caron in 1979 and inspired by the smell of undergrowth moist with morning dew, Eau d'Orange Verte has since asserted itself as an emblem of Hermès, standing out by its distinctive freshness. Conceived as an explosion of citrus notes, orange plays the principal role, supported by zest and leaves, lemon, mandarin, mint and blackcurrant bud. The fragrance reveals its complexity in a unique sillage composed of oak moss and patchouli.

listings.description: The name says it all. Fucking Fabulous is an iconoclastic amber leather scent featuring a floral heart. Fragrance notes: Leather, Tonka Bean, Sage Fragrance family: Leather Set contains: Fabulous Eau de Parfum, 50ml Fabulous Eau de Parfum Travel Spray, 10ml

listings.rawTitle: Coach Love Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Coach Love is inspired by the vibrant and universal feeling of love and all of the unique ways we express it. The floral, fruity eau de parfum opens with an invigorating top note of wild strawberry, accentuated by a rich and velvety heart note of red velvet rose, before drying down to warm cedarwood. It is finished with the house’s iconic turnlock top, and classic gold hardware, including a sweetheart charm. Featuring Coach’s iconic Horse and Carriage logo, the outer pack is finished with a subtle leather texture in a rich red hue - a reference to the house’s heritage in leathercraft. Created in collaboration with director and photographer Juergen Teller, the campaign is a celebration of love in all its different forms and expressions. The campaign captures unique love languages, reminding us that love is a distinctive attitude.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Black Opium Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising. Over 16,000 5* reviews. Experience YSL Black Opium, the rock couture fragrance for women by Yves Saint Laurent. Captivating, unparalleled in provocation, deliberatively seductive. Inspiration: In 1977 Yves Saint Laurent introduces Opium: a boundary-pushing perfume. A revolution in a bottle. A new idea of femininity: sultry, provocative, enthralling. Fast forward to 2014, and Opium’s legacy continues to dazzle: Yves Saint Laurent Beauty unveils Black Opium, re-inventing desire in a new, contemporary light, reshaped for the modern woman. Scent: The original Black Opium Eau de Parfum. A captivating floral gourmand scent, twisted with dark, roasted notes of black coffee, for vigour and vitality. Energy and sensuality married with the unique YSL edge.The signature black coffee accord is paired with sensual vanilla, enriched by the softness of white flowers and orange blossom, set against a base of patchouli and comforting white musk. A daring contrast of light and dark, for a women’s fragrance that bewitches with its trail. Crafted by Marie Salamagne, Nathalie Lorson, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc. Top notes: pear accord, mandarin essence Heart notes: vanilla, orange blossom, white flowers Base notes: black coffee accord, cedarwood essence, white musk, patchouli Bottle: Feminine, sleek, dazzling. The Black Opium bottle is decorated with black glitter, as if dressed in sequins. The shimmering black of the bottle is contrasted with the pink hue of the centre and the radical contours of the bottle silhouette, for a design that is both edgy and glamourous. Collection: YSL Beauty mixes ingredients and proportions, constantly re-interpreting Black Opium’s coffee signature. Discover the YSL Black Opium fragrance wardrobe and indulge yourself or treat others to a YSL Black Opium gift. Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The original Eau de Parfum. Featuring adrenaline-rich black coffee and sensual vanilla. Captivating and energising Black Opium Eau de Parfum Illicit Green. A zesty take on the Black Opium signature. Green mandarin and creamy fig combine to create this ‘mocktail in a scent’. Energising and fresh Black Opium Eau de Parfum Neon. A vibrant spin on the original Black Opium Eau de Parfum. The signature coffee notes meet luminous dragon fruit. Fruity and vibrant Black Opium Eau de Parfum Extreme. The Black Opium signature taken to the next level. Extra-black coffee, ultra-white flowers, and an abundance of patchouli. Exhilarating and excessive Black Opium Eau de Parfum Intense. A bold interpretation of the Black Opium’s coffee note, enhanced by the thrilling aura of blue absinthe for intensity. Deep and seductive

listings.rawTitle: Penhaligon's The Baroness Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Collector of secrets and quiet conspiracies, the Baroness has always ruled from the shadows. Orange blossom sparkles with influence next to Chantilly. A whispered order of sandalwood. She doesn’t outrun danger; she outsmarts it. A floral gourmand fragrance blending Chantilly cream and orange blossom with warm sandalwood. A final flourish of geranium and vanilla sparks a soft yet sophisticated finish.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Allure Homme Édition Blanche Eau de Toilette Concentrée Spray 50ml
listings.description: A new dimension of style, striking a perfect balance between formal elegance and confident uniqueness. An explosive alchemy of hot and cold. An Amber-fresh fragrance housed in a solar bronze bottle with the contrast of a polar white cap. A unique and explosive alchemy of hot and cold. This Amber-fresh fragrance combines the citrus freshness of Lemon and Italian Bergamot with an Amber breeze of New Caledonian Sandalwood, Haitian Vetiver and Vanilla from Madagascar. listings.rawTitle: Escentric Molecules Molecule 01 + Champaca Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The most minimal fragrance is a single aroma-molecule: Molecule 01. The next most minimal adds 1 to 01: 01 + 1. This is Molecule +. The M+ line adds +1 to Iso E Super, the super aroma-molecule that turned the cloistered world of perfumery upside down. Molecule 01 + Champaca consists of Iso E Super + Champaca. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, woody, velvety cocooning sensation. Champaca is an absolute extracted from the red champaca flower, found only in India. One of the most expensive ingredients in perfumery, champaca absolute is one of the richest, most faceted floral materials in perfumery, with shades of jasmine and orange blossom, touches of tea, and a soft creaminess that unfolds in waves. Together, Iso E Super and champaca form an unexpected harmony: the weightless transparency of Iso E Super against the intricate opulence of champaca. A radiant opening with hints of orange blossom brightness gives way to a heart that is lush, floral, woody, and quietly exotic, before settling into the smooth, woody embrace of Molecule 01. "I was overwhelmed when I first smelled champaca absolute with Molecule 01. Champaca absolute and Iso E Super form an amazing amalgamation, because they are very contrary. Champaca absolute has so many facets. It's so rich. There's so much happening in it. The complexity of champaca absolute complements Iso E Super exceptionally well on its own. Because Iso E Super has these very woody yet transparent, very velvety, very cocooning, soft aspects, and then you have champaca, giving it all this complexity, all these different olfactory sensations," says Geza Schoen. M+ Champaca is an opulent yet weightless fragrance, where the multidimensional facets of champaca entwine with the velvety ease of Iso E Super, leaving a luxuriously luminous trail that lingers with quiet elegance.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Voyage d'Hermès, Eau de Toilette Refillable, 100ml
listings.description: Fresh woody notes are lively and reassuring; the brightness of juniper berries contrasts with the energy of cedar and the softness of white musks. "An invitation to discover, meet and share." Jean-Claude Ellena. A novel that feeds on the imagination, Voyage d’Hermès expresses the long-standing and unusual relationship between the house and travel. An interplay of paradoxes, complements and unexpected alliances supports the premise of woody notes that are fresh yet musky, familiar yet surprising, hovering between impulsive and comforting, equally at ease with men as with women. Hermès designer Philippe Mouquet created a travel object bottle for Voyage d’Hermès, designed for journeys and symbolic of movement.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Rosa Verde Eau de Toilette Refill, 200ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover the Rosa Verde refill, the easy way to refill your precious Aqua Allegoria bottle in one simple step. Rosa Verde, a vibrant rose bathed in freshness, that captures the feel-good effect of a dive on a summer’s day. The exhilarating aquatic freshness of cucumber evokes the invigorating frisson of skin plunging into water. The caress of rose soon unfolds, like the wave of pleasure that floods the body under the water’s surface. A vibrant green floral duo, accented with a crisp pear note and mellowed by a white musk accord. For the first time, Guerlain is exploring the emotions aroused by the fragrances in its iconic collection through the prism of the Science of the Emotions, which studies the close links between scents and emotions. At the heart of this approach, the Rosa Verde perfume offers an instant feeling of pleasure and relaxation¹. "Rosa Verde is the memory of an invigorating and relaxing dive. A rose bathed in freshness that unfurls on skin like a wave of well-being." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A real symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Aqua Allegoria fragrances are composed of more than 90% naturally derived ingredients². The French beetroot alcohol contained in their formulas is sourced from suppliers committed to sustainable agriculture. The 200ml refill extends the life cycle of the Aqua Allegoria bottle without compromising on quality. The spray unscrews manually to top up the bottle with a user-friendly refill, fitted with an anti-spill system. It cannot be used alone and is only compatible with refillable 75ml and 125ml bottles. ¹Using the Rosa Verde perfume increases the feeling of pleasure (self-assessment on 37 subjects) and the feeling of relaxation (instrumental test on 34 subjects). ²Calculation based on the international ISO 16128 standard, including water. ³Only on 75mL and 125mL sales formats. How to use: 1. Unscrew the spray pump 2. To start refilling, turn your refill upside down and screw onto your bottle 3. Refilling stops automatically once your bottle is full. Next, unscrew the refill and replace with the spray pump

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden The Heart of Leo Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Gucci’s The Alchemist’s Garden is a luxury collection of refined Eau de Parfums, Perfumed Oils, and Acque Profumate inspired by the art of alchemy. Captivated by the star-studded sky, the Gucci alchemist dreams of a new Gucci perfume honouring the brightest star from the Lion constellation - Gucci The Heart of Leo. The scent opens with a vibrant Blackcurrant Accord for a sweet touch that invites tangy and indulgent tones. At the heart, ambery and balsamic Olibanum lends the fragrance a woody warmth, beautifully balancing the fruity top note with its resinous character. A smoky base of Myrrh offers further warmth, steeping the scent in smoky, spicy undertones. An enticing Gucci perfume for any occasion, day and night. The bottle: This ambery-fruity Gucci fragrance is encased in a black lacquered bottle gilded with decorative foliage and bearing the scent's unique emblem: a golden lion. The fragrance: This mesmerising unisex perfume is manufactured using alcohol made from 100% recycled carbon emissions. Fragrance family: Ambery. Scent type: Ambery, fruity. Key notes: Top notes: Blackcurrant Accord Heart notes: Olibanum Extract Base notes: Myrrh Essential Oil

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne FAME Intense Eau de Parfum Intense 30ml
listings.description: Claim your inner light. Shimmering gold is the new bold. New FAME Intense by Rabanne unleashes your most daring feminine aura to make you shine brighter wherever you go. FAME Intense captures the irresistible Parisian spirit of the fashion–forward party girl, galvanising a new era of dazzling femininity with her everlasting light. More mischievous. More irreverent. She’s more galvanising than ever before. She’s as confident as fearless, making emboldened choices as the Paris sky turns to twilight. Crafted with only the most exceptional ingredients, solar jasmine meets opulent incense and creamy sandalwood in a dazzling new fragrance that frees the most sparkling facets of you, lighting up every room and revealing the FAME star within you. The fragrance: Quintessentially Parisian, crafted with the most exceptional ingredients. FAME Intense by Rabanne is an ode to the most dazzling facets of femininity shining through you. Inspired by Paris at twilight, this captivating honeyed fusion brings balmy warmth in an addictive new woody floral, spicy blend. Solar jasmine meets a trio of incense and creamy sandalwood in an enveloping fragrance. As flamboyant as you. The bottle: Bold is the new gold. Follow your inner light. New FAME Intense captures the iconic metallic fashion codes of Rabanne, then reinvents them for a dazzling new era of femininity. A coveted jewel so precious no one can resist: the legendary dress of FAME transforms into luminous honeyed gold, captivating every gaze. Sparkling brighter thanks to ambery golden hints, the bottle glows with a bold feminine aura as a new Fame star is born. Fragrance family: Floral Woody. Top notes: Coconut Water, Bergamot, Pink Pepper Heart notes: Incense, Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine, Base notes: Sandalwood, Mineral Musk, Cedarwood

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum Travel Refills, 3 x 11ml
listings.description: Same notes, two identities. The materials are worked to express their full potential, meeting the challenge of creating two unique eaux de parfum with the same ingredients: juniper berries, nutmeg, coriander, musks, ambery woods, and vanilla. The Gentle Fluidity duo was born of the perfumer’s imagination and offers two distinct olfactory silhouettes, for her or for him. The generous, enveloping sillage of Gentle Fluidity Gold unfurls coriander seed essence enhanced by a concentration of musks and vanilla. The floral, spicy note of coriander seeds brings, just like musks, ethereal volume and a lingering trail to the composition. In the base notes, the gourmand, reassuring vanilla accord, enhanced by ambery woods, reveals a radiant, bright silhouette. The gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de parfum reveals cosy, reassuring amber-musk accords. To enjoy a moment of well-being and prolong the sillage of your fragrance, add these other gentle Fluidity Gold scented creations to your beauty ritual: hand and body cleansing gel, scented body oil and hair perfume. Olfactory family: Musky Ambery. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Juniper berry oil, Nutmeg oil Heart notes: Coriander seeds oil Base notes: Musks, Ambery woods, Vanilla Blend

listings.rawTitle: DIOR J'adore Intense Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: Dive into the heart of sensual and voluptuous femininity with the new J'adore Intense fragrance, a bold interpretation of Dior's most iconic women's fragrance. A honeyed and luscious floral that leaves a gourmand trail on the skin, bringing the flowers of J'adore to their olfactory peak. In the new J'adore Intense fragrance, each flower gains intensity and volume, a true floral nectar. Fragrance notes: Jasmine: A sensual and luminous flower, is tinged with apricot accents Rose: Luscious and captivating, reveals an even more addictive facet Ylang-ylang: The ultimate sunny flower is imbued with smooth honeyed accents At the base, creamy notes of soft sandalwood and a generous vanilla note mark the new J'adore Intense fragrance with sovereign sensuality and assertive elegance. The House of Dior has made the legendary J'adore amphora lighter and more beautiful: the bottle's glass weight is 53%¹ lighter, and its cap is adorned with a golden pearl suspended in a glass droplet. ¹Comparison between the weight of the previous J'adore Eau de Parfum 100ml bottle vs. the new J'adore Intense 100ml bottle.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum Natural Spray Refills, 3 x 11ml
listings.description: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum goes mini. This perfume travel spray packs a punch. Slip it in your bag, pocket, or carry-on. It's your signature scent, ready for any adventure. Luxury that fits in the palm of your hand. Same bold fragrance, just smaller. Perfect for touch-ups on the go. Smell amazing, anywhere, anytime. Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum intensifies the radiance of the three auras found in the Eau de Parfum without betraying the original inspiration. The perfumer’s mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody extrait de perfume mini spray, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Grandiflorum jasmine head note gently underscores the craftsman’s voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with a musky and woody accord. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian pocket-size perfume embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time. Want extra protection? Try the Globe Trotter case. Its refined metal design is adorned with a polished zinc or golden finish to snugly encase your travel spray. Clips on easily. Travel worry-free. Sold separately. Olfactory family: woody ambery floral. Top notes: Grandiflorum jasmine, Saffron Heart notes: Bitter almond, Cedarwood Base notes: Musky woody accord, Ambergris accord

listings.rawTitle: Versace Eros Energy Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Love, passion, beauty, and desire. Eros Energy is a citrus-woody perfume that pays tribute to the Greek God of love through a joyful reincarnation of the original Eros Eau de Parfum. The powerful sillage and long-lasting presence of the fragrance symbolise the enduring power of love and beauty. At the same time, fresh waves of citrus pay homage to the breathtaking serenity of the Mediterranean coastline. Playfulness and intrigue are found at the heart of the fragrance through surprising and delicious notes of pink peppercorn and sharp blackcurrant. Finally, this spirited scent is rounded off with warm green notes of patchouli and oakmoss, providing a deep and earnest tribute to the natural world. listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum 100ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Reimagined with a couture-inspired design featuring an oversized Cassandre and the iconic chevron pattern, this gift set contains a full-size MYSLF Eau de Parfum and a travel spray to embody the blossoming freshness of Spring. Express your gratitude without limits, and make every moment an ode to blossoming connection. MYSLF, the masculine refillable fragrance by Yves Saint Laurent. An expression of who you are, with all your nuances. A statement of modern masculinity, for embracing all your facets and emotions. My scent, MYSLF. Austin Butler is the proud embodiment of MYSLF, as Global Fragrance Ambassador for YSL Beauty. YSL MYSLF is Yves Saint Laurent’s first woody floral scent. A prominent orange blossom heart blooms throughout the scent, complemented by a fresh and vibrant accord, and underpinned by layers of sensual, textured woods. The fragrance is characterised by its bright and authentic scent, which combines radiant freshness with earthy woods and patchouli, creating a provoking and ever-evolving aroma. Equal parts of light and depth, emblematic of modern masculinity and all the nuance it encompasses. My scent, MYSLF. Top notes: fresh and vibrant accord with bergamot heart Heart notes: orange blossom absolute heart Base notes: wood accord with patchouli and Ambrofix™ YSL MYSLF bottle: A YSL silhouette in a bottle – sleek, timeless, and expertly crafted. Dressed in black lacquer, a high shine finish reveals your reflection alongside the iconic YSL Cassandre logo, sculpted directly into the glass at the heart of the fragrance. There is subtlety in the varying shades of black that run the length of the bottle, showcasing exquisite craftsmanship and emblematic of the many facets of masculinity. Atop the fragrance, the angular lacquered cap is finished with an engraved, brushed metallic detail. YSL MYSLF is refillable. YSL Beauty is committed to reducing its impact on the environment. All formats of MYSLF are refillable, with the additional purchase of a 150ml perfume refill, reducing the amount of packaging materials used to replenish your masculine fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Calèche Soie de Parfum Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer Guy Robert in 1961, Hermès’ first fragrance for women, Calèche, was reinterpreted in 1992 as Calèche Soie de Parfum, the name of which refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house and its silk métier. Floral with aldehyde aromas, Calèche Soie de Parfum combines the refined notes of aldehyde with opulent jasmine and generous rose. The bottle, inspired by the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages, has a black cap reminiscent of a riding hat. The back label is illustrated with a design by Philippe Dumas, indicating that it belongs to the Parfums-Fondateurs collection. The Parfums-Fondateurs Collection: The Parfums-Fondateurs collection draws inspiration from the house’s heritage. Each creation encapsulates Hermès’ imaginary world in a name, a fragrance and a colour. Over the years, Hermès has pioneered a bold style of perfumery, resulting from encounters with exceptional perfumers. Written in 1961 by Guy Robert, Calèche was Hermès' first fragrance for women. A highly feminine, woody, chypre floral, its name refers to the horse-drawn carriages that are emblematic of the house. Calèche is a novel that dazzles with the beauty of its raw materials, from the joyfulness of citrus fruit to the modernity of aldehyde notes; from the floral heart embellished with ylang-ylang, rose and jasmine to the woody, chypre sillage underscored by the nobility of the iris.

listings.rawTitle: Rabanne PHANTOM Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Crafted to reveal the mysterious facets of masculinity, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne reveals an intriguing aura for the man who refuses to be constrained by the limits of convention. As an undeniable enigma, he lives by the essence of self-confidence and forges his own elusive path. Revealed to the world at nighttime in Paris, the bewitching city of lights, he is boldly non–conformist yet vulnerable, leaving an enchanting aura in his wake. Powered by the most mysterious facet of you, Phantom Eau de Toilette is unapologetically bold, yet sophisticated, combining a hypnotic blend of creamy lavender, energising lemon and addictive vanilla. Blended to perfection with the utmost refinement, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne is responsibly formulated with the most precious, ethically–sourced ingredients. The fragrance: Blended for mysterious masculinity, Phantom Eau de Toilette by Rabanne harnesses exceptional creamy lavender, energising lemon and addictive vanilla. The bottle: Catching the eye with its bold and elevated design, the Phantom Eau de Toilette bottle captures the essence of enigmatic masculinity in an iconic black and silver signature. The unmistakable Phantom aesthetic combines brilliant metallic silver with the dark glossy black of the glasses with a graphic transparent signature monogram at the centre. Sharp yet sophisticated, the bottle harnesses an aura of darkness to bring out the Phantom inside of you. Olfactive family: Aromatic, Woody, Amber. Top notes: Energising Fusing Lemon Heart notes: Sexy Woody Vanilla Base notes: Addictive Creamy Lavender
