listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum Liquid Balm Rollerball, 9ml
listings.description: In 2010, Le Labo was commissioned by AnOther Magazine to work on an exclusive scent. This project was born thanks to Sarah of colette who initiated the creative collaboration between Le Labo and Jefferson Hack, editor-in-chief of AnOther Magazine. The result of this collaboration is AnOther 13, a hypnotizing and unique scent. It’s composed of ambroxan, a synthetic animal musk, making AnOther 13 an addictive dirty potion blended with twelve other ingredients such as jasmine, moss and ambrette seeds absolute - which gives it spike and shine. As the entire planet knows, colette closed their doors December 2017, but luckily we were able to welcome AnOther 13 to our classic collection in our labs worldwide. Le Labo is proud to introduce its Liquid Balm. This new travel-friendly perfume rollerball glass vial can be used as an olfactive marker, to roll on your skin or someone else's your favourite Le Labo perfume.

listings.rawTitle: Histoires de Parfums This Is Not A Blue Bottle 1/3 Eau de Parfum, 60ml
listings.description: This is the perfume of fire. This is a molten ring, the dawning of a new energy. A Bloody Orange sun rises over Rose and Saffron’s blazing circle, liberating Leather’s endless power. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Blood Orange Heart notes: Rose, Saffron Base notes: Patchouli, Leather

listings.rawTitle: Chantecaille Frangipane Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Frangipane, native to Peru and the West Indies, was discovered by the botanist Frangipani when he landed on Antigua with the expedition of Columbus. Known by various civilisations as 'the eternal perfume', the sweet, calming fragrance is exuded by waxy yellow or pink blossoms. Uniquely sweet, full and rounded. Deeply sensual, intense and spiritual. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Orange, violet leaves, water hyacinth Mid notes: Muguet, frangipani, ylang ylang, jasmine Dry down: Vanilla, musk, cedarwood, amber

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Limited Edition Aqua Allegoria Perle Nerolia Vetiver Eau de Parfum, 125ml
listings.description: The Aqua Allegoria fragrance collection celebrates the wonders of the world. Each creation pays tribute to nature’s beauty and sweeps us up in a discovery of exceptional raw ingredients and notes, beautifully enhanced by our perfumer-explorers. Discover Nerolia Vetiver Perle, the first micro-pearl eau de parfum*. Designed to be halfway between fragrance and skincare, Nerolia Vetiver Perle captures the floral radiance of neroli in an innovative water-based micro-pearl formula. This pioneering technology* combines the intensity of highly concentrated perfume micro-pearls with the hydrating effects of an alcohol-free aqueous base. Exalted by the freshness of water, Nerolia Vetiver has been reinvented. Calabrian neroli** becomes water- and sun-drenched on contact with the zesty accents of bergamot and the aromatic notes of basil. Infused with orange blossom water, the composition highlights neroli’s greenest facets, beautifully enhanced by the generosity of a fig note and the woody depth of a vetiver accord. A fresh and luminous neroli, radiant with light. Perfumes that become one with skin, Aqua Allegoria Perle fragrances combine the intensity of an Eau de Parfum with the effect of hydrating skincare. In this new-generation water-based fragrance*, the perfume is captured inside micro-pearls composed of naturally-derived alginate in an alcohol-free aqueous base. Enriched with plant-based glycerine, its gel texture melts into skin in a single step. It leaves a soft and velvety veil with beautifying and hydrating effects on the skin. *At Guerlain. **In a Turkish neroli and Calabrian neroli duo. How to use: A highly sensory new perfume step. Sprayed onto pulse points, the neck, décolleté and wrists, the perfume is diffused in a generous mist. Its soft and enveloping texture melts onto skin when lightly massaged in circular movements.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Chance Eau Splendide Eau de Parfum 35ml
listings.description: A luminous new CHANCE that dazzles with splendour. CHANCE EAU SPLENDIDE, a magnetic fragrance that releases an olfactory whirlwind, diffusing a fruity-floral fragrance trail that is captivating and elegant. How to use: To express the full intensity of the interpretation, apply a generous sweeping spray of CHANCE EAU SPLENDIDE Eau de Parfum at the base of the neck, on the right, then on the left. The secret touch: apply a touch of fragrance to the nape of the neck, under the hair. Also, apply to the inside of clothing to increase the fragrance trail and make your presence felt. "When I leave my jacket behind, everyone knows that it's mine" Gabrielle Chanel.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Eau d'Hermès Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The first fragrance by Hermès. A powerful and sensual eau, rich in citrus fruit and enhanced with spices. Created in 1951 by Edmond Roudnitska, Eau d’Hermès explores a citrussy, spicy, floral theme and is the house's original fragrance. It draws inspiration from the idea of a magical, deeply sensory, aroma: "The inside of a Hermès bag where the scent of a perfume lingered...A note of fine leather wrapped in fresh trails of citrus fruit, seasoned with spices," was how the perfumer-composer described it at the time. A historical novel, inspired by the tradition and culture of Hermès, it appeals to both men and women. Powerful, sensual writing.

listings.rawTitle: Sol de Janeiro Cheirosa 40 Hair & Body Perfume Mist 90ml
listings.description: Silk to skin. Sultry and delicate, this warm floral fragrance pulls you in with a sheer touch of sophisticated sensuality. Give in to alluring notes of Black Amber plum, jasmine blooms, and vanilla woods. Feels like the pleasure's all yours. Cheirosa 40 Perfume Mist is inspired by the excitement of 1840 when Rio debuted the legendary bailes Carnaval Ball. All are invited. How to use: Spritz from head to toe - anytime and anywhere. (May cause compliments).

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires Insolence Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. Insolence is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. Insolence is a spark in the eyes, an intrepid smile. Insolence is a careless grace, an ironic elegance, an amused silence. Created in 2006, Insolence celebrates this surprising, free and daring femininity. An impertinent creation with powder hints which is built around a floral violet and iris duo with orange blossom. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette 30ml
listings.description: Inspired by the inimitable Parisian style, La Petite Robe Noire is an ode to freedom and love, the embodiment of elegance and style, an invitation to joie de vivre and irreverence. A characterful fragrance trail embroidered with the most beautiful black notes in perfumery. The iconic rose of La Petite Robe Noire, embroidered with tangy fruity notes, returns more sparkling than ever. Like a breath of fresh air, sparkling bergamot reveals all the freshness of the rose. White amber combined with white musk brings softness and comfort to this delicate, floral, fresh and tender trail. The symbolic silhouette has left the streets of Paris for the first time to wander through the rose fields of Grasse, a true gem of the House's perfumers' palette. Cultivated on the Mas des Sources estate, a new organically grown rose has been added to the Eau de Toilette La Petite Robe Noire formula, with 90% of its ingredients of natural origin*: the Centifolia rose from Grasse. La Petite Robe Noire fragrances are now made using French beetroot alcohol from sustainable agriculture. Created in 1912, the 'inverted heart' bottle is an iconic symbol of the Maison Guerlain. For La Petite Robe Noire Eau de Toilette, its timeless lines are adorned in a soft pink that pays tribute to the freshness and softness of the rose. Guerlain's commitment extends to its emblematic inverted heart bottle, which now incorporates at least 15% recycled glass. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation including water. How to use: Spray your La Petite Robe Noire fragrance generously on the neck and pulse points to create an intense and assertive sillage. Extend your La Petite Robe Noire fragrance ritual with bath and body products. Irresistible perfumed creations, embroidered with the most beautiful black notes of perfumery.

listings.rawTitle: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: About the fragrance: Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum, the newest Prada Women's fragrance. This 2024 crafted signature scent is a testament to florality that expands the boundaries of sensory perception. This unique fresh and floral signature is augmented by Artificial Intelligence that enables perfumers to explore new possibilities and express their creativity, and compose new and unexpected accords with a jasmine accord. Fragrance description: Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum is a floral musky fragrance that captures the airy floral scent of Jasmine as perceived in nature. The avant-garde signature reveals fresh and zesty top notes of Italian Vert de Bergamot, a lively flowery heart incorporating Jasmine accord and Neroli, and base notes of Musk and Ambrette for comfort. This feminine Eau de Parfum is ideal for Spring and Summer with its fresh and floral olfactive profile and impressive longevity. The bottle: Like the original signature, Paradoxe Virtual Flower’s bottle expresses the House’s essence of reinvention and preference for contrasts. A minimal and delicate design at first glance, inspired by the iconic Prada triangle logo, is designed to rest on its side. Prada’s coat of arms logo contrasts with the fresh light pink colour of the fragrance. The refillable perfume bottle is finished with ‘Virtual Flower’ on its top chamfer. Fragrance family: Fresh Floral. Key notes: Jasmine, Neroli, Musk and Ambrette, Vert de Bergamot. How to use: Fragrance is intensified by the warmth of your own body. Apply in the creases of your knees and elbows for a strong and long lasting perfume scent. If you prefer placing fragrance on your wrists, be sure to reapply after frequent hand-washing, as this tends to rinse off the scent. After applying your fragrance, avoid rubbing or dabbing skin. This breaks down the fragrance, causing it to wear off more quickly.

listings.rawTitle: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs Lavanda Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Good to know: Chloé Atelier des Fleurs is being re-branded, the logo on your products may differ from the photos. The scent is still the same. Chloé Atelier des Fleurs invites you to compose your personalised Chloé fragrance as though arranging your favourite blossoms in a bouquet at a Parisian flower shop. Each perfume in the collection reveals a single floral, aromatic or woody scent rooted in the perfumer’s memory. Wear alone like a corsage or combine endlessly to create a lovely present or a perfume for all occasions. A flower, a perfumer, a story... Lavanda, a sunny perfume for women by Quentin Bisch. This Provençal Eau de Parfum was inspired by Quentin Bisch's childhood vision of his mother walking from the heat of the garden into the cool of the house, a spray of lavender in her arms. Bisch revisits this note with a highly modern twist while enhancing every facet of lavender, from aromatic freshness to sun-drenched fullness. Capturing light and shade, this is the perfect summer fragrance. This Chloé perfume is housed in an elegant pleated glass bottle topped with an ivory cap that appears to be carved in stone. Touches of gold at the neckband and label trim enhance the light hue of each beautiful fragrance. How to use: For a beautiful long-lasting fragrance, delicately spray on clothing and pulse points: the neck, chest and wrists. Wear your favourite flower on its own to celebrate its vitality and intensity, or combine Lavanda with other perfumes from Atelier des Fleurs to create a personalised fragrance bouquet. Disclaimer: Packaging may vary but scent remains the same.

As Issey Miyake's first perfume for men, L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has established itself as a signature reference in the world of men's perfumery and aftershave. Strength and balance – these are the two qualities that unite the fragrance. Upon first spritz, you're greeted with the vibrant freshness of yuzu, the iconic Japanese citrus, and tangerine. In the heart, water lily creates the aquatic facet of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme, balanced by warm spicy notes. Tobacco, vetiver, and sandalwood channel an energy which evokes that of a powerful waterfall, making the fragrance assertive and masculine. The iconic bottle of L'Eau d'Issey pour Homme has transcended time as well. Inspired by waterfalls as well, the slender, contemporary glass widens at the base and stands in contrast with the light grey hood.

listings.rawTitle: Jimmy Choo I want Choo Collector Edition Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: I Want Choo is a powerful floral gourmand woody fragrance that explodes with joy and good humour, finished with a seductive twist. It is the incarnation of the true Jimmy woman: glamorous, confident, playful and always full of joy. The sensual fragrance is inspired by the atmosphere when friends are getting ready to party the night away. It is not about going out; it is all about sharing the fun, the laughter and making it a girls' night in to remember. On top, a citrus note of mandarin juice contrasts with the suave, velvety peach nuances. The carnal and solar vanilla-like notes of the red spider lily blend in with the sensual vibes of jasmine sambac in the heart. The base notes of vanilla and benzoin anchor the fragrance in a deep, yet joyful way, leaving an intense vapour trail behind. As with everything from Jimmy Choo, the bottle is a true object of desire. Featuring a bold gold spray cap with a hammered jewelled effect and the precious JC monogram logo, all underlined by the soft and ultra-feminine peach tint of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: L'OCCITANE Fleurs de Cerisier (Cherry Blossom) Eau de Toilette, 50ml
listings.description: Transport yourself to the cherry trees in the South of France with notes of cherry extract from Provence, freesia, lily of the valley, underlined by a base of amber and musk. Discover our iconic Fleurs de Cerisier Eau de Toilette (formerly Cherry Blossom), redesigned with a new, modern and minimalist look that reflects the cultural heritage of L'Occitane en Provence. listings.rawTitle: Molton Brown Dark Leather Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Unearth your brooding, mysterious side with this woody Eau de Parfum’s smouldering fusion of warming elemi, herbaceous geranium and smoky leather – a signature note of crisp lavender unexpectedly softens the wild smokiness. The fragrance: Twilight blankets mountain-ringed lakes and ancient forests. Charred birch crackles on a fire. An aged atlas lies open, imperial and leather bound. Ignite the wilderness of the plateau. Intense. Dark. Enigmatic. This fragrance captures the drama of a smoky campfire where deep, woody and leathery textures powerfully mingle with the raw briskness of wild forest pine.

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Essenza Eau de Cologne 50ml
listings.description: Vibrant, determined, and distinctive, Colonia Essenza is a citrus woody fragrance that reinterprets the iconic Colonia with a touch of authentic unconventionality. Presented in a new restyled bottle, it speaks to those with a style that comes from within. Colonia Essenza is a distinctive fragrance with a crisp character that speaks to those with an authentic style that comes from within. Acqua di Parma's golden fruits - lemon, orange, and bergamot - meet notes of grapefruit, mandarin, and petitgrain, blending into an aromatic-floral heart of notes of rose, jasmine, and a hint of clove. A precious blend of woody vetiver, soft musk, and warm amber enriches its earthy patchouli base. The fragrance comes in the quintessential Acqua di Parma bottle, an epitome of the Art Deco expression. The transparent glass allows Colonia Essenza’s nuances to be fully appreciated, while the classic black cap adds a touch of understated sophistication. The restyled minimal white labels echo the refined aesthetics of the Colonia collection, while the matte-paper box, characterised by its cylinder shape, features our signature vibrant yellow shade.

listings.rawTitle: KILIAN PARIS Dark Lord 'Ex Tenebris Lux' Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: Kilian Hennessy's Inspiration: “A gentleman is one who never hurts anyone’s feeling - unintentionally,” the quixotic Oscar Wilde once noted of the elite race of men who are shamelessly, unapologetically themselves and with perfect aplomb. They charm by their character and please only those who are refined enough to receive them. The Perfume: DARK LORD ‘EX TENEBRIS LUX’ is a gentleman of the night. Meet him in the most surprising of circumstances and his mystery slowly unfolds: A head-twisting mix of shadows and light, it seduces in seconds with its elegant, long-lasting accords of leather and strong vetiver, its jasmine drenched in rum, and a dandyish entrance of bergamot and pepper. From darkness, into light. Perfume Notes: Pepper, Jasmine, Vetiver. Perfumer: Alberto Morillas.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Idôle L'Eau de Toilette 25ml
listings.description: Embrace your inner strength. Discover Idôle l'Eau de Toilette, the first fragrance to turn a rare freshness into a true trail, enclosed in an elegant and sleek bottle. Idôle enables you to embrace who you are, your inner strength - to move the world. Idôle is not just a fragrance, it's a symbol. The time has come to embrace who you are, to discover your true self, and to join a community of engaged peers. Self-aware and full of convictions, those wearing Idôle join the ride of women fighting to change the world, in an era of modernity and commitment. A powerful and fresh fragrance - Idôle l'Eau de Toilette is the perfect encounter between strong notes and a subtle, surprising freshness. The fragrance opens with a green shincha tea accord, followed by a duo of roses, with green notes and a rose damascena essence, combined with a fresh bergamot that adds juicy and fresh tones to preserve an elegant citrus heart. How to use: To elevate your trail, delicately mist from a distance of approximately 20 cm onto your skin, emphasizing the pulsating points.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Oud for Greatness Neo Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: A powerful concentrate of essences revealed by the active properties of 'Neuroscents'. The psychoactive molecules of Oud enhance our ability to think and feel. The synergistic pairing of Lavender Orpur® and Bergamot soothes and strengthens the mind.Meanwhile, the positive energy of Balsam Fir enhances well-being. Its brain-boosting scent promotes self-confidence and determination propelling it to new heights. Aromatic Spicy. Fragrance notes: Agarwood, Bergamot, Lavender Orpur®, Saffron, Fir Balsam, Musk.

listings.rawTitle: Van Cleef & Arpels Collection Extraordinaire Fleur de Nuit Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: As the sun goes down and summer grows milder, tuberose reveals a sunny, delicate scent with milky and honeyed notes. The Collection Extraordinaire celebrates this precious flower, whose white petals awaken at dusk, just as day slowly fades. After being picked, it continues to release its aroma for two days, as if prolonging the magic. A vibrant burst of Pink Peppercorns and Petitgrain opens the fragrance, like a gentle breeze carried by the mildness of the evening. The creamy opulence of Tuberose then unveils its floral richness, enhanced by a salty accord that evokes the serenity of a calm sea. Finally, a warm breath of Sandalwood blends with the tenderness of White Musks and the roundness of Vanilla Milk, leaving a comforting, enveloping trail.

listings.rawTitle: HUGO BOSS BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum Intense for Him 50ml
listings.description: Fuse the power of attraction with BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum Intense for Him, an irresistible BOSS fragrance for men that captures the smouldering connection between a power couple. Radiating sensuality, this ambery-fruity gourmand scent blends sultry contrasts. Iconic, suave Maninka fruit, crafted exclusively for BOSS, intertwines with opulent, warm Amber accord to form a rich, seductive liqueur of sweetness and raw intensity that fuses the senses. BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum Intense for Him redefines empowering sensuality in a striking bottle, crowned with a gunmetal-silver cap engraved with the Double-B monogram. Deep, glossy brown lacquered glass, adorned with an oversized BOSS logo, reflects the rich intensity of the men's fragrance within and subtly echoes the glowing heat of the scent. With its multi-faceted silhouette, the bottle captures the fierce fusion of a power couple in perfect harmony. How to use: Spray BOSS The Scent Eau de Parfum Intense for Him on pulse points around the body to increase the longevity of this long-lasting masculine scent.

listings.description: Indulge in the luxurious Pomelo Bath Cologne and transform your bath ritual. Pour the cologne liberally under warm running water, light a candle, and step into the bath to relax and immerse yourself in the captivating scent. Inspired by Jo's walks on the beach in Parrot Cay, Pomelo captures the essence of holidays, the beach, the sun, and the waters. Discover the scent notes of Vetiver, Pomelo, Patchouli, and Pomelo Zest, and let Pomelo transport you to your own personal oasis. How to use: Pour liberally under warm running water for a luxurious bathing experience, gently scenting the skin without a sticky or oily residue.

listings.description: Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum captures the powerful freshness of the sea. Top notes: Fresh marine notes and zesty green mandarin Middle notes: Clary sage and fresh lavandin Base notes: Vetiver and smoky patchouli As part of Giorgio Armani’s commitment to a better future, the Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum is made of some sustainably sourced ingredients: a fragrance that captures the essence of the sea and is mindful of the planet. Acqua di Giò Eau de Parfum unveils a modern new bottle which displays a new black gradient lacquering effect, a black cap and a striking new logo positioning, to chime with the complete range. listings.rawTitle: Memo Paris Ilha Do Mel Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: An enticing Brazilian island, allowing for all sorts of fantasies. Her name, Ilha do Mel or 'Honey Island', immerses the soul in delicious dreams. This honey, which memories of love are made of, sends an urgent message: surrender to desire and lose yourself! It was its enchanting name that led Memo to this destination, a virtually untouched and pure island. Crests of broom absolute roll into noble Iris concrete, blending with voluptuous gardenia and orange blossom absolute... and a touch of jasmine blossom honey. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Juniper berry essence, Bergamot, Gardenia Heart notes: Cypriol essence, Jasmine absolute, Narcisse absolute, Broom absolute Base notes: Vanilla bean extract, Benzoin resinoid, Iris concrete

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI OMNIA Coral Eau de Toilette, 100ml
listings.description: The heart of Omnia Coral pulses with the warm light of red Coral. Alberto Morillas interprets this solar energy in a striking signature, where the tropical Hibiscus proudly offers its flamboyant colours and lively fruitiness to the sun. Goji berry, the fruit of happiness, captured in a creative accord, joins Bergamot essence in a fusing burst of freshness, while the Water Lily accord delicately refreshes the warm accents of Hibiscus. The natural elegance of Cedarwood essence adds an addictive woody trail to this explosion of colour. The flacon design pays tribute to Omnia's signature shape while staying true to its inimitable original scent, crafted by Master Perfumer Alberto Morillas, which remains untouched. Like a frame of light, an invitation to rediscover the fascination of Omnia from a new, more precious perspective. Reinforcing its commitment to making the flacon last longer, the collection embraces a fully refillable design. Omnia Coral Eau de Toilette is offered in a dedicated 200ml refill, compatible with the 100ml flacon size.

listings.rawTitle: TOM FORD Costa Azzurra Eau de Parfum 10ml
listings.description: TOM FORD Costa Azzurra evokes the uninhibited sensuality of a Mediterranean escape. "I have always loved fragrances with a transportive quality. Costa Azzurra captures the relaxed and sexy mood of the Mediterranean – for me, it feels like the ultimate escape." TOM FORD. Costa Azzurra captures the easy sensuality of a purely uninhibited escape. The exhilarating aroma of sea air, fresh aromatic notes, evergreens and citrus set the scene and mingle with deeper woody scents — a crisp medley of cypress, oaks and aromatics. The Costa Azzurra flacon reflects a warm and elegant presence. The 50ml and 100ml editions are each housed in a luxe, fluted bottle with a sleek, gold metal plaque and matching cap. Good to know: Please be aware that ingredient lists may change or vary from time to time. listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Limited Edition Stronger With You Spices Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Discover Stronger With You Spices, a limited edition intense ambery-spicy scent, encapsulated in a metallic terracotta-toned bottle that evokes the sandy tones of desert dunes. A spicy, warm scent with a sensual projection, empowered by Stronger With You’s iconic fougère-ambery signature. The fresh spiciness emerges as the fragrance opens with citrus and the woody facet of black pepper extract. Amplifying this unmistakable heat is a heart defined by the subtly bittersweet scent of a saffron accord. This is woven with a trio of hot spices and aromatic lavender diva essence. Delicious and indulgent, the base unveils an addictive fusion of vanilla bourbon premium extract. The iconic bottle transforms into a striking new guise. A unique metallic, terracotta-toned bottle, evoking the sandy tones of desert dunes, and a tactile gold cap, intricately designed with the iconic entwined rings. How to use: Spray on wrists and neck. To obtain a long-lasting trail, complete by spraying in a double ring-gesture around your head and towards your shoulders.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Aqua Allegoria Herba Fresca Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: A note of fresh herbs sparkling with dew and springtime flowers, energised by a bunch of spearmint leaves and connected by a green tea accord. Create your own signature by pairing Herba Fresca with: Bergamote Calabria, Pera Granita, Orange Soleia or Granada Salvia. To create your own olfactory signature, select your favourite duo among recommended options and spray each Aqua Allegoria on your skin one by one in equivalent quantities.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Promise Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: An olfactory illusion, Promise is a masterly perfume by Dominique Ropion for the Desert Gems collection, which recreates the alluring power of oud. Emblematic of Middle Eastern culture, oud is a natural treasure. A 'black gold' with a deep, faceted scent that fascinates master perfumer Dominique Ropion. With Promise, he recreates all of its nobility with cypriol, a plant native to India, accompanied by precious essences of Turkish and Bulgarian roses. An olfactory celebration of the strongest bonds that can join two people, this scent induces an irrepressible appeal that connoisseurs of fragrance would be able to recognise from a crowd of a thousand. Rose, apple, patchouli, cypriol. listings.description: Pure pleasure in a perfume. Unwrap the pink bow of the luxurious Viktor & Rolf Bonbon Eau de Parfum to treat yourself to Bonbon’s indulgent flavours and spoil yourself with its opulent aromas. Distinguished by its caramel heart, this feminine scent is both seductive and tantalising. Try to resist if you can. Indulge in a sweet treat with fruity top notes of Mandarin, Orange and Blackcurrant developing into a heart of Jasmine, Orange Blossom and sumptuous Caramel, which characterises the scent. Almost tempting enough to eat, the delectable Caramel notes mature from a sharp, edible top note to a softer and milkier heart, evolving to add depth to the woody base notes of Cedarwood, Guaiac Wood, Sandalwood and Amber. listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Eau Parfumée Au Thé Vert Eau de Toilette 75ml
listings.description: Eau Parfumée Thé Vert is a precious signature encapsulating the revitalising olfactive botanical properties of natural green tea. Eau Parfumée Thé Vert, launched in 1992, was initially designed as an exclusive gift intended to cater to the close circle of the Maison’s top high jewellery clients. Today, Bvlgari invites its clients to rediscover its original perfume creation through a new design, an upgraded formula with natural tea and a new conceptual story. Inspired by a dreamlike place where gems of nature spark the imagination, clients are welcome to experience Eau Parfumée's unique olfactive botanical harmonies inside the Botanical Garden. Eau Parfumée Thé Vert Eau de Toilette traces an awakening path through this garden, unveiling the revitalising olfactive botanical properties of green tea. With Eau Parfumée Thé Vert, Master Perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena captures the irresistible vitality of the young tea leaves as well as their vegetal, grassy and refreshing aroma. The signature citrus aromatic skilfully combines green tea notes with a luminous floral accord of neroli petals. The fizzy texture of bergamot essence mingles with crispy, young tea leaves to recreate the timeless, rejuvenating pleasure of being immersed in nature, imbuing all the senses with new energy. The silhouette of the flacon is inspired by the robust elegance of ancient Roman columns. The design is embellished by the iconic glass décolleté symbolising a sensory experience as rich and intimate as wearing a jewellery creation. A crackled inlay adorns the beige gold cap and echoes the tradition of celadon ceramics, which originated in China. The front label is enriched with new hand-drawn botanical illustrations, meticulously crafted exclusively for Bvlgari by a French botanist and exquisitely embossed thanks to new selected paper made from hemp. Olfactive pyramid: Neroli Petals Accord & Green Tea Extract.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Mitsouko Eau de Parfum Spray, 75ml
listings.description: Her name was Mitsouko. It means “mystery”, a mystery of tenderness and softness. She is this enigmatic, disarming and determined woman who accepts her destiny with the courage of the greatest heroines in literature. A masterpiece of balance, this mysterious perfume is made of spices and wood with subtly fruity accents. Little by little, Mitsouko evokes the assertive scent of underbrush. Its tonality is warm and sensual, it makes its presence known softly and embarks on a long story…Fruity chypre mysterious, balanced, velvety, a masterpiece of balance and originality, Mitsouko marries a fruity note of peach with jasmine flowers and May rose. The mysterious dry-down of the fragrance blends spicy notes with those of underbrush and vetiver.Originally released in 1919. Top notes: Rose, bergamot, jasmine, citrus Heart notes: Ylang-ylang, jasmine, peach, lilac Base notes: Oakmoss, vetiver, cinnamon, amber, spices

listings.rawTitle: Jo Malone London Fig & Lotus Flower Cologne
listings.description: Luscious lotus flowers skim the surface of a shimmering pond in the ancient Hanging Gardens. Their delicate water-splashed petals glide down the shaded walkways, sweeping over the plump, juicy figs that punctuate the bountiful trees. This light floral fragrance is brought together with neroli to capture the essence of a luxuriant landscape. Top note: Fig Leaf Heart note: Lotus Flower Base note: Vetiver Your Jo Malone London order will be exquisitely wrapped in their iconic box, tied with a beautiful grosgrain ribbon. Looking to find your new favourite scent in person? listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Brume du Matin Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Created by perfumer François Merle-Baudoin, Brume du Matin (French for Morning Mist) is a bright, harmonious fragrance that captures a mystical, dew-filled world, evoking the freshness of a Mediterranean morning in Grasse, a founding location of the perfume house. Juicy and invigorating, Brume du Matin starts with fruity hints of mandarin and bergamot, which are then amplified in the heart by peach and plum, alongside the floral notes of rose, fresh violet, peony and indulgent jasmine. This sumptuous medley of ripening fruit and delicate flowers creates a complex composition, whilst remaining as light as the eponymous mist itself, a veil that trails upon the skin. Base notes of sandalwood, amber and white musk provide the perfect, sweet and creamy undertones that round out this radiant Floral fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Coach Men Pure Platinum Parfum 60ml Fragrance Gift Set
listings.description: Pure Platinum Parfum is the olfactory expression of strength refined, a scent for those who lead with confidence and leave a lasting impression. It channels the rare intensity and enduring allure of platinum, capturing the magnetism of a man at his most expressive. Opening with the vibrant freshness of Lavender Oil from Bulgaria LMR, the fragrance immediately asserts its energy, clean, sharp, and unmistakably masculine. At the heart, the warmth of Rum Absolute unfurls with depth and richness, evoking effortless sophistication and a hint of intrigue. Anchoring it all is the addictive pull of Ambrox, radiating sensuality and a modern edge that lingers on the skin like a second signature. Encased in a bottle adorned with platinum accents, Pure Platinum is more than a fragrance; it's a statement. Rare, powerful, and timeless, it celebrates the luxury of being unapologetically you. Set contains: Coach Pure Platinum Parfum, 60ml Coach Pure Platinum Parfum, Travel Size, 7.5ml

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Amyris Pour Homme Eau de Toilette 70ml
listings.description: Created from rosemary from Morocco, mandarin from Sicily, Amyris from Jamaica, Iris from Florence, Tonka bean from Brazil and beautifully subtle modern woods. Like the flamboyant warmth of a sunset Amyris kindles a flame that never dies. Amyris is a genus of flowering plants in the citrus family. The generic name is derived from the Greek word which means "intensely scented" and refers to the strong odor of the resin. Members of the genus are commonly known as Torchwoods because of their highly flammable wood.

listings.description: Deliciously fresh, pretty, classic, and romantic. Pétales is a party at the Botanical Gardens on a warm summer's evening, it's an all-night dance on a Yacht off the Riviera its essence is the white-flower elegance of a thousand gardenias, chic and couture at its heart. Inspired by Sylvie Chantecaille's deep love for Gardenias A classically romantic white floral fragrance Modernized with notes of Balsam, Jasmine, and Tuberose Anchored with notes of Cedar and Sandalwood.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent JAZZ Eau de Toilette Natural Spray, 80ml
listings.description: JAZZ and its musical option is a celebration of life, rich in encounters and in culture, the premises of multi-ethnicity, a world where opposites are joined by the happy medium. Virility and strength, both perceptible from the first few notes, reflect fresh and vibrant masculinity carried by coriander. The theme broadens out and takes on an unsuspected dimension, rather like a jazz score where the central theme leaves so much scope for improvisation and originality. Geranium gives a masculine floral touch then very quickly the whole mood changes with artemisia and cypress, which deliver the measure of a warmer, more intelligent man with a great aesthetic sense, able to play with a more intimate score, riskier certainly, but more subtle. With JAZZ, the classic fern harmony becomes increasingly singular and evolves into more somber and mysterious moods with patchouli. In the image of the man who reveals all his inner wealth and paradoxes. Key notes: Coriander, geranium, artemisia, cypress, patchouli. 80ml

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI MAN Rain Essence Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Man Rain Essence Eau de Parfum captures the revitalising energy and quiet renewal of Rain, nature’s most transformative element. As the Rain starts to fall, man and nature move in unison, embracing the quiet strength of a new beginning. The elemental force is part of a deeper inspiration that unites the entire Bvlgari Man collection. At its heart lies the Circle of Nature: a visual and narrative journey through the geometry of nature, capturing the eternal essence of the elements. For Bvlgari Man, the Circle of Nature holds profound meaning. More than just a shape, it is a force that governs all life, the eternal essence of nature, timeless and ever flowing. The circular symbolism also echoes the refillable design of the Bvlgari Man flacon and the Bvlgari Bvlgari engravings on the cap, reinforcing a connection to nature and timeless craftsmanship. The Bvlgari Man flacon reflects the Maison’s unmistakable style, where the geometric precision of Roman architecture meets the bold modernity of Italian design. With its clean lines, structured silhouette, and refined finish, it embodies both audacity and elegance. The brushed silver tones and luminous transparency of Man Rain Essence capture the pure freshness of Rain. Beyond design, the packaging also encompasses the use of sustainable materials. Overall, the newly designed Bvlgari Man Rain Essence flacon features 16% PCR (post-consumer recycled) materials, including 15% recycled glass and 28% recycled plastic. To enhance usability, the new packaging features a removable cap that protects the atomiser and reveals a circular aluminium plate engraved with the Bvlgari Bvlgari logotype. Reinforcing its commitment to making the flacon last longer, the collection embraces a fully refillable design. Each fragrance in the collection is offered in a dedicated 200ml refill, compatible with all flacon sizes: 60ml, 100ml, and 150ml.

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Delina Hair Perfume, 75ml
listings.description: The Delina Hair Perfume is a light mist to be sprayed directly onto the hair or onto a hairbrush. It has a poetic floral scent that will be swirling inside your mind long after it is applied. With a fragrant heart of rose, it has the perfect touch of modern femininity, which concludes at the base with cashmere wood essence that infuses the fragranced cream with a velvety sensuality. The perfect accompaniment to the Delina Eau de Parfum. Olfactive notes: An iconic, addictive scent with notes of rose and lychee. The Delina hair perfume is a charming way to enjoy the Delina scent, which is a firmly modern floral bouquet. This Eau de Parfum is a highly nuanced fragrance that is both soft and sensual. Delina relishes in its floral accords which are dominated by Turkish rose, lily of the valley and peony, blended with the rounded tangy notes of lychee, rhubarb, bergamot and nutmeg. Vanilla accentuates the sensuality of the composition at the base, mingling with white musk, cashmeran, cedarwood and incense.

listings.rawTitle: Calvin Klein Eternity for Women Eau de Parfum, 30ml
listings.description: Luxurious. Romantic. Timeless. Inspired by a simple band of diamonds and the ideal of lasting love and intimacy, Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum for Women is a harmonious blend of classic and contemporary style. A classic, mesmerising Eau de Parfum, Eternity for Women is a harmonious blend of white flowers and creamy woods. This Calvin Klein scent has floral top notes of freesia, mandarin, and sage. It transitions to essences of white lily and marigold, and is completed with dry and spicy notes of sandalwood, patchouli, and amber. Calvin Klein Eternity Eau de Parfum for Women is a classic floral fragrance housed within an elegant tall glass bottle with a silver lid. How to use: Apply this women's Eau de Parfum to the pulse points at your chest, neck and behind your ears.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Jicky Perfume, 30ml
listings.description: Amber chypre. Fresh, dynamic, surprising. Filled with contrasts and dualities, freshness and Amber notes, Jicky is a magical perfume that plays on the olfactory ambiguity between masculine and feminine. The subtle spicy notes that blossom with the usual warmth of the Amber facet also play skillfully with the fresh and aromatic notes of lemon and lavender at its heart. Underneath this audacious structure, one detects woody and vanilla notes for greater vibration and character. 30ml

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Terre d'Hermès Eau de Toilette 30ml + 125ml Refill
listings.description: In 2006, perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena created Terre d’Hermès, an Eau de Toilette that connects man to his creative power. The composition tells the story of man’s relationship with the earth, his dialogue with nature and the elements. Since 2016, Hermès perfumer Christine Nagel has been exploring new possibilities linked to this fragrance. A mineral, woody fragrance, Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette combines powerful notes of cedar with the radiance of grapefruit and the vibrancy of flint. The compact Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette travel spray is encased by lightweight, shock-proof rubber. The bottle rests on an orange H, which leaves its imprint on the earth. The 30ml Terre d’Hermès Eau de Toilette travel bottle comes with a 125ml refill.

listings.rawTitle: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Oud Satin Mood Eau de Parfum Refills, 3 x 11ml

Transported by the finesse of a violet accord, oud wood from Laos curls on contact with rose essence from Bulgaria and rose absolute from Turkey. A rich vanilla and amber accord adds softness to this vibrant composition. With your eyes closed, you can imagine flowing fabrics delicately draped over bare skin. Travel spray case sold separately. 3 x 11ml

Montblanc Incense – A mesmerizing tribute to the ancient art of incense, this fragrance envelops you in a warm embrace of amber and precious woods, radiating an air of quiet sophistication and reverence for tradition.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Bel Ami Vétiver Eau de Toilette, 100ml

From chypre leather to woody leather: now the light of warm, woody, green vetiver, with a very subtle smokiness, becomes the centrepiece, replacing the patchouli of before. The Founders bear witness to the initial encounters between the house of Hermes and fragrance. They tell the story of the living heritage of Hermes, its references and secrets... These fragrances are timeless, yet never less than contemporary. A bold, assertive charm, an encounter between vetiver and Russian leather. Olfactory emotion: Warm, Sensual. listings.rawTitle: Issey Miyake L’Eau d’Issey Eau de Toilette 50ml Fragrance Gift Set

listings.rawTitle: DIOR J'adore Eau de Parfum 30ml
listings.description: J’adore Eau de Parfum is the great women's floral fragrance by DIOR. A bouquet finely crafted down to the last detail, like a custom-made flower. It unites essence of Ylang-Ylang with its floral-fruity notes; essence of Damascus Rose from Turkey and blends with a rare duo of Jasmine Grandiflorum from Grasse, and Indian Sambac Jasmine with fruity and voluptuous sensuality. "J’adore is an extraordinary fragrance because it succeeds in being effortlessly seductive while boasting an original signature. Carnal, but not overbearing. This is a composition that unites contrasts, transforming iconic floral notes into an appealing, unprecedented and mysterious ensemble. J'adore invents a flower that does not exist." François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator. Olfactory description: J'adore Eau de Parfum unites the most beautiful flowers from all over the world: Ylang-Ylang, with its fruity and exotic notes Damascus Rose from Turkey, sensitive and smooth Jasmine Grandiflorum from Grasse, with Apricot and jam notes Indian Sambac Jasmine, with the warm facets of Orange Blossom Indian Tuberose, with its white, heady beauty A closer look at Grasse Jasmine: Sun-drenched and jammy Jasmine Grandiflorum from Grasse, and Sambac Jasmine from India with its warm Orange Blossom accents, unite their strengths and differences to form a superb note: the ultimate embodiment of florality. An exceptional flower, Jasmine must be harvested at dawn, when its aroma is strongest. A moment suspended in time when, in the perfect light, Jasmine rejoices. How to use: For an intense and enhanced ritual: 1. Apply J'adore beautifying body milk 2. Spray J'adore Eau de Parfum on pulse points 3. Enhance with J'adore dry body oil

This is a composition that unites contrasts, transforming iconic floral notes into an appealing, unprecedented and mysterious ensemble. J'adore invents a flower that does not exist." François Demachy, DIOR Perfumer-Creator. Olfactory description: J'adore Eau de Parfum unites the most beautiful flowers from all over the world: Ylang-Ylang, with its fruity and exotic notes Damascus Rose from Turkey, sensitive and smooth Jasmine Grandiflorum from Grasse, with Apricot and jam notes Indian Sambac Jasmine, with the warm facets of Orange Blossom Indian Tuberose, with its white, heady beauty A closer look at Grasse Jasmine: Sun-drenched and jammy Jasmine Grandiflorum from Grasse, and Sambac Jasmine from India with its warm Orange Blossom accents, unite their strengths and differences to form a superb note: the ultimate embodiment of florality. An exceptional flower, Jasmine must be harvested at dawn, when its aroma is strongest. A moment suspended in time when, in the perfect light, Jasmine rejoices. How to use: For an intense and enhanced ritual: 1. Apply J'adore beautifying body milk 2. Spray J'adore Eau de Parfum on pulse points 3. Enhance with J'adore dry body oil

listings.rawTitle: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum, 10ml Travel Tube Refill
listings.description: In 2010, Le Labo was commissioned by AnOther Magazine to work on an exclusive scent. This project was born thanks to Sarah of colette who initiated the creative collaboration between Le Labo and Jefferson Hack, editor-in-chief of AnOther Magazine. The result of this collaboration is AnOther 13, a hypnotizing and unique scent. It’s composed of ambroxan, a synthetic animal musk, making AnOther 13 an addictive dirty potion blended with twelve other ingredients such as jasmine, moss and ambrette seeds absolute - which gives it spike and shine. As the entire planet knows, colette closed their doors December 2017, but luckily we were able to welcome AnOther 13 to our classic collection in our labs worldwide. Refill your travel tube with the fragrance(s) of your choice available in 3 x 10ml (0.33 FL.OZ.) spray bottles.

listings.rawTitle: Estée Lauder Beautiful Belle Eau de Parfum
listings.description: The fragrance. Love breaks all rules. Fall head over heels for this irreverent floral fragrance and blend of Lychee, Mimosa, Rose Petals, Orange Flower, Gardenia and Marzipan Musk. Romantic, carefree and irreverent. The Inspiration: Modern love is a journey - the first shy moments of attraction. The full-blown romance. The promise to commit forever. Deep. Forever. Beautiful. Fragrance family: Floral Amber. Fragrance notes: Top: Lychee, Rose Petals, Mimosa The Thrill: Happiness that is effervescent and contagious sparkles with notes of Lychee, Rose Petals and Mimosa. Filling the air with the beginning of love Heart: Orange Flower, Gardenia, Tuberose The Romance: Deep in the heart, the magic begins. Head-over-heels passion. The full-blown romance. A floral bouquet of Orange Flower, Gardenia and Tuberose. Luminous. Rich. Feminine. Base: Orris Root, Blush Suede Accord, Marzipan Musk, Ambrox The Promise: A love so strong you can’t live without it. Captured in vibrant Amber notes of Orris Root, a Blush Suede Accord, Marzipan Musk and Ambrox. Sensual with a hint of irreverence.

listings.rawTitle: Yves Saint Laurent Gold Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: A supreme flower bouquet embodying the blaze of gold. The intoxicating tuberose encapsulates the brightest and most radiant of colours that Yves Saint Laurent called "today’s black." The olfaction: To glorify the brightest and most radiant of colours in fragrance, the Master Perfumer Dominique Ropion, a virtuoso of white flowers, chose the nighttime diva of the garden. Solar, voluptuously creamy, fruity, spicy, kissed with golden honeyed nectar, the tuberose gives off a sublimely radiant scent from dusk to dawn. A supreme flower, embodying the blaze of Gold, to glow like the sun during the festive hours. Because, as Yves Saint Laurent would say, "An evening should glow; otherwise, it’s a bit absurd." And as befits an icon, the flamboyant tuberose starring in GOLD has an entourage of lustrous floral beauties. Tropical ylang-ylang with its golden petals and sultry jasmine sambac amplifies its solar creaminess and deliciously fruity tones in a supreme bouquet irradiating a rich amber glow. Fragrance family: Floral Ambery. Top notes: Bergamot Essence, Pink Pepper Essence, Solar Accord Heart notes: Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Tuberose Absolute, Ylang Ylang Essence Base notes: Patchouli Heart Essence, Ambery Woody Accord, Musks The inspiration: "It is today’s black. I always enliven black with gold, through buttons, belts and chains," said Yves Saint Laurent. A memory of his sun-filled childhood in Oran, no collection escaped the couturier’s 'golden' touch. The very first piece he showed on the runway in his own name was a pea coat adorned with gold buttons. The warm metallic colour lent its dazzling brilliance to brocade, lace, lamé, sequins, leather, and embroidery. Evening pieces that seemed entirely sculpted out of gold, like the gleaming, goddess-draped, cut-out gown from Yves Saint Laurent’s autumn/winter 1991/1992. Yves Saint Laurent's style lies in the ability to seamlessly blend simplicity with opulence. Gold plays a pivotal role in this delicate balance. Its very presence sublimates even the most understated designs, imbuing them with a sense of richness and extravagance without overwhelming their inherent elegance. The result is a sophisticated interplay between minimalism and luxury. The YSL silhouette is confident, independent, and unapologetically daring. Gold, in the hands of Yves Saint Laurent, becomes an extension of this attitude, a symbol of its aspirations and desires. It creates an aura of richness and extravagance that emanates not just from the garment itself but from the person who wears it, reflecting its inner strength and supreme allure.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Les Légendaires L'Instant Magic Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: For almost two centuries, Guerlain has been a story of fragrance and beauty, legacy and creation, daring and exploration, heritage and the future. Our roots enrich the present and inspire the future. With more than 1,100 fragrances created since 1828 by five generations of perfumers, our heritage is unique. The Legendary fragrance collection pays tribute to this exceptional heritage. L'Instant Magic is part of Guerlain’s Legendary fragrance collection. A collection made of emblematic fragrances, composed for more than a century by five generations of Perfumers. These mythical pioneer perfumes compose a unique olfactive library that the Maison Guerlain endeavours to preserve. L'Instant Magic transports you to a dream world. With its immediately identifiable scent, it illustrates the instant when a dream suddenly becomes possible. L’Instant Magic is a light, soft fragrance, a mist that caresses on a bed of wood and musk. Designed by Georges Chevalier, its iconic 'inverted heart' bottle is underscored with graceful scrolls typical of Art Nouveau. Its avant-garde stopper, in the form of a hollowed heart, evokes the delicate romanticism of this perfumery masterpiece and represented a real technical feat at the time.

listings.rawTitle: Juliette has a Gun Ode To Dullness Eau de Parfum 7.5ml
listings.description: This creation embodies a neutral, and poetic balance that provides a calming and centering effect. Ode To Dullness pays tribute to the understated beauty of dullness. The transparent appearance of this fragrance conceals an unexpected balance of Badiane and Freesia which exudes a sense of minimal lightness. Combined with the enveloping sensuality of the sandalwood and Cashmere flower the composition wraps you in a cosy halo.

listings.rawTitle: Hermès Jardin De Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Poised between reality and imagination, Le Jardin de Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette evokes a Chinese garden. In this place of meditation, perfumer Jean-Claude Ellena conceived a fragrance dotted with flowers, water, trees and rocks. A floral and botanical fragrance, Le Jardin de Monsieur Li Eau de Toilette expresses a harmonious blend of delicate sambac jasmine, tangy kumquat and fiery bergamot. The bottle echoes the lanterns of horse-drawn carriages and was created by Fred Rawyler. Its glass is in a delicate yellow gradient, the traditional Chinese imperial colour. Painted by artist Li Xin, a river of ink in a thousand shades of anthracite adorns the box. The Parfums-Jardins Collection: The Parfums-Jardins collection brings together the soul of a place, the perfumer's inspiration and the Hermès annual theme. They are olfactory strolls to indulge every desire for freshness, reverie or escape.

listings.description: The scent that started it all. Irresistible and sunny, this warm gourmand fragrance is the ultimate expression of Sol de Janeiro's Brazilian spirit. Experience the sweet sensation of our iconic perfume mist, with delicious notes of pistachio, salted caramel, and vanilla. Feels like summer all year round. Cheirosa 62 Perfume Mist is inspired by the year 1962 when we fell for the Girl from Ipanema and the iconic beach culture of Brazil. Like the sundrenched wonder of Rio, you just can't get enough. Fragrance notes: Top: Pistachio, Almond Middle: Heliotrope, Jasmine Petals Base: Vanilla, Salted Caramel, Sandalwood

listings.description: Brighter notes of Citron, Pepper, Nutmeg and Bergamot add a cosy warmth matched by an invigorating freshness . An exotic grass native to Haiti and Indonesia, Vetyver is often a key ingredient in unisex fragrances.

listings.rawTitle: MALIN + GOETZ Strawberry Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: What it is: Unexpected. bright. refined. A reimagined interpretation of the common garden strawberry - deconstructed and unexpected. This fragrance stimulates the senses using a dynamic blend of fresh and bright notes of bergamot and pink pepper with warm musks, jasmine petals, and orris root to reveal a memorable, genderless scent. Fragrance notes: Top notes: sparkling bergamot, mara strawberry, pink pepper Middle notes: jasmine petals, jasmine lactone captive, woodland greens Base notes: cedarwood, oakmoss, captive musks, orris root

listings.rawTitle: Parfums de Marly Athénaïs Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: Athénaïs is a tribute to the dazzling fusion of vivacity, vibrant energy, positivity, and sophistication. It opens with sparkling notes of neroli and yuzu, followed by a luminous heart of orange flower. The fragrance then settles on a warm base, where a modern duo of tonka beans and vanilla adds a powdery, addictive facet, further enriched by the comforting note of amber. A fragrance inspired by the character of the marquise Athénaïs in 18th-century France, Louis XIV’s greatest love and considered by many as the true queen of the Sun King's court. The fragrance's harmonious blend mirrors the duality in her character as an uplifting scent that radiates confidence, enveloping you softly in a glowing aura of fearless individuality. Flamboyant, Charming, Vivacious.

listings.rawTitle: Frederic Malle Contre-Jour Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Contre-Jour is more than just a perfume; it is a presence, a fiercely free soul by Annick Ménardo. Built against conventional patterns, this fragrance reveals a dazzling yet elusive trail that invites one to never be defined. The perfume echoes the spirit of the Mediterranean wildflower ‘Everlasting Flower’, famed for its extraordinary longevity, a sunlit yellow bloom, contrasting with the dark, untamable depths of its scent. Master perfumer Annick Ménardo drew from this inspiration to craft a fragrance that defies traditional olfactive structures. Notes of the Everlasting Flower unfurl a spicy, almond-tinged nature, dancing alongside an intense rose absolute, embracing its shadows and thorns. To imprint this manifesto on the skin, sandalwood oil offers a rhythm, amplifying the enigma of this creation. Captivated by the allure of contradictions, Annick Ménardo creates fragrances of a new era, for those who cherish their own mystery.

listings.rawTitle: Emporio Armani Stronger With You Amber Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Stronger With You Amber is a deeper and warmer interpretation of the original Stronger With You fragrance, inspired by the perpetual luminosity of the amber stone. The fragrance opens with lavender, which brings a freshness and luminosity to the scent. At the heart is an amber accord, conjured by balsamic notes, which lends a warm and sensual flamboyance to the fragrance. The bright radiance of warm spices, heightened by the fresh citrus of mandarin essence, complements this amber accord. To make this amber accord richer, the vanilla bourbon premium infuses the scent with its balsamic and floral aspects. Powerful and sweet ambery. Fragrance notes: Top notes: Fresh lavender Heart notes: Rich and sensual amber accord Base notes: Warm and sweet vanilla Stronger With You Amber is captured in the distinctive Emporio Armani fragrance glass bottle, shaped with essential lines and curves. Crafted for this edition in a translucent ambery shade, the bottle conjures the ever-radiant amber stone. The glass is adorned with a design of interlacing gold rings that embrace its form, while the iconic Stronger With You cap, in a golden tone, brings a warm and luxurious touch. How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: Fragrance Du Bois Voyage À Paris Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: Voyage À Paris, the new addition to the Fashion Capitals Collection, is not just a fragrance but also a journey, an experience and a celebration of a decade of excellence. It pays a heartfelt tribute to the brand’s origins in Paris, the city of love and a fashion capital that is one of the world's most alluring and sophisticated cities. As well as evoking the intoxicating scents of delectable treats found in Parisian patisseries, the fragrance embodies the essence of the inimitable French style that glides across catwalks and the pages of glossy fashion magazines. It captures the very spirit of French sophistication and refinement, reflecting the timeless allure of a culture known for its artistry, elegance and attention to detail. From the patisseries to the luxury boutiques and couture houses on the iconic Rue Saint-Honoré, this veil of prestige ingredients oozes style and charm. Irresistibly chic and effortlessly elegant, Voyage À Paris was created by master perfumer Kévin Mathys, and starts with top notes of rum, orange blossom and tagete that create a sense of sweetness, vibrancy and a touch of exoticism, reminiscent of sipping cocktails in a Parisian café. The heart of jasmine, honey, and davana evokes the lush, sensual side of Paris, capturing the essence of blooming gardens and the allure of French honey, before a dry-down of oud, alongside creamy sweet vanilla and the earthy richness of oak fusion rounds out this opulent and indulgent Gourmand-Amber parfum.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Liu Eau de Parfum, 75ml
listings.description: How far would you go for love? As an opera lover, Jacques Guerlain discovered the answer to this burning question within the lyrical love story of Puccini's opera, Turandot, and Liu, its heroine. Painting her olfactory portrait, the perfumer paid homage to a woman who was prepared to sacrifice anything for the man she loved, sketching a love story telling the tale of a rare, unconditional love. In this aldehydic floral, flights of jasmine and rose sing with a carnal sensuality that vibrates with iris and vanilla on a woody base. A sensual fragrance for lovers of the shadows.

listings.rawTitle: MALIN + GOETZ Leather Eau de Parfum, 50ml
listings.description: What it is: Nodding to the centuries-old practice of fragrancing artisanal leather goods with custom perfumes, leather is a modern update that marries rawness and refinement. Immediately recognisable and universally appealing, leather is a texture and scent that inevitably evokes feelings of nostalgia. In our formula, muted florals mirror the elegance of smooth leather while rustic wood notes call to mind the softness of a well-worn vintage find. Intimately shaping itself around the wearer like a second skin, leather is a fragrance that only gets better with time. Fragrance notes: Top notes: pepper, lotus flower and clove Middle notes: muguet, orchid and green violet Base notes: leather, cedarwood and sandalwood

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI Le Gemme Amunae Eau de Parfum
listings.description: Discover Bvlgari Le Gemme Amunae, a striking, radiant, floral, woody fragrance crafted around a splendid jasmine absolute and an intense, woody black musk accord. A journey to captivating Sri Lanka in search of the precious moonstone. Known as the gemstone of balance, the precious moonstone captures the power of the moon, bringing you inner clarity and trust in your intuition. Its pearly blue iridescence evokes the multifaceted nature of the self, strong and sensitive, masculine and feminine, in constant evolution. Amun in Arabic means “what is hidden”, just like the moon, whose power we can always feel even if we cannot always see it. Bvlgari Le Gemme Amunae is a striking, radiant blend, an ode to a true olfactive gem: the jasmine flower. Its floral, luminous, fresh, airy, and creamy facets reflect the vibrant hues of the moonstone. The blend of clear jasmine absolute with mysterious, woody black musk accord illustrates how softness can hide intense strength, and how contrasts are essential to inner balance. Olfactive family: Floral, Woody. Olfactive pyramid: Jasmine Absolute and Woody Black Musk Accord.

listings.rawTitle: DIOR Homme Cologne 75ml
listings.description: White Musks procure a cottony effect that is at once powdery and immaculate, an impression of being wrapped in softness. The new fragrance is a true modern cologne - simple and elegantly sophisticated. The main notes consists of citrus, floral and musky accords. Made with Calabrian bergamot, Italian grapefruit blossom and sensual musk. The fragrance gives a sense of purity; like a crisp white cotton shirt and the freshness of the morning that lingers after a soothing shower.

listings.rawTitle: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: Born of simplicity and essentiality; guided by femininity and elegance. The For Her line is Narciso Rodriguez’s gift to women and a homage to their inner beauty. The patented heart of musc infused in every For Her perfume takes its wearer on a sensorial journey. The Fragrance: For Her Eau de Toilette centralises on three olfactory pulsations. The first pulse resembles that of a ‘flower honey’. This is a solar musk with accents of orange blossom and osmanthus. Further into the fragrance, the ‘amber light’ pulse uses musk in its most unique fashion, its softness enveloping the woman who wears it with Amberlyn and vanilla. Lastly, a ‘wood’ pulse furthers the musk with notes of vetiver, magnifying the sensuality of the perfume. The Bottle: Narciso Rodriguez takes his design philosophy to the bottle. Stripped of anything unessential, the lacquered bottle is modern and discreet in its subdued nature. Top notes: Osmanthus blossom Heart notes: Heart of Musk Base notes: Patchouli, Amberlyn

listings.rawTitle: Acqua di Parma Colonia Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: A modern and intensified interpretation of the Maison’s first-ever fragrance, the iconic Colonia, originally launched in 1916, Colonia Il Profumo draws from the golden radiance of the Italian sun with a refined blend of ylang-ylang and patchouli, which enhance and prolong the citrus notes throughout the fragrance. The top notes feature an exquisite blend of bergamot, grapefruit, blood orange, and petitgrain, delivering an initial burst of fresh, zesty aroma that captivates the senses. At its heart, Colonia Il Profumo blooms with the aromatic allure of rosemary, the volume, intensity and opulence of ylang-ylang, and the unique touch of orange leaves absolute. Ylang-ylang was specifically chosen for its multi-dimensional notes that sublimate the golden fruits and their presence throughout the whole sillage adding modernity and richness to a timeless icon. The base notes are anchored by the sophisticated depth of vetiver oil and patchouli, giving structure and character to the fragrance. The fragrance's yellow hue evokes the warmth of the Italian sun and the zest of citrus fruits, while the bottle features a golden-tinted base for an intense and robust visual experience.

listings.rawTitle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for Women Refill, 150ml
listings.description: The power within. Burberry Goddess tells a story of self-discovery. The new campaign follows Emma Mackey and a pride of lionesses. Radiating confidence, strength and kindness, Emma embodies the spirit of Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum. The scent: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum is a unique gourmand aromatic fragrance led by a powerful trio of vanillas. On top, a vanilla infusion with woody tonalities, at the heart a vanilla caviar with a rich sweetness, and at the base a vanilla absolute enriched with luminous lavender. The bottle: Burberry Goddess Eau de Parfum for women is encased in an elegant square-shaped bottle designed to be refilled. Refill sold separately. Gabardine beige and gold packaging adorned with a medallion reference the brand’s rich heritage. Refillable format: Thanks to a sustainable and innovative refill system, all Burberry Goddess bottles can be refilled with ease. How to refill: Remove the bottle cap, then unscrew the fragrance pump, and screw the refill onto the bottle’s neck The refill will stop automatically once the perfume bottle is filled Unscrew the refill, screw the fragrance pump back onto the bottle and replace the cap Your refilled Burberry Goddess fragrance is now ready to be used How to use: Spray the Burberry Goddess perfume generously onto pulse points such as the neck, wrists and décolletage to increase the longevity of this refined Burberry scent. Gently press onto the skin to preserve the essence of the fragrance.

listings.rawTitle: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Often associated with fire, Saffron is considered the most auspicious colour in India. The monks and sages of Hinduism wear Saffron clothes as a symbol of abstinence from all material things, thoughts and pleasures. It has always been a part of Byredo's founder's Indian upbringing, both in smell, taste and colour. The fragrance is inspired by this idea of unity and inclusion. Intense Amber Genderless Notes: Top: Juniper Berries, Pomelo, Saffron Heart: Black Violet, Cristal Rose, Accord Cuir Base: Blonde Woods, Raspberry, Vetiver How to use: To be sprayed on the skin and/or clothes.

listings.rawTitle: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Florabloom Eau de Parfum 75ml
listings.description: Absolus Allegoria, the absolute fragrance collection, is an enchanting and mysterious journey to the heart of the world’s wonders once night falls: fragrance trails celebrating deep and powerful nature, revealed by striking contrasts in the moonlight. Discover Florabloom Absolu, an enchanting floral bouquet by moonlight. Tuberose becomes more sensual and hypnotic, accompanied by an enigmatic Four O’Clock Flower accord. The warm depth of sandalwood and the woody refinement of patchouli beautifully enhance this powerful and addictive composition, inspired by the fascinating spectacle of desert superblooms at nightfall. "Florabloom Asbolus is a spellbinding nocturnal bouquet, in which tuberose becomes more sensual and bewitching than ever." Delphine Jelk, Guerlain Perfume Creation Director & Perfumer. A powerful symbol of Guerlain’s commitment to the planet, the Absolus Allegoria fragrances contain more than 90% natural-origin* ingredients. The French beetroot alcohol used in their formulas comes from a network committed to responsible farming. Floabloom Absolu comes in the Allegoria collection’s emblematic bottle, which is made in France and crafted from 15% recycled glass. Its unscrewable spray and transparent lacquer allow it to be recycled more easily. *In accordance with ISO 16128, calculation includes water.

listings.rawTitle: CHANEL Gabrielle CHANEL Essence Eau de Parfum Refillable Purse Spray, 3 x 7ml
listings.description: The limited-edition GABRIELLE CHANEL ESSENCE Purse Spray offers an irresistible, intuitive fragrance experience. Its golden case, adorned with a double chain strap, presents as a piece of jewellery that can be worn around the wrist. A 7ml format that can be taken anywhere on the go to refresh the floral, solar notes of the fragrance throughout the day. Thanks to its double chain strap, this jewellery accessory can be worn around the wrist or slipped into a bag, allowing you to take the refillable 7ml fragrance anywhere with you on the go. The GABRIELLE CHANEL ESSENCE Purse Spray comes with two refills. A set of three refills is also available.

listings.rawTitle: Gucci The Alchemist's Garden Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum 50ml
listings.description: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden reimagines the four stages of ancient alchemy. The Ignis stage: Gucci The Alchemist’s Garden Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum. Forged like a fire in the ocean from honeyed Damascena Rose and salty Red Seaweed. Incandescent. Mystical. Transcendent. Fragrance family: Floral, Marine. Like a powerful storm rolling off the ocean towards a fire-loving land, Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum transports you beyond your wildest imagination. An undiscovered treasure forged through the blazing chaos between shore and sea, salty Red Seaweed crashes into honeyed Damascena Rose. The pure essence of Red Seaweed is revealed through a modern supercritical fluid extraction technique that preserves its marine beauty. A truly unique sillage of extreme and unusual beauty. The bottle: Rosa Incandescente Eau de Parfum’s red glass bottle is adorned with a seahorse. Guided by the creature’s mystical presence, the scent transcends your spirit by burning the boundaries between art and science. Olfactive alchemist: Perfumers Cecile Matton and Ralf Schwieger created this exceptional Floral Marine jewel by bringing together their respective skills for utilising imperfections and enhancing the imagined colour of an olfactive ingredient. Freeing their minds from the usual constraints, they worked in tandem to bring these two free-spirited ideas into one, a fascinating combination rarely seen before. How to use: To enjoy the addictive notes of this Gucci perfume for longer, it is recommended to apply it to the body’s pulse points, including the wrists, neck, chest, and behind the ears. Designed to be layered with other fragrances, create your own unique scent with other Eaux de Parfum from the Gucci Alchemist’s Garden collection.

listings.rawTitle: Lancôme Absolue Les Parfums I Flamed A Rose Eau de Parfum, 100ml
listings.description: In this land where nature's grandeur lives untamed, we grow a rose like no other. Absolue Les Parfums, a radical collection dedicated to our rose, born in our domain. Our first-ever rose-dedicated haute-parfumerie collection composed of 11 scents unveils our exclusive centifolia rose like you've never smelled before. Reinventing perfumery's iconic ingredient. I Flamed A Rose Eau de Parfum with Patchouli and Amber. Burning with fire, the rose is fearless and dangerous. Riding with deep patchouli, she becomes untameable. Her defying spirit is only equalled by her legendary beauty. Encountering deep masculine vetiver, perfectly paired with earthy patchouli, our rose is sensual yet balanced and harmonious. Meet The Perfumer. Daphné Bugey: "Between the elegance and carnal extravagance, a rose dressed in the depths of woods and amber... I was inspired by the duality of the rose, between its elegance and its sensuality." How to use: Apply on pulse point: wrist, inner elbow and neck.

listings.rawTitle: BVLGARI MAN In Black Parfum 60ml
listings.description: Man in Black Parfum is a darker, more enigmatic expression of Fire, unveiling a deeper and mysterious intensity. From the first bright spark to the smouldering embers, this fragrance captures the untamed power of a flame, revealing its duality, bold yet mysterious. The elemental force is part of a deeper inspiration that unites the entire Bvlgari Man collection. At its heart lies the Circle of Nature: a visual and narrative journey through the geometry of nature, capturing the eternal essence of the elements. For Bvlgari Man, the Circle of Nature holds profound meaning. More than just a shape, it is a force that governs all life, the eternal essence of nature, timeless and ever flowing. The circular symbolism also echoes the refillable design of the Bvlgari Man flacon and the Bvlgari Bvlgari engravings on the cap, reinforcing a connection to nature and timeless craftsmanship. The Bvlgari Man flacon reflects the Maison’s unmistakable style, where the geometric precision of Roman architecture meets the bold modernity of Italian design. With its clean lines, structured silhouette, and refined finish, it embodies both audacity and elegance. Moreover, the matte black of Man in Black evokes lava stone polished by Fire. Beyond design, the packaging also encompasses the use of sustainable materials. Overall, the newly designed Bvlgari Man in Black flacon features 34% PCR (post-consumer recycled) materials, including 40% recycled glass and 28% recycled plastic. To enhance usability, the new packaging features a removable cap that protects the atomiser and reveals a circular aluminium plate engraved with the Bvlgari Bvlgari logotype. Reinforcing its commitment to making the flacon last longer, the collection embraces a fully refillable design. Each fragrance in the collection is offered in a dedicated 200ml refill, compatible with all flacon sizes: 60ml, 100ml, and 150ml.

listings.rawTitle: INITIO Parfums Privés Lift Me Up Eau de Parfum, 90ml
listings.description: Lift Me Up captures the force of the sun, from the first golden ray to the last lingering glow. This floral-amber fragrance channels the sun’s revitalising energy to awaken your senses and uplift your spirit. Whether you’re seeking stress relief, a burst of summer vibes, or simply a brighter outlook, Lift Me Up is your gateway to an instant lift in mood. A scent that soothes and empowers, elevating your mindset to a sunnier, more luminous version of yourself. Notes of Ylang-Ylang, Bergamot, and Magnolia burst with intensity, while an overdose of Musk fuses with the skin, releasing waves of warmth and vitality. The richness of roasted Tonka beans and Vanilla adds addictive depth, creating a sun-kissed perfume that feels like a never-ending summer. Backed by science. Driven by emotion Designed to energise, empower, and connect Let the sunshine in, and keep summer alive all year long All our fragrances are unisex and made in France

Woody.

listings.rawTitle: Montblanc Legend Spirit Eau de Toilette 50ml
listings.description: A new chapter for Montblanc unfolds with LEGEND Spirit. The heritage brand, well known for its sophistication and pursuit of excellence, has created a fragrance for a man with a truly independent spirit. Inspired by modern shades of white, LEGEND Spirit is a breath-taking composition, a fresh, intense fragrance. The top notes are sparkling with pink peppercorn, bitter grapefruit and zesty bergamot. Its powerfully aromatic heart beats wildly, with intense lavender and cardamom. A sensual blend with oak moss, the unique signature scent of Montblanc LEGEND, softened with a cocktail of white musk, cashmere and blonde woods.

A novel that feeds on the imagination, Voyage d’Hermès expresses the long-standing and unusual relationship between the house and travel. An interplay of paradoxes, complements and unexpected alliances supports the premise of woody notes that are fresh yet musky, familiar yet surprising, hovering between impulsive and comforting, equally at ease with men as with women. Hermès designer Philippe Mouquet created a travel object bottle for Voyage d’Hermès, designed for journeys and symbolic of movement.
